description.zh: 以酥脆黄油派皮包裹酸甜苹果丁，烘烤至金黄，外皮酥香、内馅温润多汁，奶香与肉桂辛香交织。
description.en: Flaky butter pastry crust filled with spiced, tender-sweet apple slices, baked until golden; crisp exterior, juicy cinnamon-infused filling with rich dairy notes.

recommendation.zh: 喜爱经典美式甜点者、家庭聚餐时孩子与长辈皆宜的暖心甜品。
recommendation.en: Ideal for dessert lovers and families—comforting, universally appealing, and perfect for all ages.

caution: 含小麦、牛奶、鸡蛋；热量较高；分量适中偏饱腹。

reviews.content: 派皮酥到掉渣，苹果酸甜平衡，肉桂香气恰到好处，吃完幸福感爆棚！
温热食用风味最佳，搭配香草冰淇淋绝配，传统味道但毫不腻口。

description.zh: 猪肋排经慢烤烟熏，外焦里嫩，肉汁丰盈，酱香浓郁带微甜与烟熏风味。
description.en: Slow-smoked pork ribs glazed with sweet and tangy BBQ sauce, tender with juicy meat, caramelized crust, and rich smoky-sweet flavor.

recommendation.zh: 肉食爱好者与聚会人群首选，满足大快朵颐的畅快感。
recommendation.en: Ideal for meat lovers and groups seeking bold, satisfying comfort food.

caution: 高脂较油腻，含小麦和大豆，分量足需多人共享。

reviews.content: 肋排软烂脱骨，酱汁浓香不腻，烟熏味恰到好处！
肉质非常嫩，酱料层次丰富，微甜带果酸，回味悠长。

description.zh: 蓬松烘烤苏打饼配浓稠肉汁，口感酥软交融，风味咸鲜浓郁带黑胡椒辛香。
description.en: Fluffy buttermilk biscuits topped with rich, savory sausage gravy made from pan drippings, milk, and black pepper—creamy, hearty, and deeply comforting.

recommendation.zh: 适合早餐嗜好饱腹感者、寒冷天气食客及美式风味爱好者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for breakfast lovers seeking hearty comfort food on cold days or craving classic American flavors.

caution: 高脂油腻，含小麦牛奶，分量较大。

reviews.content: 饼干外酥内软，肉汁浓香不腻，黑胡椒提味恰到好处，地道美式早餐灵魂！
分量实在，暖胃又满足，适合大清早需要能量的人，建议搭配煎蛋更完美。

description.zh: 煎脆培根、新鲜生菜与多汁番茄夹在烤香吐司中，酥脆与清爽交织，咸鲜微酸，烟熏风味突出。
description.en: Crispy pan-fried bacon, crisp lettuce, and juicy tomato layered between toasted white bread—savory, smoky, and refreshingly acidic with contrasting crunchy and tender textures.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢经典美式简餐、追求口感层次的上班族或轻食爱好者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for busy professionals or light-eaters craving a satisfying, no-fuss American classic.

caution: 含小麦和猪肉；培根较咸且略油腻；分量适中。

reviews.content: 培根焦香酥脆，番茄酸甜解腻，三重口感平衡得恰到好处！
吐司烤得金黄不干硬，蛋黄酱用量刚好，整体清爽不厚重。

description.zh: 以黑巧克力和黄油为主料烤制而成，质地绵密微韧，口感湿润醇厚，带有浓郁可可香与微妙苦甜平衡。
description.en: A dense, fudgy American dessert baked with dark chocolate, butter, sugar, eggs, and flour; rich, moist, bittersweet, and deeply chocolatey.

recommendation.zh: 巧克力爱好者、下午茶提神者及甜食入门者首选，温和甜度老少皆宜。
recommendation.en: Perfect for chocolate lovers, afternoon tea guests, or anyone seeking a comforting, not-too-sweet treat.

caution: 含高脂高糖，分量偏大，含坚果时需注意过敏原

reviews.content: 巧克力香气扑鼻，外皮微脆内里湿润，苦甜平衡得恰到好处！
质地扎实不干噎，搭配咖啡绝配，是经典美式甜点的诚意呈现。

description.zh: 鸡翅中经油炸至外皮酥脆，裹上辣椒酱、黄油与醋调制的辣味酱汁，咸鲜微酸带劲辣，口感焦香酥脆。
description.en: Deep-fried chicken wings tossed in a spicy, tangy sauce made with cayenne pepper, butter, and vinegar—crispy outside, tender inside, with bold heat and savory tang.

recommendation.zh: 嗜辣者与聚会爱好者首选，开胃解馋，适合边看球赛边享用。
recommendation.en: Perfect for spice lovers and social gatherings—irresistible as a shared appetizer during sports events or casual hangs.

caution: 辣度高，含小麦和乳制品，油脂较重。

reviews.content: 辣得过瘾又不掩鸡肉本味，酱汁挂得均匀，越吃越上瘾！
酥脆度满分，辣中带微酸很解腻，配冰啤酒绝了。

description.zh: 牛肉饼煎烤至外焦里嫩，夹入松软面包中，搭配生菜、番茄与特调酱汁，咸鲜多汁，奶香微酸。
description.en: Grilled beef patty, tender and juicy, nestled in a soft bun with crisp lettuce, tomato, and tangy sauce—savory, rich, and satisfying.

recommendation.zh: 适合快节奏上班族、学生及家庭聚餐，饱腹感强且食用便捷。
recommendation.en: Ideal for busy professionals, students, or families seeking a hearty, handheld meal.

caution: 含小麦和牛奶，油脂含量较高，分量较足。

reviews.content: 牛肉饼肉汁丰盈，面包松软不干，酱料层次丰富，一口满足！
分量实在，芝士融化恰到好处，适合喜欢经典美式风味的人。

description.zh: 罗马生菜、烤面包丁、帕玛森奶酪与凤尾鱼酱汁拌制，口感酥脆清爽，风味咸鲜浓郁带微酸
description.en: Crisp romaine lettuce tossed with garlicky croutons, shaved Parmesan, and a creamy anchovy-egg yolk dressing—savory, tangy, and rich with crunchy texture.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢经典西式风味、追求便捷优质轻食的上班族或沙拉爱好者
recommendation.en: Ideal for salad lovers and busy professionals seeking a satisfying, restaurant-style classic.

caution: 含鸡蛋、奶酪、小麦；酱汁偏咸，分量适中

reviews.content: 酱汁醇厚不腻，生菜清脆，凤尾鱼提鲜恰到好处，复刻了正宗美式风味
面包丁香脆，奶酪咸香平衡，适合喜欢有层次感沙拉的食客

description.zh: 奶油奶酪、鸡蛋与消化饼干底烘烤而成，口感绵密柔滑，奶香浓郁，甜中微酸。
description.en: Made with cream cheese, eggs, and a graham cracker crust, baked until set—creamy, smooth, richly dairy-forward with balanced sweetness and subtle tang.

recommendation.zh: 甜品爱好者与奶酪控必试，适合喜欢柔和甜味与细腻质地的人群。
recommendation.en: Ideal for dessert lovers and cheese enthusiasts who enjoy creamy, not overly sweet treats.

caution: 含乳制品与鸡蛋，较油腻，分量偏大

reviews.content: 奶香醇厚不腻，底部酥脆与上层绵密形成绝妙对比！
酸甜平衡恰到好处，冷藏后口感更细腻顺滑。

description.zh: 以新鲜蛤蜊为主料，搭配土豆、洋葱和培根慢炖而成，汤体浓稠顺滑，咸鲜中带奶香与微甜。
description.en: A creamy New England-style soup made with fresh clams, potatoes, onions, celery, bacon, and milk or cream, slow-simmered for rich, briny, savory depth and velvety texture.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢暖胃浓汤的食客，尤其推荐给秋冬季节或需补充能量的人群。
recommendation.en: Ideal for cold-weather diners or anyone craving a hearty, comforting, protein-rich soup.

caution: 含乳制品和贝类，分量适中偏饱腹

reviews.content: 蛤蜊鲜味十足，汤体醇厚不腻，奶香与海味平衡得恰到好处。
土豆软糯入味，培根增香不抢戏，喝完浑身暖意融融。

description.zh: 鸡胸肉、培根、牛油果、水煮蛋、蓝纹奶酪、番茄和生菜切丁冷拌，口感丰富层次分明，咸鲜中带微酸与奶香。
description.en: Chopped grilled chicken, crispy bacon, creamy avocado, hard-boiled egg, crumbled blue cheese, tomato, and romaine lettuce tossed cold. Savory, creamy, tangy, and crunchy with balanced richness.

recommendation.zh: 适合追求营养均衡的上班族或健身人士，饱腹感强且蛋白质充足。
recommendation.en: Ideal for health-conscious diners or office workers seeking a protein-rich, satisfying meal.

caution: 含乳制品与鸡蛋，分量较大，轻微咸香不辣。

reviews.content: 鸡胸肉嫩滑不柴，蓝纹奶酪提味绝了，饱腹又不腻！
食材新鲜分量足，牛油果和培根搭配特别香，适合午餐抗饿。

description.zh: 以玉米粉为主料，烘烤制成的美式传统面包，外皮微脆、内里松软湿润，带有天然玉米香甜与淡淡奶香。
description.en: A classic American quick bread made with cornmeal, baked until golden; tender-crumbed, slightly sweet, with earthy corn flavor and subtle dairy richness.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢粗粮口感或追求怀旧美式风味的食客首选，也适合搭配炖菜解腻。
recommendation.en: Ideal for corn lovers, comfort-food seekers, or those pairing with savory stews or BBQ.

caution: 含小麦和牛奶，中等分量，非低脂食品

reviews.content: 玉米香气扑鼻，外脆内润，配烤鸡腿绝了！
质地扎实不干噎，甜度适中，孩子也爱吃。

description.zh: 水波蛋配英式松饼、煎火腿与荷兰酱，口感柔嫩滑润，风味咸鲜浓郁带奶香
description.en: Poached eggs on English muffins with Canadian bacon and rich, creamy hollandaise sauce; tender, silky, and luxuriously savory with buttery notes.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢经典美式早午餐、追求精致口感与丰盛体验的食客
recommendation.en: Ideal for brunch lovers seeking a rich, comforting, and elegantly balanced breakfast experience.

caution: 含乳制品与鸡蛋，酱汁偏油腻，分量适中

reviews.content: 荷兰酱丝滑不腻，水波蛋流心完美，火腿咸香恰到好处
早午餐仪式感满分，松饼酥脆与蛋液柔嫩形成绝妙对比

description.zh: 鸡腿肉或鸡胸肉裹粉油炸，外皮金黄酥脆，内里多汁嫩滑，咸鲜带微香
description.en: Crispy golden-brown chicken pieces (thigh or breast), deep-fried until crunchy outside and juicy inside, seasoned with savory salt and herbs.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢酥脆口感和高能量餐食的食客，尤其适合年轻人和体力消耗大者
recommendation.en: Ideal for young adults and active people craving crispy, satisfying comfort food.

caution: 较油腻；含小麦和鸡蛋；分量偏大

reviews.content: 外皮炸得超级酥脆，咬下去直掉渣，鸡肉还特别嫩，完全不柴！
分量实在，调味恰到好处，不腻口，配啤酒绝了

description.zh: 切达奶酪与白吐司经黄油煎烤，外皮金黄酥脆，内里芝士拉丝浓香，咸鲜微乳香，温暖满足。
description.en: Sliced cheddar cheese sandwiched between white bread, grilled in butter until golden and crispy outside, with molten, creamy, savory-umami filling.

recommendation.zh: 适合儿童、上班族及芝士爱好者，快速饱腹又治愈的暖心主食。
recommendation.en: Perfect for kids, busy professionals, or cheese lovers seeking a comforting, quick, satisfying meal.

caution: 含乳制品和小麦，较油腻，分量适中

reviews.content: 外脆里嫩，芝士拉丝超长，奶香扑鼻，一口回到童年！
黄油香恰到好处，不腻不干，配番茄汤绝了。

description.zh: 以秋葵、虾、鸡肉和香肠为基底，慢炖而成的浓稠汤品，口感滑润醇厚，风味咸鲜微辣，带有烟熏与泥土香气。
description.en: A rich, slow-simmered stew featuring okra, shrimp, chicken, and smoked sausage; thickened with roux and filé, offering savory, smoky, and mildly spicy flavors with a smooth, velvety texture.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢浓郁风味和复合口感的食客，尤其适合寒冷天气或想体验南方美式风情的人。
recommendation.en: Ideal for lovers of hearty, complex soups—especially in cold weather or those exploring authentic Southern U.S. cuisine.

caution: 中辣，含甲壳类、小麦、大豆，分量较足

reviews.content: 秋葵滑而不腻，香肠烟熏味十足，汤底层次丰富，喝一口就暖到胃里！
虾肉弹牙，鸡肉软嫩，汤汁浓稠适中，配米饭绝了。

description.zh: 烤制牛肉或猪肉香肠夹入松软白面包，外脆内多汁，咸鲜微甜，伴有黄芥末或番茄酱的酸香。
description.en: Grilled beef or pork frankfurter nestled in a soft white bun, juicy and savory-sweet with tangy mustard or ketchup.

recommendation.zh: 适合赶时间上班族、学生及儿童，快速饱腹又充满美式街头活力。
recommendation.en: Perfect for busy professionals, students, and kids seeking a quick, satisfying, nostalgic bite.

caution: 含小麦和大豆，较油腻，分量适中不辣。

reviews.content: 香肠多汁弹牙，面包微脆，黄芥末提味绝了，一口回到纽约街头！
分量刚好，热乎满足，孩子每次路过都嚷着要买一根。

description.zh: 以大米为主料，与鸡肉、香肠、虾等炖煮而成；口感软糯微韧，风味鲜香浓郁，略带烟熏与微辣。
description.en: A Creole rice dish cooked with chicken, andouille sausage, shrimp, vegetables, and spices—simmered until tender, savory, smoky, and mildly spicy.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢丰富口感和复合风味的食客，尤其适合嗜好咸鲜微辣的成年人。
recommendation.en: Ideal for adults who enjoy hearty, flavorful, one-pot meals with bold seasoning.

caution: 中辣，含海鲜、小麦、大豆，分量扎实。

reviews.content: 香料层次分明，米饭吸饱汤汁却不烂，虾和香肠搭配绝了！
分量足味道正，微辣恰到好处，适合配冰啤酒解腻。

description.zh: 青柠汁、炼乳与蛋黄制成酸甜滑嫩的馅料，铺于酥脆全麦饼干底上，冷藏定型，口感清爽酸甜，奶香柔和。
description.en: A classic American dessert made with key lime juice, sweetened condensed milk, and egg yolks, chilled on a crisp graham cracker crust—tangy, creamy, smooth, and refreshingly bright.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢清新酸甜口味者必尝；适合餐后解腻或夏日消暑。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those who love bright, zesty desserts; perfect after rich meals or on hot days.

good_for: 餐后甜点，独食或分享皆宜
caution: 含鸡蛋牛奶；分量适中；无辣度

reviews.content: 青柠香气扑鼻，酸度恰到好处，不齁甜，饼底酥而不散，回味悠长。
冷藏后口感更绵密，酸味提神醒脑，适合不爱厚重甜点的人。

description.zh: 新鲜龙虾肉以黄油轻煎，拌入蛋黄酱与少许柠檬汁，裹入微烤布里欧修面包卷中，口感鲜嫩多汁，风味咸鲜微酸、清爽不腻。
description.en: Tender chunks of fresh lobster meat sautéed in butter, mixed with lemon-infused mayonnaise, and served in a lightly toasted brioche roll. Fresh, briny, creamy, and subtly tangy.

recommendation.zh: 海鲜爱好者与追求精致简餐者首选，适合喜欢清鲜口感又不愿负担过重的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for seafood lovers and those seeking a light yet luxurious lunch—fresh, satisfying, and not overly heavy.

caution: 含甲壳类过敏原；分量适中偏小；轻微黄油油腻感

reviews.content: 龙虾肉饱满弹牙，黄油香气与柠檬酸度平衡绝妙，面包酥软恰到好处！
用料实在，龙虾甜味突出，虽价格稍高但物有所值，夏日吃格外开胃。

description.zh: 通心粉搭配切达与帕玛森芝士酱，烘烤至表面微焦，口感柔滑浓郁，奶香醇厚，咸鲜微酸。
description.en: Elbow macaroni baked with sharp cheddar and Parmesan cheese sauce, golden on top. Creamy, rich, and savory with a subtle tang.

recommendation.zh: 适合儿童、芝士爱好者及追求温暖饱腹感的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for kids, cheese lovers, and anyone craving comforting, hearty comfort food.

caution: 高脂高热量；含牛奶和小麦；分量较足。

reviews.content: 芝士拉丝完美，酱汁浓稠不腻，孩子连吃两碗！
烘烤后表层微脆，内里热乎绵密，暖胃又满足。

description.zh: 以面粉、牛奶、鸡蛋调制面糊，平底锅煎制而成；外微酥内松软，奶香浓郁，微甜柔润。
description.en: Made from flour, milk, and eggs, cooked on a griddle until golden. Soft, fluffy interior with a slight crisp edge, rich dairy aroma and mild sweetness.

recommendation.zh: 适合早餐人群、儿童及喜欢温和甜味的食客，饱腹又暖心。
recommendation.en: Ideal for breakfast lovers, children, and those preferring mild, comforting sweetness.

caution: 含小麦和乳制品；分量适中，不油腻。

reviews.content: 松软蓬松，奶香扑鼻，搭配枫糖浆绝了！孩子每早必点。
火候刚好，边缘微脆，内里湿润，比普通松饼更轻盈不腻。

description.zh: 全麦或白吐司夹花生酱与葡萄果冻，无需加热，冷食；口感柔滑微黏，风味甜润酸甜平衡，略带坚果香。
description.en: Sliced bread (often white or whole wheat) spread with creamy peanut butter and grape jelly, served cold without cooking. Smooth, slightly sticky texture with balanced sweet-tart flavor and nutty aroma.

recommendation.zh: 儿童、学生及早餐偏好便捷甜食者，能量充足且制作快速。
recommendation.en: Great for kids, students, and anyone wanting a quick, energizing breakfast.

caution: 含花生过敏原；甜度较高；分量适中

reviews.content: 童年味道重现！花生酱醇厚，果冻酸甜解腻，两口就治愈。
用全麦吐司更健康，果冻不流汁，夹心均匀不干不腻。

description.zh: 薄切牛肉片与洋葱、青椒快炒，夹入烤热法棍，融化的美式奶酪带来浓郁奶香与咸鲜，口感柔嫩多汁、外脆内润。
description.en: Sliced ribeye steak and sautéed onions and green peppers, stuffed into a toasted hoagie roll with melted American cheese—tender, juicy, savory, and richly creamy.

recommendation.zh: 肉食爱好者与芝士控必点，追求饱足感和经典美式风味的食客首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for meat lovers and cheese enthusiasts seeking a hearty, iconic American comfort meal.

caution: 高脂高热量，含小麦和牛奶，分量较大

reviews.content: 牛肉嫩滑不柴，奶酪拉丝完美，面包外脆内软，地道费城风味！
分量实在，饱腹感强，洋葱甜香平衡了奶酪的厚重感。

description.zh: 黑麦面包夹腌牛肉、瑞士奶酪、酸菜和千岛酱，煎至外脆内热，咸鲜浓郁，酸香解腻，口感层次丰富。
description.en: Grilled rye bread sandwich with corned beef, Swiss cheese, sauerkraut, and Thousand Island dressing—crispy exterior, warm melty interior, savory-sour balance and rich umami depth.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢经典美式风味、追求饱腹感与风味冲击的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for lovers of bold, hearty American comfort food who crave savory richness and tangy contrast.

caution: 含乳制品和小麦，分量较大，较油腻

reviews.content: 腌牛肉软嫩多汁，酸菜清爽解腻，奶酪融化恰到好处，经典美式风味无可替代。
黑麦面包煎得焦香酥脆，千岛酱微甜提味，整体咸酸平衡，饱腹又满足。

description.zh: 以面粉、鸡蛋、牛奶和黄油为主料，铁板烘烤而成；外脆内松软，奶香浓郁，微甜不腻。
description.en: Made with flour, eggs, milk, and butter, baked in a waffle iron until golden. Crispy outside, tender and airy inside, with rich dairy sweetness.

recommendation.zh: 早餐爱好者、甜食控及家庭用餐者首选，温暖饱腹又充满仪式感。
recommendation.en: Ideal for breakfast lovers and sweet-toothed diners seeking a comforting, satisfying start to the day.

caution: 含小麦、牛奶、鸡蛋；分量较足，易饱。

reviews.content: 外皮焦脆内里蓬松，淋上枫糖浆后甜香平衡，早餐幸福感爆棚！
质地扎实不干硬，搭配水果和奶油口感层次丰富，孩子超爱。

description.zh: 以冷冻巴西莓泥为基底，混合香蕉等水果搅打成浓稠冰沙， topped with格兰诺拉、新鲜水果和坚果，口感绵密冰凉，风味酸甜清新带果香
description.en: A thick, smooth blend of frozen açaí pulp and banana, topped with granola, fresh fruit, and nuts. Creamy, icy texture with bright, tangy-sweet berry flavor.

recommendation.zh: 适合追求健康轻食的上班族、健身人群及素食者，营养丰富且低负担
recommendation.en: Ideal for health-conscious diners, fitness enthusiasts, and vegetarians seeking a nutrient-dense, energizing breakfast.

caution: 含坚果与牛奶制品，分量较大，乳糖不耐者慎选

reviews.content: 酸甜平衡超赞！巴西莓香气纯正，格兰诺拉增添香脆口感，饱腹又不腻
水果新鲜度高，冰沙细腻顺滑，适合夏天早晨，但坚果略多对过敏者需留意

description.zh: 黑豆泥与虾仁混合油炸而成，外酥里糯，咸鲜微辣，带有棕榈油独特香气
description.en: Mashed black-eyed peas and dried shrimp fried in dendê palm oil; crispy outside, tender and slightly chewy inside, with savory, umami-rich, subtly spicy flavor.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢异域风味和街头烟火气的食客，适合初次体验巴西饮食文化者
recommendation.en: Ideal for adventurous eaters seeking authentic Brazilian street food and bold, aromatic flavors.

caution: 含甲壳类、花生油；略油腻；中等辣度

reviews.content: 外皮酥脆焦香，内馅绵密鲜甜，棕榈油香气令人难忘！
虾味突出，豆泥细腻不腻，辣度刚好唤醒味蕾

description.zh: 主料木薯切条油炸，外皮金黄酥脆，内里绵软微甜，带有天然淀粉清香与焦香风味。
description.en: Cassava root cut into sticks and deep-fried until golden and crispy outside, tender and slightly sweet inside, with a clean, earthy, toasty starch aroma.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢粗粮口感、追求地道南美风味的食客，尤其受素食者和无麸质饮食者欢迎。
recommendation.en: Ideal for vegetarians, gluten-free diners, and those seeking authentic, hearty South American comfort food.

caution: 含油脂较高，分量适中，无辣度，不含常见过敏原。

reviews.content: 外酥里糯，木薯本味清甜不腻，比薯条更健康有嚼劲！
金黄酥脆，蘸番茄酱绝配，是餐厅最受欢迎的巴西风味小食。

description.zh: 烤切达奶酪、烤牛肉片、番茄和酸黄瓜夹在烤脆法棍中，外酥内融，咸鲜浓郁带微酸回甘。
description.en: Grilled cheddar cheese, roasted beef slices, tomato, and pickles layered in toasted French bread—crispy exterior, molten interior, savory-rich with tangy balance.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢经典热三明治的食客，尤其适合午餐快速饱腹或奶酪爱好者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for lunch seekers and cheese lovers wanting a hearty, comforting hot sandwich.

caution: 含乳制品和小麦；分量扎实，较油腻。

reviews.content: 奶酪拉丝完美，牛肉多汁不柴，面包烤得恰到好处，经典巴西风味太满足了！
分量实在，热乎香浓，适合冷天吃，唯一建议可选减盐版更健康。

description.zh: 以木薯粉为主料，煎制成薄而柔韧的圆饼，口感软糯微弹，带有天然清甜与淡淡谷物香。
description.en: A Brazilian breakfast flatbread made from cassava flour, pan-fried until tender and slightly chewy, with mild sweetness and earthy, nutty notes.

recommendation.zh: 适合乳糖不耐、麸质敏感者及追求天然碳水的健康饮食人群。
recommendation.en: Ideal for gluten-free, dairy-free, or clean-carb seekers seeking a light, traditional breakfast.

caution: 无麸质但含木薯淀粉，分量适中不油腻

reviews.content: 软糯不粘牙，木薯清香十足，比普通煎饼更清爽健康！
外缘微脆内里柔韧，配咖啡绝了，饱腹感恰到好处。

description.zh: 以盐腌鳕鱼为主料，混合土豆、洋葱和欧芹，油炸至外酥里嫩，咸鲜浓郁，略带海洋清香。
description.en: Crispy golden fritters made with rehydrated salted cod, mashed potato, onion, and parsley, fried until golden—savory, briny, and tender inside with a crunchy exterior.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢海鲜风味、追求经典巴西小吃的食客首选，适合初次体验葡语系料理者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for seafood lovers and first-timers exploring Brazilian cuisine—authentic, approachable, and deeply flavorful.

caution: 含鱼类过敏原，油炸略油腻，分量适中

reviews.content: 外皮酥脆不腻，鳕鱼香气十足，咸度恰到好处，一口就爱上巴西味道！
土豆软糯衬托鳕鱼鲜味，配柠檬汁更清爽，是地道又友好的开胃选择。

description.zh: 炼乳、可可粉与黄油慢煮熬制成浓稠糊状，搓圆裹巧克力碎，口感软糯香甜，奶香浓郁带微苦可可风味。
description.en: Made by simmering sweetened condensed milk, cocoa powder, and butter into a thick, glossy paste, then rolled into balls and coated with chocolate sprinkles. Soft, chewy, richly sweet with deep milky-cocoa flavor.

recommendation.zh: 甜食爱好者与巧克力控必试，儿童及聚会宾客尤其喜爱。
recommendation.en: Perfect for chocolate lovers and kids; ideal for festive gatherings or dessert cravings.

caution: 含乳制品，较甜腻，单颗约25克

reviews.content: 外层微脆内里绵密，可可香和奶香平衡绝妙，吃完还想再吃一颗！
传统巴西风味十足，甜度适中不齁，小朋友一口气吃了三颗。

description.zh: 现煮浓缩咖啡豆，加糖熬煮过滤，口感浓烈顺滑，带有焦糖甜香与微苦回甘
description.en: Strong, freshly brewed espresso-style coffee made from dark-roasted beans, sweetened and simmered with sugar, then filtered—bold, smooth, with caramel sweetness and gentle bitterness.

recommendation.zh: 咖啡爱好者或需提神者，适合餐后解腻、社交待客或午后小憩
recommendation.en: Ideal for coffee lovers or anyone needing a quick energy boost after meals or during social gatherings.

caution: 含咖啡因，分量小但浓度高

reviews.content: 香气扑鼻，甜苦平衡绝妙，喝完神清气爽不发酸
传统风味纯正，小杯恰到好处，配巴西烤肉太经典了

description.zh: 以巴西甘蔗酒为基酒，加入青柠块与粗砂糖捣压调制，口感清爽酸甜，带有鲜明的柑橘清香与微醺回甘。
description.en: A classic Brazilian cocktail made with cachaça (sugarcane spirit), fresh lime wedges, and coarse sugar muddled together—refreshing, tangy-sweet, with bright citrus aroma and a clean alcoholic finish.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢果香烈酒、追求夏日清爽感的成年饮客首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for adults who enjoy citrus-forward, refreshing spirits on warm days or as a vibrant aperitif.

good_for: 餐前开胃/社交小酌/独饮放松
caution: 含酒精，未成年人禁饮；含柑橘皮油可能刺激胃部。

reviews.content: 青柠香气扑鼻，酸甜平衡绝妙，喝完神清气爽不腻口！
正宗cachaça带来独特甘蔗香，比伏特加版更有层次感。

description.zh: 新鲜甘蔗现榨而成，未经加热，口感清冽顺滑，风味清甜微带草香与矿物感。
description.en: Fresh sugarcane stalks cold-pressed into juice, unheated and unpasteurized; crisp, silky texture with clean, sweet, grassy-mineral flavor.

recommendation.zh: 适合夏日解渴、运动后补能或喜食天然甜味者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for hot days, post-workout rehydration, or those seeking natural, unrefined sweetness.

caution: 含天然糖分较高，糖尿病患者慎饮

reviews.content: 刚榨出来冰凉清甜，甘蔗香气扑鼻，喝完喉咙特别舒服！
比市售瓶装汁鲜活百倍，微纤维感真实，夏天来一杯太治愈了

description.zh: 精选牛羊肉或猪肉，炭火直烤至外焦里嫩，肉香浓郁带烟熏气息，咸鲜多汁，口感扎实弹牙。
description.en: Grilled over open charcoal fire using premium cuts of beef, lamb, or pork; juicy, tender, smoky, and savory with a satisfying bite.

recommendation.zh: 肉食爱好者与聚会人群首选，追求原汁原味炭火风味者必点。
recommendation.en: Ideal for meat lovers and groups seeking bold, authentic grilled flavors.

caution: 分量较大，含红肉脂肪，部分部位略油腻。

reviews.content: 炭火香气扑鼻，肉质鲜嫩多汁，每一块都烤得恰到好处！
分量实在，搭配蒜蓉酱更提味，适合多人共享的满足感主菜。

description.zh: 鸡胸肉与奶酪为馅，裹面糊油炸而成；外皮酥脆金黄，内馅鲜嫩多汁，咸香微奶香。
description.en: Shredded chicken and cheese filling wrapped in wheat dough, deep-fried until golden. Crispy exterior contrasts with tender, savory, creamy interior.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢酥脆口感和浓郁风味的食客，尤其适合初次尝试巴西街头美食的人。
recommendation.en: Ideal for crispy-food lovers and first-time explorers of Brazilian street food.

caution: 含小麦和乳制品；中等油腻；分量适中不辣。

reviews.content: 外皮酥到掉渣，鸡肉馅料湿润不柴，奶酪拉丝惊艳！
地道巴西风味，热吃最香，配冰啤酒绝配。

description.zh: 鸡胸肉与土豆泥夹心，烘烤制成的酥脆派，外皮香脆内馅嫩滑，融合奶香与咸鲜风味。
description.en: A Brazilian baked pie with shredded chicken and creamy mashed potato filling, encased in a golden, flaky crust—savory, creamy, and comforting.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢浓郁奶香和软硬兼备口感的人，尤其适合家庭聚餐或初次尝试巴西菜的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for comfort-food lovers and first-time Brazilian cuisine explorers seeking hearty, familiar flavors.

caution: 含小麦和牛奶，分量扎实，中等油腻度

reviews.content: 外皮酥到掉渣，内馅鸡肉鲜嫩多汁，奶酪香气十足，完全不腻！
分量实在，土豆泥绵密顺滑，鸡丝入味，适合配一杯冰橙汁享用。

description.zh: 牛肉或奶酪为馅，烤制而成，外皮微酥内馅多汁，咸鲜微酸带奶香。
description.en: Savory baked pastry filled with spiced ground beef or creamy cheese; crisp golden crust, juicy tender filling with tangy, dairy-rich umami notes.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢异国风味、追求便捷美味的上班族和学生党首选。
recommendation.en: Perfect for busy professionals and students craving flavorful, handheld comfort food.

good_for: 独食/街边小吃/快速简餐
caution: 含小麦和奶制品，分量适中不油腻

reviews.content: 外皮酥香不干硬，牛肉馅调味恰到好处，酸甜开胃不腻。
热乎出炉香气扑鼻，奶酪款拉丝绵密，饱腹感强又不负担。

description.zh: 以木薯粉为主料，经干炒或与培根、洋葱等同炒制成，颗粒分明、酥脆干香，带有焦香与咸鲜风味。
description.en: Toasted cassava flour, often sautéed with bacon, onions, and herbs; crispy, nutty, savory, and slightly smoky with a light crunch.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢香脆口感、追求地道巴西风味的食客必点，尤其适合搭配烤肉解腻增香。
recommendation.en: Ideal for lovers of crunchy textures and authentic Brazilian flavors, especially with grilled meats.

caution: 含培根（猪肉），略油腻，分量较小，建议搭配主食食用。

reviews.content: 酥脆焦香，和牛排绝配！木薯粉的天然甜香被培根油脂完美激发。
口感层次丰富，不油不腻，是整餐中提味点睛的巴西灵魂配菜。

description.zh: 以黑豆、五花肉、熏猪耳、香肠等慢炖而成，质地软糯醇厚，风味咸鲜浓郁带微烟熏香。
description.en: A hearty Brazilian stew of black beans slow-cooked with pork belly, smoked pork ears, and linguiça sausage; rich, savory, slightly smoky, and deeply comforting.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜爱浓郁炖菜和传统风味的食客，尤其推荐给肉食爱好者和寒冷天气下寻求暖身主食的人。
recommendation.en: Ideal for meat lovers and those seeking a warming, traditional comfort meal on cool days.

caution: 较油腻，分量大，含猪肉及大豆，辣度低

reviews.content: 黑豆绵密入味，肉香丰腴不腻，地道巴西家常味让人回味无穷。
炖得非常酥烂，配米饭和橙片解腻，层次感丰富又暖心。

description.zh: 以亚马逊雨林特产瓜拉纳果萃取液为基底，碳酸化制成，气泡丰盈，口感清爽微甜，带有独特木质与浆果清香。
description.en: A Brazilian soft drink made from guaraná berry extract, carbonated to create lively bubbles; refreshingly sweet with subtle woody and fruity notes.

recommendation.zh: 适合夏日解渴、运动后补给或喜欢低酒精感风味饮料的年轻人群。
recommendation.en: Ideal for young adults seeking a refreshing, caffeine-containing non-alcoholic drink after exercise or on hot days.

caution: 含咖啡因，儿童及孕妇慎饮；不含常见过敏原。

reviews.content: 气泡细腻持久，瓜拉纳的独特香气让人一秒穿越巴西街头！
比可乐更清新不腻，搭配烤肉解腻效果一流。

description.zh: 以碎牛肉、小麦粉和洋葱为主料，油炸至金黄酥脆，外脆内嫩，咸鲜微香，带有中东风味的巴西街头经典小吃。
description.en: A Brazilian street food made with ground beef, bulgur wheat (or wheat flour), and onions, deep-fried to golden crispness—savory, aromatic, and tender inside with a crunchy exterior.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢酥脆口感和浓郁肉香的食客，适合初次尝试巴西风味的游客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for crispy-texture lovers and first-time explorers of Brazilian street food.

caution: 含小麦，油炸较油腻，分量适中

reviews.content: 外皮酥到掉渣，肉馅多汁不柴，一口就爱上巴西街头烟火气！
香料搭配恰到好处，不抢味，配冰啤酒超解馋。

description.zh: 以新鲜海鱼为主料，用椰奶、棕榈油和香料慢炖而成，口感柔嫩滑润，风味鲜香浓郁带热带果酸与微辛。
description.en: A Brazilian seafood stew featuring fresh white fish, simmered in coconut milk, dendê oil, tomatoes, onions, and cilantro—creamy, fragrant, with bright acidity and gentle heat.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢热带风味、追求地道南美体验的食客首选，适合不排斥鱼腥味且喜爱复合香料者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for adventurous eaters who love aromatic, coconut-infused seafood stews with authentic Brazilian flair.

caution: 含鱼类及甲壳类，中等分量，微辣（辣度2）

reviews.content: 椰奶与棕榈油融合绝妙，鱼肉嫩而不散，酸香层次丰富，一口回到萨尔瓦多！
香料平衡得当，不抢鱼鲜，配米饭吸饱汤汁特别满足。

description.zh: 以木薯粉和帕尔马干酪为主料，烘烤而成；外皮微脆、内里柔韧拉丝，奶香浓郁、咸鲜微酸。
description.en: Made with tapioca flour and Parmesan cheese, baked until golden. Chewy, stretchy interior with crisp exterior; savory, cheesy, tangy, and richly aromatic.

recommendation.zh: 芝士爱好者与无麸质饮食者首选，口感独特，适合初次体验巴西风味的人。
recommendation.en: Ideal for cheese lovers and gluten-free diners seeking an authentic, fun Brazilian snack.

caution: 含乳制品和小麦（部分配方），非纯素，单颗约50g偏小。

reviews.content: 拉丝效果惊艳，奶香纯粹不腻，热吃外脆内弹，地道巴西味道！
无麸质却口感饱满，芝士味足，适合下午茶配咖啡。

description.zh: 以蔗糖、黄油、鸡蛋和面粉为主料烘烤而成，质地松软微润，甜香浓郁，带有焦糖暖香与淡淡奶香。
description.en: A traditional Brazilian dessert made by baking granulated sugar, butter, eggs, and flour; tender, moist, and richly sweet with caramelized warmth and subtle dairy notes.

recommendation.zh: 喜甜食者及下午茶爱好者首选，适合搭配咖啡或红茶享用。
recommendation.en: Ideal for dessert lovers and afternoon tea guests—pairs beautifully with coffee or black tea.

caution: 含高糖分，分量适中；含鸡蛋和小麦。

reviews.content: 糖香自然不腻，蛋糕体湿润绵密，焦糖香气让人回味无穷。
传统巴西风味十足，甜度恰到好处，配咖啡解腻又满足。

description.zh: 酥脆油炸面皮包裹牛肉、奶酪或虾仁等馅料，外酥里嫩，咸鲜微香，略带奶香与肉汁丰盈感

recommendation.zh: 喜欢酥脆口感和浓郁风味的食客，适合初次尝试巴西街头美食的人

reviews.content: 外皮炸得金黄酥脆，内馅多汁不干，奶酪拉丝超满足！
地道巴西风味，一口咬下层次丰富，配冰橙汁绝了

recommendation.zh: 肉食爱好者首选，适合追求原汁原味与优质脂肪香气的食客
recommendation.en: Ideal for meat lovers who crave bold flavor, tenderness, and premium marbling.

caution: 油脂较丰富，分量扎实，含牛肉过敏原

reviews.content: 外皮焦脆内里粉嫩，油脂香而不腻，巴西风味太正宗了！
肉质软嫩多汁，炭火香气十足，配粗盐吃最能体现本味。

description.zh: 以鸡蛋、炼乳和淡奶油为主料，水浴烘烤而成；口感柔滑细腻，焦糖微苦回甘，奶香浓郁甜润。

recommendation.zh: 喜爱经典布丁口感者、奶香爱好者及甜品初尝者首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for dessert lovers, dairy fans, and those new to Brazilian sweets.

reviews.content: 焦糖层恰到好处，布丁嫩如豆腐，入口即化，奶香纯正不腻。

recommendation.zh: 喜欢传统甜点、偏好温和甜味及柔滑口感的食客首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those who love classic, gently sweet, creamy desserts with a silky texture.

good_for: 餐后甜点，适合独食或小份分享

reviews.content: 椰香与蛋香完美融合，入口即化，甜而不腻，地道巴西风味！
质地细腻顺滑，椰丝增添恰到好处的嚼感，甜度适中很讨喜。

recommendation.zh: 适合早餐偏好无麸质、轻食或乳糖不耐者，健康又饱腹。

reviews.content: 外缘微韧有嚼劲，内里柔滑清甜，纯素也超满足！
木薯香很纯粹，不加糖也自带甘味，早餐吃很舒服。

description.zh: 以虾肉、椰奶、面包碎和棕榈油为主料，慢炖成浓稠糊状，口感柔滑绵密，风味鲜香浓郁带微酸与热带辛香。

recommendation.zh: 喜爱浓郁异域风味、偏好海鲜与椰香融合的食客首选。

caution: 含甲壳类过敏原；质地较油腻；辣度低但风味浓烈。

reviews.content: 椰香与虾鲜完美融合，口感丝滑不腻，地道巴西风味让人难忘！
棕榈油香气独特，搭配软糯质地很开胃，适合配米饭慢慢享用。

recommendation.zh: 健康饮食者、健身人群及追求清爽早餐的年轻人首选

caution: 含坚果与牛奶制品，分量较大

reviews.content: 超级饱腹又不腻，巴西莓的微酸和水果清甜完美平衡，早上吃超有活力！
配料丰富有层次，麦片脆度刚好，适合想吃健康又满足感强的早餐族

description.zh: 牛油果泥涂抹烤脆吐司，搭配柠檬汁与海盐，口感绵密顺滑，风味清新微酸、咸鲜平衡。

reviews.content: 牛油果新鲜绵密，吐司酥脆不干硬，柠檬提味恰到好处！
饱腹感强又不腻，搭配咖啡是完美的晨间仪式感。

recommendation.zh: 适合早餐时段需要快速能量补充的上班族或学生，也受甜食爱好者欢迎。

温热时口感最佳，外脆内柔，搭配咖啡堪称经典早餐组合。

description.zh: 水波蛋配英式松饼、加拿大培根与荷兰酱，口感柔滑丰腴，风味咸鲜微酸，奶香浓郁

recommendation.zh: 适合下午提神、社交小聚或初尝英式文化的食客

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢传统英式风味、追求饱腹感与温暖口感的食客，尤其受家庭用餐者欢迎。

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢经典英式甜点、追求温暖饱腹感的食客，尤其受儿童和长辈欢迎。

caution: 含乳制品与鸡蛋；分量较扎实；非低脂低糖选项

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢传统英式风味、追求饱腹感与温暖口感的食客。

caution: 含小麦和牛奶，分量扎实，略油腻

reviews.content: 酥皮层次分明，肉汁丰盈不柴，地道康沃尔风味让人回味无穷。

recommendation.zh: 适合家庭用餐、寒冷天气或需要温暖饱腹感的人群

recommendation.zh: 适合早晨提神、搭配英式早餐或需要温和醒脑的人群。
recommendation.en: Ideal for morning drinkers seeking gentle caffeine lift and classic British tradition.

caution: 含咖啡因；建议避免空腹大量饮用。

reviews.content: 香气纯正，提神不刺激，配烤面包和煎蛋绝配！
茶汤浓而不涩，回甘明显，是每日晨间仪式感的完美起点。

description.zh: 以新鲜草莓、香草奶油和碎蛋白饼为主料，手工轻拌而成；口感绵密柔滑又带酥脆层次，风味清新甜美微酸。
description.en: A classic British dessert made by gently folding fresh strawberries, whipped vanilla cream, and crushed meringue. Creamy, airy, and refreshingly sweet-tart with delicate crunch.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢清爽甜点、不喜厚重奶酪或烘焙感强的食客首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those who love light, fruity desserts without heavy baking or dense textures.

caution: 含鸡蛋和小麦，分量适中偏小

reviews.content: 草莓酸甜多汁，奶油轻盈不腻，蛋白饼碎增添绝妙口感层次！
传统英式风味十足，夏日吃起来特别解腻，适合配红茶。

description.zh: 新鲜鳕鱼裹麦粉面糊油炸，配粗切土豆条，外酥里嫩，咸鲜香脆，蘸塔塔酱更添清爽酸香。
description.en: Beer-battered fresh cod fillet and thick-cut potato chips, deep-fried until golden and crisp. Tender, flaky fish with a savory, salty crunch and creamy tartar sauce.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢经典英式风味、追求饱腹感与满足感的食客首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for comfort-food lovers seeking hearty, nostalgic British fare.

caution: 较油腻；含小麦、鱼、鸡蛋；分量较大。

reviews.content: 鱼肉鲜嫩多汁，外皮酥到掉渣，薯条厚实有嚼劲，经典不踩雷！
分量实在，搭配豌豆泥和醋汁很地道，稍油但幸福感爆棚。

description.zh: 煎蛋、培根、香肠、烤番茄、焗豆、蘑菇与烤面包，油煎烘烤为主，外脆内润，咸鲜浓郁带微烟熏与奶香
description.en: Fried eggs, streaky bacon, pork sausages, grilled tomatoes, baked beans, sautéed mushrooms, and toasted bread—pan-fried and grilled for crispy edges and tender interiors, rich, savory, and smoky with creamy notes.

recommendation.zh: 适合早餐刚需者、体力劳动者或想体验经典英式风味的食客
recommendation.en: Ideal for hungry breakfast lovers, active individuals, or anyone craving authentic British comfort food.

caution: 高脂高热量，含小麦鸡蛋牛奶，分量大易饱

reviews.content: 培根焦香酥脆，焗豆绵密微甜，一口唤醒英伦清晨！
分量实在，香肠多汁不腻，搭配烤番茄解腻恰到好处。

description.zh: 羊肉与土豆层层叠炖，肉质酥烂、土豆软糯，汤汁浓郁咸鲜，带有洋葱与胡萝卜的自然甘甜。
description.en: Slow-cooked lamb shoulder layered with sliced potatoes, onions, and carrots; tender meat, creamy potatoes, rich savory gravy with subtle sweetness.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢传统英式暖胃主食、追求饱腹感与温和风味的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those seeking hearty, comforting British comfort food without spice or complexity.

caution: 分量扎实，含小麦（面糊/肉汁增稠）和牛奶（部分配方用奶汁）

reviews.content: 羊肉酥烂入味，土豆吸饱汤汁，冬日里一口暖到心窝！
传统风味纯正，分量足，适合胃口大的人，但略偏油腻。

description.zh: 冷食拼盘，含切达奶酪、腌洋葱、酸黄瓜、苹果片和粗麦面包，口感丰富，咸鲜微酸，奶香浓郁
description.en: A cold British pub classic: mature cheddar, pickled onions, gherkins, apple slices, and farmhouse bread. Savory, tangy, creamy, and rustic with contrasting textures.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢传统英式风味、追求便捷冷食或乳制品爱好者的主菜选择
recommendation.en: Ideal for cheese lovers and those seeking a hearty, no-cook British meal.

caution: 含乳制品和小麦；分量较足；非热食

reviews.content: 奶酪醇厚，搭配酸洋葱绝了，面包扎实有嚼劲，地道英式满足感！
食材新鲜，冷食清爽不腻，分量实在，适合胃口大的人。

description.zh: 以低筋面粉、黄油、牛奶为主料，烘烤而成；外皮微酥内里松软，奶香浓郁略带甜味。
description.en: Made with all-purpose flour, cold butter, and milk, baked until golden. Tender-crumbed interior with a lightly crisp exterior and rich, buttery sweetness.

recommendation.zh: 适合早餐或下午茶时搭配果酱和凝脂奶油享用的轻食爱好者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for breakfast or afternoon tea lovers seeking a comforting, traditional British treat.

caution: 含小麦和乳制品，分量适中不油腻

reviews.content: 外酥内软，奶香扑鼻，配草莓酱绝了！
温热时口感最佳，湿润不干噎，传统英式风味很正。

description.zh: 以绞羊肉和洋葱、胡萝卜、豌豆为馅，覆以绵密土豆泥烘烤而成，口感软糯丰润，风味咸鲜浓郁带奶香
description.en: Minced lamb cooked with onions, carrots, and peas, topped with creamy mashed potatoes and baked until golden. Rich, savory, and comforting with a tender, creamy texture.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢传统英式暖食、追求饱腹感与温和风味的食客
recommendation.en: Ideal for comfort-food lovers seeking hearty, warming, and family-style British fare.

caution: 含乳制品和小麦；分量扎实，较油腻

reviews.content: 土豆泥绵密香浓，羊肉馅汁水丰盈，暖心暖胃的经典英式味道
分量实在，奶香与肉香平衡得恰到好处，适合冷天享用

description.zh: 嫩牛肉与牛腰切块，慢炖后裹入酥脆黄油酥皮烘烤而成；口感丰润多汁，风味咸鲜浓郁带微香料辛香。
description.en: Tender beef and lamb kidneys slow-cooked in rich gravy, encased in golden buttery shortcrust pastry and baked until crisp. Savory, hearty, and deeply flavorful with subtle warm spices.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜爱传统英式风味、追求饱腹感与醇厚肉香的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for lovers of classic British comfort food seeking rich, satisfying meat flavors.

caution: 较油腻；含小麦、牛奶、鸡蛋；分量扎实。

reviews.content: 酥皮金黄起层，内馅肉质软嫩不腥，酱汁浓稠挂勺，地道英伦风味！
牛腰处理得当毫无膻味，搭配酥皮香气十足，冬日暖身首选。

description.zh: 以枣泥蛋糕为主料蒸烤而成，淋满焦糖太妃酱，口感湿润绵密，风味香甜浓郁带焦糖微苦回甘
description.en: A moist date sponge cake baked and drenched in rich toffee sauce, offering tender texture and deep caramelized sweetness with a hint of bitter balance.

recommendation.zh: 甜品爱好者、寒冷天气下需暖身者、搭配红茶享用更佳
recommendation.en: Ideal for dessert lovers and those seeking comfort food; pairs perfectly with hot tea on chilly days.

caution: 含高糖高热量，含小麦牛奶鸡蛋，分量较足

reviews.content: 太妃酱浓稠香滑，蛋糕湿润不干，冷热皆宜，暖心又治愈
经典英式甜点，甜度适中，配伯爵茶解腻效果一流

description.zh: 烤制的牛肉或羊肉配烤土豆、约克郡布丁和时蔬，外酥里嫩，肉汁丰盈，咸鲜浓郁带淡淡焦香
description.en: Roasted beef or lamb with crispy roast potatoes, Yorkshire pudding, and seasonal vegetables; tender, juicy, and richly savory with caramelized depth.

recommendation.zh: 适合家庭聚餐或想体验英式传统风味的食客，温暖饱足感强
recommendation.en: Ideal for families or travelers seeking authentic British comfort food—hearty, nostalgic, and deeply satisfying.

caution: 分量较大，含小麦和牛奶，中等油腻度

reviews.content: 肉质软嫩多汁，约克郡布丁蓬松香脆，地道英式周日仪式感满分
配菜丰富不单调，酱汁醇厚，适合喜欢扎实口感的食客

description.zh: 以手指饼干、蛋奶酱、鲜奶油和水果 layered 制成，口感绵密柔滑，风味甜润微酸，奶香浓郁
description.en: Layered British dessert made with sponge fingers, custard, whipped cream, and fresh fruit; creamy, smooth, and delicately sweet-tart with rich dairy notes.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢经典英式甜点、追求层次丰富口感的甜品爱好者首选
recommendation.en: Ideal for dessert lovers who enjoy classic, layered, creamy sweets with balanced sweetness.

caution: 含乳制品与鸡蛋；分量较足，易饱腹

reviews.content: 奶油轻盈不腻，果香清新，层层口感交融得恰到好处
传统英式风味正宗，冷藏后口感更佳，适合夏日午后享用

description.zh: 烤制吐司配融化的切达奶酪酱，口感浓滑微咸，奶香浓郁带少许麦芽与芥末辛香。
description.en: Toasted bread topped with a rich, smooth sauce made from melted sharp Cheddar cheese, ale, mustard, and Worcestershire sauce—creamy, savory, and slightly tangy.

recommendation.zh: 芝士爱好者、轻食偏好者及需快速饱腹的上班族首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for cheese lovers and busy professionals seeking a comforting, hearty bite.

caution: 含乳制品和小麦；较油腻；分量适中

reviews.content: 奶酪酱丝滑不腻，麦芽香与微辛完美平衡，热乎出炉太治愈！
吐司酥脆，芝士拉丝感十足，暖胃又满足，适合阴冷天气。

description.zh: 面粉、鸡蛋、牛奶调制面糊，高温烘烤而成；外皮酥脆，内里松软微孔，咸香浓郁带蛋奶香。
description.en: Made from flour, eggs, and milk batter roasted at high heat until puffed and golden. Crispy outside, light and airy inside with rich eggy, savory notes.

recommendation.zh: 喜爱传统英式风味、追求酥脆与松软双重口感的食客必点。
recommendation.en: Ideal for lovers of classic British comfort food and contrasting textures.

caution: 含小麦和鸡蛋；热食最佳，冷后易变韧

reviews.content: 外脆内软，吸饱肉汁后香气四溢，地道英式灵魂配菜！
烘烤火候到位，蓬松有弹性，比普通布丁更香更耐嚼。

description.zh: 以玉米面为主料，经煎或烤制而成，外微酥内软糯，带有天然玉米香与淡淡咸鲜味。
description.en: Made from pre-cooked cornmeal, pan-fried or grilled until golden; tender and slightly chewy inside with a crisp exterior and sweet, earthy corn flavor.

recommendation.zh: 适合素食者、玉米爱好者及追求质朴主食体验的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for vegetarians, corn lovers, and anyone seeking a wholesome, gluten-free staple.

caution: 含玉米（非常见过敏原），分量适中，无辣度

reviews.content: 外皮微脆内里绵软，玉米香气纯正，饱腹又不腻！
传统风味十足，加热后口感更佳，配豆泥绝了。

description.zh: 鸡腿肉与短粒米同炖，加入彩椒、洋葱和藏红花，口感软糯微韧，风味鲜香浓郁带微酸与草本清香
description.en: Tender chicken thighs and short-grain rice braised together with bell peppers, onions, saffron, and sofrito—savory, aromatic, slightly tangy, with a soft yet toothsome texture.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢温和异国风味、追求饱腹感与营养均衡的上班族和家庭食客
recommendation.en: Ideal for busy professionals and families seeking a hearty, flavorful, one-bowl meal with balanced protein and carbs.

caution: 含小麦（酱油），分量充足，微辣（可选配辣椒酱）

reviews.content: 鸡肉酥嫩入味，米饭吸饱汤汁香气扑鼻，藏红花赋予独特金黄与优雅回甘
色彩丰富、营养全面，孩子也爱吃，只是建议少放盐更健康

description.zh: 新鲜海鱼生切，以青柠汁、芒果、红洋葱和彩椒酸腌，口感清爽脆嫩，风味酸甜微辣，充满热带果香与海洋鲜味。
description.en: Fresh raw fish marinated in lime juice with ripe mango, red onion, and bell peppers. Light, crisp texture with bright acidity, tropical sweetness, and subtle heat.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢清爽开胃、追求低脂健康饮食的食客，尤其推荐给夏日聚餐或海鲜爱好者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for health-conscious diners and seafood lovers seeking a light, refreshing starter on warm days.

caution: 含生鱼与贝类，孕妇及免疫力弱者慎食；辣度适中。

reviews.content: 青柠酸香恰到好处，芒果清甜解腻，鱼肉鲜嫩不腥，一口回到加勒比海边！
色彩缤纷，口感层次丰富，酸辣平衡，是夏日最解暑的开胃之选。

description.zh: 黑豆与大米同煮，慢炖至软糯入味，口感绵密醇厚，带有烟熏香肠的咸鲜与微微酸甜风味。
description.en: Cuban-style black beans and rice slow-cooked together with smoked sausage, onions, and spices—creamy, savory, and subtly tangy with a rich, hearty texture.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢浓郁豆香和饱腹主食的食客，尤其推荐给探索加勒比风味的美食爱好者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for bean lovers and those seeking a comforting, culturally rich Caribbean main dish.

caution: 含猪肉及大豆，中等分量，微咸不辣。

reviews.content: 黑豆绵密入味，米饭吸饱汤汁，烟熏香肠提香绝了，地道古巴家常味！
分量实在，酸香平衡得恰到好处，配烤玉米更添加勒比风情。

description.zh: 浓缩咖啡加白砂糖高温打发，口感绵密顺滑，风味浓烈香甜带焦糖苦韵
description.en: Espresso brewed with demerara sugar whipped into a velvety, sweet foam; bold, rich, and caramel-bitter with creamy texture.

recommendation.zh: 适合咖啡爱好者或需要快速提神的人，尤其喜爱浓烈甜香风味者
recommendation.en: Ideal for espresso lovers or anyone needing an intense, energizing caffeine boost.

caution: 含高糖量，糖尿病患者慎饮

reviews.content: 糖霜泡沫绵密如云，咖啡香醇不涩，一口提神醒脑！
传统古巴风味十足，甜度适中，比普通意式浓缩更有层次感

description.zh: 以大蒜、橙汁、柠檬汁和橄榄油为主料冷拌而成，口感清爽酸香，风味明亮开胃，略带微辛与果香回甘
description.en: A vibrant cold sauce made with crushed garlic, fresh orange and lemon juice, cumin, oregano, and extra-virgin olive oil—bright, tangy, aromatic, and lightly pungent.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢酸香开胃口味者、搭配烤肉或海鲜时想提升风味的人必点
recommendation.en: Ideal for those who love bright, citrusy flavors or want to elevate grilled meats and seafood.

caution: 含生蒜，气味较重；含柑橘酸，胃敏感者慎食

reviews.content: 橙香扑鼻，蒜味不过分，蘸烤鸡腿绝了，解腻又提鲜！
自制感十足，比餐厅版更清新，拌凉菜也特别出彩。

description.zh: 烤制的古巴面包夹火腿、烤猪肉、瑞士奶酪、酸黄瓜和黄芥末，外脆内润，咸鲜微酸，层次丰富
description.en: Grilled Cuban bread layered with roasted pork, ham, Swiss cheese, pickles, and yellow mustard; crispy exterior, tender interior, savory-sour balance with rich umami.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢咸香浓郁风味、追求经典美式三明治体验的食客首选
recommendation.en: Ideal for sandwich lovers seeking bold, savory, and nostalgic flavors in a hearty meal.

caution: 含小麦、牛奶、猪肉；分量扎实，较油腻

reviews.content: 烤得恰到好处，奶酪拉丝，酸黄瓜解腻，经典古巴风味还原度高
分量实在，肉香浓郁，芥末微辛提味，适合胃口好的人

description.zh: 酥脆面皮包裹牛肉、洋葱与青椒，油炸或烘烤而成，外酥里嫩，咸鲜微辣带香料风味。
description.en: Crispy pastry pockets filled with seasoned ground beef, onions, and bell peppers, fried or baked—savory, slightly spicy, with warm Caribbean spices and tender-crisp texture.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢街头风味和便携小吃的食客，适合初次尝试加勒比美食的人。
recommendation.en: Great for street food lovers and first-time Caribbean cuisine explorers seeking bold, handheld flavor.

caution: 含小麦和牛肉，中等油腻，分量适中，微辣（辣度2）

reviews.content: 外皮酥得掉渣，内馅多汁入味，香料层次丰富不抢戏！
热乎出炉时最惊艳，肉汁饱满，配芒果莎莎解腻刚刚好。

description.zh: 以鸡蛋、牛奶和焦糖为主料，水浴慢烤而成；口感滑嫩如丝，甜润微苦，奶香浓郁带焦糖微脆。
description.en: Made with eggs, milk, and caramel, baked gently in a water bath. Silky-smooth texture with rich dairy sweetness and a subtle bitter-caramel finish.

recommendation.zh: 甜品爱好者与奶香控首选，适合追求经典顺滑口感的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for dessert lovers and dairy enthusiasts who crave creamy, comforting sweetness.

caution: 含乳制品与鸡蛋；分量适中，甜度较高

reviews.content: 焦糖层脆而不苦，布丁体细腻到入口即化，奶香纯正不腻人。
水浴烘烤火候精准，质地均匀柔滑，甜度平衡，老少皆宜。

description.zh: 新鲜海鱼裹薄面糊油炸，外皮金黄酥脆，鱼肉鲜嫩多汁，带有海盐清香与淡淡柑橘或香料余味。
description.en: Fresh whole or filleted fish coated in light batter and deep-fried until golden and crisp; tender, flaky interior with briny sweetness and subtle citrus or allspice notes.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢海鲜、追求酥脆口感的食客，也推荐给初次尝试加勒比风味的人。
recommendation.en: Ideal for seafood lovers and first-timers exploring Caribbean flavors—crispy, approachable, and authentically coastal.

caution: 含鱼类过敏原；油炸较油腻；分量适中偏大。
ingredients: 海鱼（如红鲷、石斑或鲯鳅）

reviews.content: 鱼皮酥到掉渣，鱼肉却湿润不柴，青柠提味太绝了！
地道加勒比风味，香料不过重，配米饭或芭蕉片都很搭。

description.zh: 熟透香蕉切片油炸，外酥里糯，香甜浓郁带焦糖风味。
description.en: Ripe plantains sliced and deep-fried until golden; crispy outside, tender and sweet inside with caramelized notes.

recommendation.zh: 喜甜食者、素食者及想尝试加勒比风味的食客首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for dessert lovers, vegetarians, and anyone exploring Caribbean flavors.

caution: 含油脂较多，分量适中，无辣度。

reviews.content: 香蕉焦糖香扑鼻，外脆内绵，配烤肉绝了！
甜度恰到好处，不腻不齁，孩子也抢着吃。

description.zh: 鸡腿肉经牙买加香料腌制，炭火慢烤，外皮微焦酥脆，内里多汁嫩滑，烟熏香浓烈，辣中带甜酸果香。
description.en: Chicken thighs marinated in Jamaican jerk spice blend, slow-grilled over pimento wood charcoal; tender, juicy, with smoky, spicy-sweet heat and tangy allspice notes.

recommendation.zh: 嗜辣者与喜欢异域烟熏风味的人必试，适合追求强烈味觉体验的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers and adventurous eaters seeking bold, authentic Caribbean flavor.

caution: 辣度高（3-4级），含辣椒和大蒜，分量足，建议配饮解辣。

reviews.content: 烟熏香气扑鼻，辣得过瘾却不燥口，鸡肉嫩到一咬脱骨！
香料层次丰富，甜辣平衡恰到好处，配米饭或芭蕉片都绝配。

description.zh: 整只乳猪经香料腌制后慢火烤制，外皮酥脆金黄，肉质细嫩多汁，咸鲜微香，带有炭火烟熏风味。
description.en: Whole suckling pig marinated in aromatic spices and slow-roasted over charcoal until the skin is crackling-crisp and the meat is tender, juicy, and savory with smoky depth.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢酥脆口感和传统炭火风味的食客，适合聚会分享或庆祝场合。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those who love crispy skin and authentic celebratory flavors—perfect for group gatherings.

caution: 分量较大，含较多脂肪，外皮较油腻。

reviews.content: 外皮酥到掉渣，肉嫩不柴，香料平衡得恰到好处，地道古巴风味！
炭火香气十足，配米饭解腻，适合多人一起分享享受。

description.zh: 以青香蕉为主料，油炸后捣成泥状，加入蒜香橄榄油和培根碎，口感软糯扎实，风味咸鲜浓郁带蒜香
description.en: Made from fried green plantains mashed with garlic-infused olive oil and crispy pork cracklings; soft, dense, savory, and deeply aromatic.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢浓郁碳水与蒜香风味的食客，尤其适合搭配烤肉或海鲜主菜
recommendation.en: Ideal for carb lovers and fans of bold garlic-umami flavors, especially with grilled meats or seafood.

caution: 含小麦（面包糠）和猪肉，略油腻，分量扎实

reviews.content: 蒜香扑鼻，外酥里糯，和烤鸡腿绝配，一口就停不下来
传统波多黎各风味很正，虽稍油腻但层次丰富，配朗姆酒超赞

description.zh: 白朗姆酒、新鲜薄荷叶与青柠汁捣拌后加苏打水调制，口感清爽微气泡，风味清新酸甜带草本清香
description.en: A refreshing Caribbean cocktail made by muddling fresh mint leaves and lime juice with white rum, then topped with soda water—crisp, effervescent, and herbaceous with bright citrus acidity.

recommendation.zh: 适合夏日消暑或餐前开胃者，喜欢清爽低酒精饮品的人群
recommendation.en: Ideal for those seeking a light, refreshing, low-alcohol drink to cool down or stimulate appetite before a meal.

caution: 含酒精，未成年人禁饮；含柠檬酸可能刺激胃部

reviews.content: 薄荷香气扑鼻，青柠酸度恰到好处，喝完神清气爽不腻口
气泡感十足，解渴效果一流，是炎炎夏日的完美救星

description.zh: 整块猪肩肉经香料腌制后慢烤数小时，外皮酥脆焦香，内里软嫩多汁，咸香浓郁带微微蒜香与柑橘清香
description.en: Slow-roasted whole pork shoulder marinated in garlic, citrus, and Caribbean spices; crispy skin, tender juicy meat with savory, aromatic, slightly tangy flavor.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢大口吃肉、追求丰盛口感的食客，尤其适合聚会分享或节日聚餐
recommendation.en: Ideal for meat lovers and groups seeking a hearty, celebratory centerpiece dish.

caution: 分量较大，含较多脂肪，对高脂饮食者需适量

reviews.content: 外皮咔嚓酥脆，肉质软烂入味，香料层次丰富不腻，地道波多黎各风味！
分量实在，蒜香和柑橘香平衡得恰到好处，配米饭或烤根茎蔬菜绝配

description.zh: 以绞牛肉为主料，慢炒至干香，加入洋葱、彩椒、葡萄干和肉桂，口感软嫩微糯，风味咸鲜带酸甜与温暖辛香。
description.en: Ground beef sautéed with onions, bell peppers, raisins, and cinnamon until tender and fragrant; savory-sweet with warm spice notes and a soft, slightly moist texture.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢温和异国风味、不嗜辣又爱复合香气的食客首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those who enjoy aromatic, mildly spiced comfort food without heat or heaviness.

caution: 含小麦（酱油）、大豆（酱油），中等分量，微甜不辣。

reviews.content: 葡萄干与肉桂的搭配太惊艳，牛肉嫩而不柴，下饭一流！
香气层次丰富，酸甜平衡得恰到好处，孩子也爱吃。

description.zh: 新鲜菠萝汁、椰奶与朗姆酒冷摇而成，口感绵密顺滑，风味甜润清爽，带有热带果香与淡淡椰香。
description.en: Blended cold with fresh pineapple juice, coconut cream, and white rum; creamy, smooth texture with sweet-tropical, refreshing flavor.

recommendation.zh: 喜爱果味鸡尾酒或初次尝试热带饮品的顾客首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for fruit-cocktail lovers or first-time tropical drink explorers.

good_for: 餐后饮品/休闲小酌/夏日解暑
caution: 含酒精；含牛奶与坚果（椰子属树坚果）

reviews.content: 椰香浓郁不腻，菠萝酸甜平衡得恰到好处，喝完满口热带风情！
冰沙质地细腻，酒精感柔和，女生聚会点单率超高。

description.zh: 大米与黑豆/红腰豆慢炖而成，口感软糯绵密，咸鲜微香，带有淡淡的烟熏与香料风味。
description.en: Steamed rice served with slow-simmered black or red beans, tender and creamy in texture, seasoned with onions, garlic, cumin, and a hint of smokiness.

recommendation.zh: 素食者、健身人群及追求高蛋白均衡饮食者首选，饱腹感强且营养扎实。
recommendation.en: Ideal for vegetarians, fitness enthusiasts, and anyone seeking affordable, protein-rich, filling comfort food.

caution: 含大豆；分量扎实，易饱；辣度可选，基础版微辣。

reviews.content: 豆子炖得酥烂入味，米饭吸饱汤汁，咸香恰到好处，暖心又管饱！
传统加勒比风味十足，豆香浓郁不腻，素食者吃着特别满足。

description.zh: 以牛腱肉为主料慢炖撕成细丝，配彩椒洋葱番茄烩制，口感软嫩多汁，风味咸鲜微酸、层次丰富。
description.en: Shredded flank steak slow-braised with bell peppers, onions, and tomatoes until tender and juicy; savory, slightly tangy, deeply aromatic Caribbean comfort dish.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢软嫩肉食、追求浓郁家常风味的食客，尤其推荐给初次尝试古巴菜的人。
recommendation.en: Ideal for meat lovers seeking comforting, flavorful dishes and first-time Cuban cuisine explorers.

caution: 含小麦（酱油），中等分量，微辣（可选调整）

reviews.content: 牛肉酥软入味，番茄酸甜恰到好处，配米饭绝了！
酱汁浓郁下饭，彩椒保留清脆感，整体平衡不腻。

description.zh: 玉米面团包裹炖煮鸡腿肉与彩椒洋葱，蒸制而成，口感软糯微韧，风味鲜香微辣带热带甜香
description.en: Steamed masa dough filled with slow-cooked chicken thighs, bell peppers, and onions; soft, slightly chewy texture with savory, mildly spicy, and subtly sweet tropical notes.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢异域风味、追求饱腹感的食客，尤其适合想尝试加勒比主食文化的顾客
recommendation.en: Ideal for adventurous eaters seeking hearty, culturally rich Caribbean comfort food.

caution: 含小麦和鸡蛋；中等分量；微辣（辣度2）

reviews.content: 鸡肉酥烂入味，玉米糕体湿润不干，椰香与彩椒清甜平衡绝妙！
分量实在，蒸得恰到好处，微辣很友好，配芒果莎莎更显热带风情。

description.zh: 以青芭蕉为主料，切片油炸后压扁再复炸，外皮酥脆金黄，内里微韧带清香，咸鲜微甜。
description.en: Made from green plantains, sliced, fried, flattened, and double-fried until golden and crisp. Crispy outside, slightly chewy inside, with mild sweetness and savory notes.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢香脆口感、追求地道加勒比风味的食客，素食者亦可安心享用。
recommendation.en: Ideal for crispy-snack lovers and vegetarians seeking authentic Caribbean flavor.

caution: 含油脂较高，分量适中，无辣度，不含常见过敏原。

reviews.content: 外酥里韧，芭蕉清香不腻，蘸酱更添风味，完美配烤肉！
复炸火候到位，金黄饱满，比普通薯片更有层次感。

description.zh: 发酵面皮包裹猪肉或蔬菜馅，蒸制而成，外皮松软微弹，内馅多汁鲜香，咸鲜中带微甜。
description.en: Steamed buns made from leavened wheat dough filled with savory pork or vegetable filling; soft, slightly springy exterior with juicy, umami-rich, subtly sweet interior.

recommendation.zh: 适合早餐空腹食用者、学生及上班族，饱腹暖胃，能量充足。
recommendation.en: Ideal for breakfast eaters, students, and office workers seeking warm, filling, and comforting energy.

caution: 含小麦；分量适中，馅料略油润。

reviews.content: 皮薄馅大，咬一口汤汁四溢，肉香十足，热乎乎的特别治愈。
面皮松软不粘牙，馅料调味恰到好处，连吃两个也不腻。

description.zh: 鲜嫩牛肉与宽扁河粉大火干炒，镬气十足，口感滑韧微焦，咸鲜带焦香。
description.en: Stir-fried wide rice noodles with tender beef over high heat, delivering smoky wok hei, savory umami flavor, and a satisfyingly slippery-yet-slightly-crisp texture.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢镬气重、主食饱腹感强的食客首选，适合工作日快速午餐。
recommendation.en: Ideal for diners craving bold wok hei and hearty comfort—perfect for a filling lunch.

caution: 含小麦和大豆，分量足，中等油润度

reviews.content: 牛肉嫩滑不柴，河粉吸饱酱汁又保持筋道，镬气扑鼻，地道广式风味！
分量实在，豆芽爽脆提味，唯一建议可略减油更健康。

description.zh: 炖煮数小时的牛腱肉与碱水面，汤头醇厚鲜香，面条筋道滑弹，肉质软嫩入味。
description.en: Slow-braised beef shank and alkaline wheat noodles in a rich, aromatic broth; tender meat, springy noodles, savory umami depth.

recommendation.zh: 适合上班族、学生及需要温补体力者，暖胃饱腹又营养均衡。
recommendation.en: Ideal for office workers, students, or anyone needing warming, nourishing comfort food.

caution: 含小麦和牛肉；汤稍油腻，分量足

reviews.content: 汤头清澈却滋味厚重，牛肉酥而不柴，面条吸饱汤汁太满足了！
分量实在，冬天来一碗全身都暖起来，汤底回甘很舒服。

description.zh: 皮蛋与瘦肉熬煮的绵滑白粥，口感柔润顺滑，咸鲜微香，略带皮蛋特有的醇厚回甘。
description.en: Silky rice porridge slow-simmered with century egg and tender lean pork, offering a smooth texture and savory, umami-rich flavor with subtle earthy depth.

recommendation.zh: 肠胃较弱者、晨起食欲清淡者及喜爱传统广式早茶风味的人首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those with sensitive stomachs or craving comforting, traditional Cantonese breakfast comfort food.

caution: 含鸡蛋（皮蛋）、大豆（酱油调味），分量适中不油腻

reviews.content: 皮蛋香气恰到好处，瘦肉嫩而不柴，粥体绵密暖心，清晨喝一碗超满足！
老广味道正宗，温润不腻，感冒时喝特别舒服，姜丝提味很到位。

description.zh: 精选猪梅头肉或五花肉，以秘制酱料腌制后炭火烤制，外皮微焦酥香，内里软嫩多汁，咸中带甜、蜜香浓郁。
description.en: Made with premium pork shoulder or belly, marinated in a signature sweet-savory sauce and roasted over charcoal until caramelized and tender—juicy, fragrant, and perfectly balanced between salty and sweet.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢经典广式风味、追求肉质嫩滑与复合甜咸口感的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for lovers of Cantonese classics who crave tender, flavorful, sweet-savory roasted pork.

caution: 含糖量较高，略油腻，分量适中

reviews.content: 蜜汁光泽诱人，瘦肉不柴，肥肉入口即化，广式灵魂味道！
酱香醇厚，甜度恰到好处，配白饭三碗都不够吃。

description.zh: 叉烧肉馅配甜面酱，包裹于松软奶香白面皮中，蒸制而成；外皮绵软微弹，内馅咸甜多汁，鲜香浓郁。
description.en: Steamed buns with tender, sweet-savory char siu (barbecued pork) filling in a soft, slightly chewy milk-enriched dough. Juicy, aromatic, and delicately sweet.

recommendation.zh: 适合初次尝试粤式点心者及喜欢咸甜口味的食客，老少皆宜。
recommendation.en: Ideal for dim sum newcomers and those who enjoy savory-sweet flavors—family-friendly and approachable.

caution: 含小麦和鸡蛋，分量适中，微甜不辣。

reviews.content: 叉烧汁水丰盈，面皮蓬松不腻，热食时香气扑鼻，地道广式风味！
甜度恰到好处，孩子一口气吃了两个，冷吃也柔软不干硬。

description.zh: 米浆蒸制而成的薄滑肠粉，包裹鲜虾、牛肉或叉烧，口感柔滑弹牙，咸鲜微甜，淋上香浓酱油汁。
description.en: Steamed rice noodle roll filled with shrimp, beef, or barbecued pork; tender, silky, and springy texture with savory-sweet soy-based sauce.

recommendation.zh: 适合口味清淡者、老人儿童及初次尝试广式点心的人，易消化且风味温和。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those preferring mild flavors, seniors, children, or first-time dim sum eaters—light and digestible.

caution: 含小麦（米粉含少量淀粉改良剂）、酱油含麸质；分量适中，不油腻。

reviews.content: 肠粉皮薄如纸却韧而不破，虾仁鲜甜弹牙，酱汁咸香恰到好处！
米香清雅，入口即化又带嚼劲，搭配温热茶饮特别舒服。

description.zh: 猪肉与白菜为馅，水煮而成，皮薄滑弹、馅多汁鲜，咸鲜微甜，清香不腻。
description.en: Dumplings filled with minced pork and napa cabbage, boiled until tender. Silky wrapper, juicy savory-sweet filling with subtle freshness.

recommendation.zh: 适合全家老少，尤其喜爱传统家常风味与软嫩口感的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for families and anyone craving comforting, tender, homestyle Chinese dumplings.

caution: 含小麦和猪肉；分量适中，非辣味。

reviews.content: 皮薄透亮不破，咬一口汤汁四溢，肉馅鲜嫩不柴，家的味道！
个头均匀，蘸醋吃更提鲜，老人孩子都爱吃，饱腹感强。

description.zh: 卤制茶叶蛋以鸡蛋为主料，经酱油、茶叶、香料长时间煨煮，蛋白呈琥珀色虎纹，口感紧实弹嫩，滋味咸鲜微甜，茶香馥郁回甘。
description.en: Hard-boiled eggs simmered for hours in a fragrant broth of black tea, soy sauce, star anise, and rock sugar, yielding marbled brown shells, tender-firm texture, and savory-sweet umami with subtle tea aroma.

recommendation.zh: 适合上班族、学生党及素食者（蛋素）作为便捷高蛋白小食或加餐。
recommendation.en: Perfect for busy professionals, students, or ovo-vegetarians seeking a portable, protein-rich snack or energy boost.

caution: 含鸡蛋；钠含量较高；冷热皆宜但冷藏后风味更佳。

reviews.content: 茶香入味透彻，蛋白Q弹不柴，蛋黄沙绵微油，越嚼越香！
卤汁层次丰富，冷吃更显茶韵，是记忆里的老味道。

description.zh: 鸡丁、豆芽、青椒等杂蔬快炒，口感脆嫩爽口，咸鲜微甜，锅气十足。
description.en: Stir-fried chicken, bean sprouts, bell peppers and assorted vegetables in a light savory-sweet sauce; crisp-tender texture with bold wok hei aroma.

recommendation.zh: 适合初次尝试中式快餐者或偏好清淡快炒的人群。
recommendation.en: Great for first-time Chinese food explorers or those who prefer mild, vegetable-forward dishes.

good_for: 主菜，适合独食或两人分享
caution: 含小麦（酱油）、大豆（酱料），分量适中

reviews.content: 蔬菜新鲜脆嫩，鸡肉滑而不柴，酱汁恰到好处不腻口。
家常味十足，下饭一流，适合工作日快速解决一餐。

description.zh: 以碱水面为主料，快火爆炒而成，口感爽滑弹牙，咸鲜微香，略带锅气。
description.en: Stir-fried alkaline wheat noodles with vegetables and often meat or tofu, cooked quickly over high heat for a springy, savory, aromatic dish with wok hei.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢经典中式快餐、追求饱腹感与镬气风味的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those craving a hearty, flavorful, and satisfying Chinese noodle dish with authentic wok-fired taste.

caution: 含小麦和可能鸡蛋；中等油量；分量扎实。

reviews.content: 锅气十足，面条筋道不软烂，蔬菜清脆保留原味。
分量实在，咸淡适中，是解馋又管饱的经典选择。

description.zh: 腊肠、鸡肉或牛肉与米饭同煲，锅底焦香微脆，上层软糯油润，咸鲜带脂香，热气腾腾香气扑鼻。
description.en: Rice cooked in a claypot with Chinese sausage, chicken or beef; crispy golden rice crust at the bottom, tender fragrant top layer, savory and rich with aromatic oil infusion.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢热食、追求锅气和焦香口感的食客，尤其秋冬暖身首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those who love hot, aromatic dishes with textural contrast—perfect for cold days.

caution: 分量足，含油脂较多；含小麦（酱油）、大豆（豉油）

reviews.content: 锅巴金黄酥脆，腊味香气直冲鼻腔，米饭吸饱肉汁，每一口都满足！
分量实在，热乎上桌时滋滋作响，腊肠油润不腻，配烫青菜绝了。

description.zh: 优质大米经长时间文火慢熬而成，米粒化为绵密顺滑的粥体，口感温润软糯，味道清鲜微甘，凸显食材本味。
description.en: Slow-simmered for hours with premium rice until creamy and silky, Cantonese congee has a delicate, comforting texture and subtle umami-sweet flavor.

recommendation.zh: 肠胃敏感者、老人儿童及病后调养人群的理想选择，温和易消化。
recommendation.en: Ideal for sensitive stomachs, elders, children, and post-illness recovery—gentle, nourishing, and easily digestible.

caution: 分量适中，无辣度，不含常见过敏原（基础款）

reviews.content: 米香浓郁，入口即化，喝完胃里暖暖的，特别适合清晨或感冒时。
质地细腻不糊口，咸淡恰到好处，配油条一绝！

description.zh: 碱水面配肉末、芽菜、花椒油与红油，麻辣鲜香，面条劲道，酱汁浓稠裹面。
description.en: Alkaline wheat noodles tossed with spicy Sichuan chili oil, minced pork, preserved mustard greens, and aromatic Sichuan peppercorns—bold, numbing heat with savory depth and chewy texture.

recommendation.zh: 嗜辣者与川菜爱好者必点，追求层次丰富、开胃过瘾的主食体验。
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers and Sichuan cuisine fans seeking a bold, flavorful, satisfying main dish.

caution: 辣度高，含小麦、大豆、芝麻，分量适中偏小。

reviews.content: 麻辣鲜香层层递进，芽菜脆爽提味，面条劲道不坨，一口上头！
花椒麻香够足，红油香而不腻，微醋提亮，适合重口味但怕太干的人。

description.zh: 以鸡蛋、淡奶和砂糖为馅，酥皮烘烤而成；外皮酥脆，内馅滑嫩香甜，奶香浓郁。
description.en: A classic Chinese dessert with a flaky pastry shell filled with a smooth, sweet custard made from eggs, evaporated milk, and sugar, baked until golden and fragrant.

recommendation.zh: 甜品爱好者与下午茶人群首选，儿童与长辈皆宜，温和不刺激。
recommendation.en: Ideal for dessert lovers, children, and elders—mild, comforting, and universally appealing.

caution: 含鸡蛋和小麦，略高糖高脂，单份约180千卡。
allergens: 坚果（部分配方含杏仁粉）

reviews.content: 蛋香浓郁，酥皮层次分明，冷藏后口感更绵密，一口回到童年。
甜度适中不腻，蛋羹细腻无气孔，热食时奶香扑鼻，非常治愈。

description.zh: 鸡腿肉经黄酒、香料卤制后冰镇，肉质细嫩弹牙，酒香清冽，咸鲜微甜，口感清爽不腻。
description.en: Poached chicken thighs marinated in Shaoxing wine and aromatic spices, then chilled—tender, springy texture with clean, fragrant wine aroma and balanced savory-sweet notes.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜食冷盘、追求清爽口感或初次尝试中式凉菜的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for cold-appetizer lovers or first-time diners exploring Chinese chilled dishes.

caution: 含酒精（微量残留），对酒敏感者慎食；含大豆（酱油）、小麦（料酒）。

reviews.content: 酒香沁人不冲，鸡肉滑嫩入味，夏日开胃首选！
黄酒风味柔和，冰镇后口感特别清爽，配粥绝了。

description.zh: 以鸡蛋液入沸清汤搅成蛋花，配葱花提香；口感滑嫩清爽，风味咸鲜微香。
description.en: Light broth simmered with beaten eggs swirled in to form tender ribbons, finished with scallions. Silky, delicate, and subtly savory.

recommendation.zh: 适合肠胃敏感、老人儿童及清淡饮食者，暖胃易消化。
recommendation.en: Ideal for sensitive stomachs, elders, children, or anyone seeking light, soothing comfort food.

caution: 含鸡蛋；分量较小；无辣度；低脂不油腻。

reviews.content: 蛋花细腻均匀，汤头清亮不腻，喝一口就暖到胃里。
做法简单却极见功夫，蛋花蓬松柔滑，是家常温暖的代表。

description.zh: 米饭与鸡蛋为主料，旺火快炒而成；粒粒分明、干香弹牙，咸鲜中带蛋香，锅气十足。
description.en: Fragrant steamed rice and eggs stir-fried over high heat until fluffy and separate, with savory umami, rich egg aroma, and a satisfying springy texture.

recommendation.zh: 适合忙碌上班族、学生党或口味清淡者，快速饱腹又不失风味。
recommendation.en: Ideal for busy professionals or students seeking a quick, comforting, and balanced meal.

caution: 含鸡蛋和小麦（酱油），分量适中，不辣。

reviews.content: 锅气足，米饭颗颗分明，蛋香扑鼻，吃一口就想起家的味道。
简单却不寡淡，咸淡刚好，配碗汤就是完美工作午餐。

description.zh: 酥脆蛋挞皮包裹香滑奶黄馅，烘烤而成，外酥内嫩，奶香浓郁、甜而不腻。
description.en: A flaky, buttery pastry shell filled with smooth, creamy custard, baked until golden—rich in dairy flavor, sweet and velvety with a crisp exterior and tender interior.

recommendation.zh: 甜品爱好者、下午茶人群及喜欢温和甜味的食客首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for dessert lovers and afternoon tea guests who enjoy mild, comforting sweetness.

caution: 含鸡蛋和牛奶，略油腻，单份分量适中。

reviews.content: 蛋挞皮酥到掉渣，内馅温润香浓，奶香纯正不齁甜。
外皮层次分明，内馅细腻顺滑，冷藏后口感更显柔润。

description.zh: 牛杂（牛舌、牛心、牛肚）卤制后切片，拌以红油、花椒油、芝麻酱等，麻辣鲜香，脆嫩爽口。
description.en: Sliced braised beef offal (tongue, heart, tripe) tossed in spicy chili oil, Sichuan pepper oil, and sesame paste—bold, numbing, savory, and texturally vibrant.

recommendation.zh: 嗜辣者与川菜爱好者必点，适合喜欢浓郁风味和丰富口感的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers and Sichuan cuisine fans seeking bold, complex flavors and contrasting textures.

caution: 辣度高，含花生、芝麻、大豆，分量适中偏少。

reviews.content: 麻辣过瘾，牛杂脆嫩不腻，红油香而不燥，回味悠长！
传统味道正宗，花椒麻香突出，配米饭或啤酒都绝配。

description.zh: 以鲜虾为主料，蒸制而成的广式经典点心；晶莹剔透的澄面皮包裹整只虾仁，口感爽脆弹牙，鲜甜清雅。
description.en: Cantonese dim sum made with whole fresh shrimp wrapped in translucent wheat starch dough and steamed; tender-crisp texture with delicate sweetness and clean ocean freshness.

recommendation.zh: 适合追求原汁原味、喜爱清爽口感及海鲜风味的食客，尤其受儿童与长辈欢迎。
recommendation.en: Ideal for seafood lovers and those preferring light, delicate flavors—great for kids and seniors.

caution: 含甲壳类过敏原，分量小巧，不油腻无辣度。

reviews.content: 虾肉饱满Q弹，皮薄透亮不粘牙，一口咬下鲜汁四溢，地道广式风味！
澄面皮软滑有韧性，虾仁新鲜无腥味，清淡不腻，配普洱茶绝配。

description.zh: 以豆腐、木耳、香菇、笋丝为主料，水淀粉勾芡炖煮，口感滑润微稠，酸辣鲜香，层次丰富。
description.en: A classic Chinese soup made with silken tofu, wood ear mushrooms, shiitake, and bamboo shoots, thickened with cornstarch; tangy, spicy, savory, and velvety-smooth.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢开胃暖身、追求风味层次的食客，尤其适合秋冬或食欲不振时食用。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those seeking a warming, appetite-stimulating starter—great in cold weather or when feeling sluggish.

caution: 辣度中等偏上，含小麦（酱油/醋）、大豆（豆腐）、鸡蛋（蛋花）

reviews.content: 酸辣平衡绝妙，胡椒辛香提神，喝完浑身暖洋洋，开胃效果一流！
蛋花细腻，汤体浓淡适中，比普通餐厅更清爽不腻，适合怕太辣的人。

description.zh: 绿豆面糊摊烙成薄饼，夹油条或薄脆，刷甜面酱、腐乳汁，撒葱花香菜，外酥里软，咸鲜微甜带酱香。
description.en: Thin crepe made from mung bean batter, cooked on a griddle, filled with crispy fried dough stick (youtiao), hoisin sauce, fermented soybean paste, scallions and cilantro—crispy outside, soft inside, savory-sweet and aromatic.

recommendation.zh: 早餐党、学生和上班族适合，快速饱腹又充满烟火气的地道中式街头风味。
recommendation.en: Perfect for breakfast lovers, students, and busy workers seeking a hearty, authentic street-food start to the day.

caution: 含小麦、鸡蛋、芝麻；油条较油腻；辣度可选。

reviews.content: 薄脆咔嚓响，酱料层次丰富，葱香扑鼻，一口回到天津老街！
鸡蛋摊得均匀，面饼柔韧不硬，酱料咸淡刚好，饱腹感强。

description.zh: 猪肉与白菜为主料，水煮或煎制而成，外皮柔韧微弹、内馅多汁鲜香，咸鲜中带清甜。
description.en: Dumplings filled with minced pork and napa cabbage, boiled or pan-fried. Tender chewy wrapper encases juicy, savory-sweet, umami-rich filling.

recommendation.zh: 适合家庭聚餐、初尝中式面食者及喜爱手工主食的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for families, dumpling newcomers, and those who appreciate handmade comfort food.

caution: 含小麦和猪肉；煎制款略油腻；分量扎实。

reviews.content: 皮薄馅大，咬一口汤汁四溢，家的味道太治愈了！
煎饺底部金黄酥脆，搭配醋蒜汁绝了，下饭一流。

description.zh: 鸡丁、花生、干辣椒爆炒而成，口感嫩滑微脆，风味咸鲜微辣带酸甜，香气浓郁
description.en: Succulent diced chicken stir-fried with roasted peanuts, dried chilies, and Sichuan peppercorns; savory, slightly spicy, tangy-sweet, with tender-crisp texture and bold aroma.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢川菜麻辣风味或想尝试经典下饭菜的食客首选
recommendation.en: Ideal for lovers of bold Sichuan flavors or those seeking an authentic, satisfying main dish.

caution: 中辣，含花生，分量适中

reviews.content: 鸡肉嫩而不柴，花生香脆，辣度刚好，酸甜平衡得恰到好处！
传统宫保味很正，酱汁裹得均匀，下饭一流，就是花生略少了一点。

description.zh: 鲜嫩虾仁快炒，配花生、干辣椒与葱段，口感脆嫩兼备，风味咸鲜微辣带酸甜。
description.en: Succulent shrimp stir-fried with roasted peanuts, dried chilies, scallions, and a balanced savory-sweet-spicy sauce.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢微辣开胃、追求口感层次的食客，尤其推荐给海鲜爱好者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for seafood lovers who enjoy bold, balanced heat and textural contrast.

caution: 含花生与虾，辣度中等，慎选过敏者及忌辣人群。

reviews.content: 虾仁Q弹入味，花生香脆，酱汁酸甜微辣恰到好处，下饭一绝！
比传统宫保更清爽不腻，虾仁新鲜无腥味，辣度友好适合大众。

description.zh: 新鲜羊肉切块腌制后炭火烤制，外焦里嫩，香气浓郁，咸鲜微辣，带有明显烟熏风味。
description.en: Cubed marinated lamb grilled over charcoal until charred outside and tender inside, delivering rich aroma, savory-salty flavor with mild heat and smoky notes.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢烧烤、追求地道街头风味的食客首选，肉食爱好者不可错过。
recommendation.en: Ideal for barbecue lovers and meat enthusiasts seeking authentic street-food experience.

caution: 中等油腻，含小麦（腌料），辣度可选，分量适中

reviews.content: 羊肉鲜嫩多汁，孜然和炭火香完美融合，一口回到新疆夜市！
辣度刚好，肉质不柴，配冰啤绝了，是解馋又过瘾的街头经典。

description.zh: 以大米或面粉制成的凉皮为主料，蒸制后冰镇切条，配黄瓜丝、面筋、蒜水、醋、辣椒油等拌食，口感爽滑筋道，酸辣开胃，清爽解暑。
description.en: Made from rice or wheat flour, steamed into thin sheets, chilled and cut into ribbons, then tossed with cucumber shreds, gluten, garlic water, vinegar, and chili oil. Refreshing, chewy, tangy, and spicy.

recommendation.zh: 适合夏季食欲不振者、喜欢酸辣口味的年轻人及街头美食爱好者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for heat-weary diners, spice lovers, and young urbanites seeking authentic street food refreshment.

caution: 含小麦，辣度可调，分量适中偏大

reviews.content: 酸辣比例绝妙，凉皮Q弹不软烂，黄瓜清脆，吃完浑身通透！
分量实在，蒜香和醋香融合得恰到好处，夏天来一碗太治愈了

description.zh: 以白萝卜丝和粘米粉为主料蒸制而成，口感软糯微弹，咸鲜中带清甜，米香与萝卜清香交融。
description.en: Steamed cake made with shredded white radish and rice flour; soft, slightly chewy texture with savory-sweet balance and delicate radish aroma.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢传统广式点心、追求温和口味及素食倾向的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for fans of Cantonese dim sum and those preferring mild, comforting, plant-based flavors.

caution: 含小麦（米粉），非低卡主食，微咸不辣。

reviews.content: 萝卜清甜突出，糕体扎实不散，腊味提香恰到好处！
外微焦内软糯，冷热皆宜，是记忆里的老广味道。

description.zh: 多种荤素食材（如牛肉、藕片、金针菇）旺火快炒，麻辣鲜香，口感丰富多变，层次分明
description.en: A sizzling stir-fry of diverse proteins and vegetables (beef, lotus root, enoki mushrooms) with bold Sichuan peppercorn heat, chili pungency, and aromatic depth.

recommendation.zh: 嗜辣者与重口味爱好者首选，适合追求丰富口感和强烈风味的食客
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers and those craving bold, complex flavors in one hearty dish.

caution: 辣度高，含花生与芝麻，分量足，慎选给儿童或肠胃敏感者

reviews.content: 麻辣过瘾，食材新鲜入味，每口都有惊喜，越吃越上瘾！
香锅料足味正，麻香突出不呛喉，配米饭解辣刚刚好。

description.zh: 嫩豆腐与牛肉末烧制，麻辣鲜香，口感滑嫩微酥，突出花椒麻香与豆瓣酱醇辣
description.en: Soft tofu and minced beef stir-fried with Sichuan doubanjiang and Sichuan peppercorns, delivering bold mala (numbing-spicy) flavor, tender texture, and aromatic heat.

recommendation.zh: 嗜辣者与川菜爱好者必点，追求层次丰富、开胃下饭的食客首选
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers and Sichuan cuisine fans seeking bold, appetite-stimulating, rice-complementing flavor.

caution: 辣度高（4级），含大豆、小麦，慎选肠胃敏感者

reviews.content: 麻香扑鼻、辣而不燥，豆腐入味不碎，下三碗米饭都不够！
花椒麻感正宗，牛肉末酥香，辣度适中，适合初尝川菜者

description.zh: 嫩豆腐与牛肉末烧制，麻辣鲜香，口感滑嫩微酥，红油亮泽，花椒麻香突出。
description.en: Soft tofu and minced beef stir-braised in spicy Sichuan chili bean paste and Sichuan peppercorns, delivering bold heat, numbing aroma, savory depth, and tender-yet-slightly-textured mouthfeel.

recommendation.zh: 嗜辣者与川菜爱好者必点，适合追求强烈味觉冲击的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers and Sichuan cuisine enthusiasts seeking bold, aromatic heat.

good_for: 主菜，适合配米饭独食或分享
caution: 辣度高（4/5），含大豆、小麦，油腻适中

reviews.content: 麻香扑鼻，豆腐嫩而不碎，辣得过瘾又不掩鲜味，下饭神器！
花椒麻感正宗，牛肉末入味，红油香而不腻，辣度可接受。

description.zh: 莲蓉、豆沙或五仁为馅，裹以酥软饼皮，烘烤而成；外皮微韧内馅绵密，甜润醇厚，带有油脂香与果仁焦香。
description.en: Made with lotus seed paste, red bean paste, or mixed nuts filling wrapped in tender pastry and baked. Sweet, rich, and moist with a soft-chewy texture and aromatic nutty or floral notes.

recommendation.zh: 喜爱传统节令甜点、偏好温和甜味的食客及中秋家庭聚餐者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those who enjoy traditional festive desserts and mild sweetness, especially during Mid-Autumn family gatherings.

caution: 高糖高油，含坚果和小麦，分量偏大

reviews.content: 莲蓉细腻不腻，蛋黄流沙咸甜平衡，中秋仪式感满分！
五仁款果仁香脆饱满，传统风味正宗，老人孩子都爱。

description.zh: 鸡胸肉或鸡腿肉煮熟撕条，淋红油、花椒油、芝麻酱等复合酱汁，口感嫩滑微脆，风味麻辣鲜香、酸辣开胃。
description.en: Shredded poached chicken breast or thigh tossed in a bold, aromatic sauce with chili oil, Sichuan peppercorn oil, and sesame paste—tender, slightly chewy, with fiery heat, numbing spice, and tangy umami.

recommendation.zh: 嗜辣者与川菜爱好者必点，开胃解腻，适合夏季食欲不振时唤醒味蕾。
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers and Sichuan cuisine fans seeking a vibrant, appetite-stimulating starter.

caution: 辣度较高，含花生、芝麻、小麦，慎选过敏者。

reviews.content: 麻辣鲜香层次分明，鸡肉嫩而不柴，红油香气扑鼻，一口就停不下！
酸辣够劲，花生脆香提味，配冰啤酒绝了，就是辣得冒汗也想再吃。

description.zh: 以大米和花生为主料慢火熬煮而成，质地绵滑细腻，口感软糯微甜，带有浓郁花生香气与温润米香。
description.en: A comforting Chinese breakfast porridge made by slow-simmering rice and peanuts until creamy and smooth, offering a soft, slightly sweet texture with rich peanut aroma and mild umami.

recommendation.zh: 适合肠胃敏感者、老人儿童及需温和养胃的人群，暖身易消化。
recommendation.en: Ideal for sensitive stomachs, elders, children, or anyone seeking gentle, nourishing comfort food.

caution: 含花生过敏原，分量适中不油腻

reviews.content: 花生香浓不腻，粥体顺滑暖胃，晨起一碗元气满满！
花生煮得酥烂入味，米香醇厚，适合换季时调理脾胃。

description.zh: 选用肥嫩北京填鸭，挂炉明火烤制，皮脆肉嫩，脂香丰盈，咸鲜中带微甜。
description.en: Roasted whole Peking duck with crispy skin and tender meat, cooked in a traditional open-flame oven; rich, savory-sweet flavor with aromatic duck fat.

recommendation.zh: 适合宴请宾客或家庭聚餐者，追求经典中式仪式感与风味体验。
recommendation.en: Ideal for guests or families seeking an authentic, celebratory Chinese dining experience.

caution: 油脂含量较高，分量足，建议2–3人共享。

reviews.content: 鸭皮酥得掉渣，鸭肉不柴不腻，卷饼蘸酱一口入魂！
传统工艺到位，皮脆肉润，配菜清爽解腻，仪式感满分。

description.zh: 酥脆烤鸭肉配甜面酱，裹入薄软春饼中，口感层次丰富，咸鲜微甜，香气浓郁。
description.en: Crispy roasted duck slices wrapped in soft scallion pancakes with sweet bean sauce; savory-sweet, aromatic, and texturally balanced.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢传统京味、追求仪式感与风味层次的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for diners seeking authentic Beijing cuisine and interactive, flavorful dining experiences.

caution: 含小麦和大豆，略油腻，分量适中

reviews.content: 鸭皮酥得掉渣，酱香恰到好处，卷饼软韧不破，地道京味！
食材新鲜，搭配均衡，适合多人分享，饱腹感强又不腻。

description.zh: 五花肉经慢火红烧，色泽红亮，肥而不腻，入口软糯咸鲜微甜，酱香浓郁。
description.en: Braised pork belly simmered slowly in soy sauce, rock sugar, and aromatics until tender, glossy, richly savory-sweet with melt-in-the-mouth texture.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜爱传统中式浓味主菜的食客，尤其推荐给喜欢软糯口感和酱香风味的人。
recommendation.en: Ideal for lovers of classic Chinese comfort food—rich, savory-sweet, and deeply satisfying.

caution: 较油腻，分量扎实，含大豆、小麦，不辣。

reviews.content: 肥瘦相间恰到好处，酱汁浓稠入味，配米饭绝了！
软烂不柴，甜咸平衡，老人小孩都爱吃。

description.zh: 整只肥美鸭胚经腌制后挂炉明火烤制，皮脆油亮、肉嫩多汁，咸鲜微甜，带有焦糖香与果木熏香。
description.en: Whole duck marinated in aromatic spices, then roasted over open flame until skin is crisp and glossy, meat tender and juicy, with savory-sweet flavor and subtle fruitwood smokiness.

recommendation.zh: 喜食酥脆鸭皮与丰润鸭肉者必点，适合家庭聚餐或宴请宾客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for duck lovers who crave crispy skin and succulent meat—perfect for family dinners or hosting guests.

caution: 油脂较丰，分量足，含小麦（酱料）

reviews.content: 鸭皮薄脆如纸，一咬爆油香，鸭肉不柴，酱汁微甜提鲜，地道广式风味！
皮色红亮诱人，肉质紧实有弹性，配酸梅酱解腻，下饭一流。

description.zh: 卤炖五花肉或腊汁牛肉夹入酥脆白吉馍中，外酥里嫩，咸香浓郁，肉汁丰盈。
description.en: Braised pork belly or marinated beef nestled in a crisp, slightly chewy baked bun; savory, aromatic, juicy, and deeply flavorful.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢中式街头风味、追求饱腹感与肉香满足感的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for meat lovers seeking hearty, authentic street food with bold flavor and satisfying texture.

caution: 含小麦，油脂适中，辣度可选，分量扎实。

reviews.content: 肉香扑鼻，馍外脆内软，卤汁浸透不腻，一口回到西安街头！
分量实在，肉质酥烂入味，馍现烤很香，微辣版更提神。

description.zh: 新鲜鱿鱼切圈裹粉炸至金黄，配椒盐调味，外酥里嫩，咸香微麻，鲜味突出。
description.en: Tender squid rings coated in seasoned flour and deep-fried until golden, tossed with fragrant Sichuan pepper salt—crispy outside, tender inside, savory with a subtle numbing aroma.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢酥脆口感和下酒小食的食客首选，适合口味偏好咸香微麻者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those who love crispy seafood snacks and bold savory flavors—perfect as a bar bite or appetizer.

caution: 含海鲜及小麦，油炸较油腻，分量适中偏小。

reviews.content: 鱿鱼弹牙不腻，椒盐香气扑鼻，一口接一口停不下来！
外皮酥得恰到好处，内里仍保持鲜嫩，椒盐不过咸，很地道。

description.zh: 小麦粉、葱花与葱油煎制而成，外皮酥脆，内里柔韧，咸香浓郁，葱香扑鼻。
description.en: Made from wheat flour, scallions, and fragrant scallion oil, pan-fried until golden. Crispy outside, tender inside, with savory, aromatic scallion flavor.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢传统中式面点、追求酥香口感的食客首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for fans of traditional Chinese savory pastries who love crispy, aromatic snacks.

good_for: 街头小吃/独食/分享/配茶
caution: 含小麦，较油腻，分量适中不辣

reviews.content: 葱香十足，层次分明，外脆里软，一口就停不下来！
传统做法还原度高，油润不腻，配豆浆绝了。

description.zh: 猪肉馅与高汤冻为芯，生煎至底面金黄酥脆，外皮微韧多汁，鲜香咸鲜中带微甜。
description.en: Pan-fried pork buns with aspic filling, golden crispy bottom, tender chewy skin, juicy and savory-sweet umami flavor.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢酥脆口感与爆汁体验的食客，尤其适合早餐或下午茶小食爱好者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those who love crispy textures and juicy fillings—perfect for breakfast or afternoon snack lovers.

caution: 底部较油，含小麦和猪肉，分量适中偏小。

reviews.content: 底脆汁丰，咬一口汤汁四溢，肉香十足不腻人。
外皮有嚼劲，内馅鲜嫩，芝麻葱花提香恰到好处。

description.zh: 猪肉馅与高汤冻制成的生煎包，底部煎至金黄酥脆，上部松软多汁，鲜香咸鲜，汤汁丰盈。
description.en: Pan-fried pork buns with aspic that melts into savory broth; crisp golden bottom, tender steamed top, rich umami flavor and juicy texture.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢酥脆与多汁口感的食客，尤其适合初次体验本帮点心的游客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for newcomers to Shanghai cuisine who love crispy-yet-juicy dumplings.

caution: 含较多油脂，分量适中，含小麦和猪肉。

reviews.content: 底脆汁多，咬一口汤汁四溢，地道上海味道让人回味无穷。
外皮焦香内馅鲜嫩，搭配香醋更提味，是经典不踩雷的点心。

description.zh: 牛油底料涮煮各类荤素食材，麻辣鲜香、层次丰富，口感热辣酣畅，汤底醇厚回甘。
description.en: Sichuan-style hot pot featuring spicy-savory beef tallow broth, used to cook fresh meats, vegetables, and tofu; bold, numbing heat with aromatic depth and lingering umami.

recommendation.zh: 嗜辣者与聚会人群首选，适合喜欢互动用餐和重口味体验的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers and groups seeking lively, interactive dining with intense flavor.

caution: 辣度极高，含牛油与大豆，不建议肠胃敏感或忌辣者食用。

reviews.content: 牛油锅底香浓不腻，毛肚脆嫩爽口，麻与辣在舌尖完美交织！
食材新鲜丰富，蘸料自由搭配，朋友围炉而坐，氛围感满分。

description.zh: 猪肉与虾仁馅馄饨，水煮后淋红油辣酱，皮滑馅嫩，麻辣鲜香，微带醋香与芝麻香。
description.en: Wontons filled with minced pork and shrimp, boiled until tender, then tossed in fiery Sichuan red oil sauce with chili, Sichuan peppercorn, black vinegar, and toasted sesame. Spicy, numbing, savory, and aromatic.

recommendation.zh: 嗜辣者与川菜爱好者必点，适合想体验地道麻辣风味的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers and Sichuan cuisine enthusiasts seeking authentic mala flavor.

caution: 辣度高，含小麦、大豆、芝麻，分量适中。

reviews.content: 红油香而不燥，抄手皮薄馅足，麻与辣层层递进，醋香提味绝了！
麻辣过瘾，配冰啤酒超解腻，就是对新手稍显刺激。

description.zh: 猪肉与虾仁为馅，蒸制而成，外皮柔韧微弹，内馅鲜嫩多汁，咸鲜中带清甜。
description.en: Steamed dumplings with minced pork and shrimp filling, wrapped in thin wheat wrappers; tender, juicy, and savory-sweet with delicate umami.

recommendation.zh: 适合初次尝试粤式点心者，老少皆宜，清淡不腻。
recommendation.en: Ideal for dim sum newcomers and families—light, approachable, and universally appealing.

caution: 含小麦和猪肉，分量小巧，非辣味。

reviews.content: 虾肉鲜甜弹牙，猪肉汁水丰盈，蒸得恰到好处不干柴。
皮薄馅足，荸荠增添脆感，早茶必点经典款。

description.zh: 鸡腿肉以特制豉油卤汁慢煮，肉质鲜嫩多汁，咸鲜微甜，酱香醇厚，表皮略带光泽。
description.en: Chicken leg meat slow-braised in a signature fermented soy sauce broth, yielding tender, juicy meat with savory-sweet umami depth and glossy, aromatic skin.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢传统广式风味、追求原汁原味与温和酱香的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for diners who appreciate classic Cantonese flavors—balanced, umami-rich, and not overly heavy.

caution: 含大豆、小麦；中等分量；非辣菜；轻微油脂感

reviews.content: 豉油香气扑鼻，鸡肉软嫩不柴，酱汁拌饭绝了！
味道正宗广式风味，咸甜适中，老人小孩都爱吃。

description.zh: 以猪肉、豆芽、胡萝卜等为馅，包裹于薄面皮中油炸而成，外皮酥脆，内馅鲜香多汁，咸鲜微甜。
description.en: Crispy fried rolls filled with minced pork, mung bean sprouts, carrots, and cabbage; golden crunchy exterior contrasts tender, savory-sweet, juicy filling.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢经典中式小吃、追求酥脆口感及轻食开胃体验的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for appetizer lovers and those seeking crispy, savory, light starters.

caution: 含小麦和鸡蛋，油炸略油腻，单份约3-4卷。

reviews.content: 外皮炸得金黄酥脆不腻，馅料清甜爽口，一口一个停不下来！
传统味道很正，豆芽和胡萝卜保留脆感，蘸甜辣酱更提味。

description.zh: 新鲜海鱼清蒸而成，肉质细嫩滑润，突出原汁原味，咸鲜清雅，口感清爽不腻。
description.en: Fresh whole sea fish gently steamed to preserve tenderness and natural sweetness; light, clean, savory-umami flavor with delicate, silky texture.

recommendation.zh: 适合追求健康清淡、注重食材本味的食客，尤其推荐老人、儿童及注重养生者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for health-conscious diners, elders, and children who prefer light, nutritious, and naturally flavorful dishes.

caution: 含鱼类过敏原；分量适中，适合2-3人共享。

reviews.content: 鱼肉鲜嫩到入口即化，姜葱提香不抢味，真正吃出食材本真之鲜。
清蒸火候精准，鱼皮微韧鱼肉软滑，豉油咸度恰到好处，毫无腥气。

description.zh: 发酵豆腐经油炸制成，外皮酥脆、内里软嫩，气味浓烈独特，入口咸鲜微臭、回味醇厚回甘。
description.en: Fermented tofu deep-fried until golden and crisp outside, tender inside; pungent aroma, savory-salty taste with umami depth and subtle aftertaste.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢挑战风味、热衷街头小吃文化的食客必试，初尝者建议配冰饮解腻。
recommendation.en: Ideal for adventurous eaters and street food lovers; beginners should pair with cold drinks to balance richness.

caution: 油炸较油腻；含大豆；辣度可选；分量适中。
ingredients: 卤汁（含苋菜梗、竹笋、豆豉等）

reviews.content: 臭味入魂，外脆里嫩，卤香直冲脑门，越吃越上瘾！
气味虽冲但完全不腻，配酸梅汤绝了，是记忆深刻的地道味道。

description.zh: 嫩豆腐裹入猪肉虾仁馅，蒸制而成，口感滑嫩多汁，咸鲜微甜，豆香与肉香交融。
description.en: Tender tofu stuffed with minced pork and shrimp, gently steamed until juicy and fragrant—savory, subtly sweet, with delicate texture and rich umami.

recommendation.zh: 适合素食者（可选素馅）、老人和儿童，清淡软嫩易消化。
recommendation.en: Ideal for elders, kids, and vegetarians (with tofu-only or mushroom filling)—gentle on digestion and nutrient-rich.

caution: 含大豆、小麦；分量适中；非辣味；低油

reviews.content: 豆腐入口即化，肉馅鲜甜不腻，蒸得恰到好处，家常却惊艳。
清淡不抢味，配米饭或粥都绝配，孩子连吃三块不嫌多。

description.zh: 猪里脊肉切块裹糊油炸，配菠萝、青红椒与糖醋汁快炒，外酥里嫩，酸甜开胃，果香微醒。
description.en: Crispy battered pork loin stir-fried with pineapple, bell peppers, and tangy-sweet sauce—tender inside, crunchy outside, bright and balanced.

recommendation.zh: 适合口味偏好酸甜、不嗜辣的儿童、老人及初次尝试粤菜的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for kids, seniors, or first-time Cantonese diners who love mild, sweet-sour flavors.

good_for: 主菜，适合家庭共享或单人正餐
caution: 含较多油脂和糖分，分量偏大

reviews.content: 酸甜比例绝妙，菠萝清香解腻，孩子连吃三碗饭！
外皮酥脆不油腻，肉质滑嫩，酱汁浓郁但不齁甜。

description.zh: 猪小排经焯水、炖煮与收汁制成，肉质酥软微韧，酱汁浓亮，酸甜适口，略带焦香
description.en: Braised and caramelized pork spare ribs in a glossy sweet-and-sour sauce; tender yet slightly chewy with balanced tangy-sweet depth and subtle caramel notes.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢经典中式酸甜口味、家庭聚餐或初次尝试本帮菜的食客
recommendation.en: Ideal for those who love classic Chinese comfort food or are new to Shanghainese-style dishes.

caution: 含糖量较高，分量较足，含小麦（酱油）

reviews.content: 酸甜比例绝妙，排骨酥而不柴，酱汁拌饭一绝！
传统做法还原度高，孩子爱吃，但稍偏甜，可依口味微调

description.zh: 山楂串裹糖浆油炸冷却而成，外脆内软，酸甜开胃，糖壳晶莹透亮，果肉微韧带汁。
description.en: Skewered hawthorn berries coated in hot sugar syrup, cooled to form a glossy, crunchy shell; tart-sweet flavor with tender-yet-chewy fruit inside.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢传统小吃、追求酸甜解腻的食客，尤其适合饭后或冬日暖身时品尝。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those craving nostalgic, tangy-sweet snacks—great after meals or on cold days.

good_for: 餐后甜点/街头小食/独食
caution: 含高糖，山楂微酸刺激胃，糖壳较硬慎防儿童噎呛

reviews.content: 糖壳薄脆不粘牙，山楂酸度刚好，一口唤醒童年记忆！
传统手艺扎实，甜而不齁，冬天吃着暖手又开胃。

description.zh: 糯米粉制成圆子，水煮后配甜汤，口感软糯弹牙，风味清甜温润。
description.en: Glutinous rice balls boiled in light sweet soup; soft, chewy, and springy texture with mild, comforting sweetness.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜食传统甜点、追求温暖口感者，尤其受老人与儿童喜爱。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those craving comforting traditional sweets—especially loved by children and elders.

good_for: 餐后甜点/独食/节日分享
caution: 含小麦（部分配方）、糯米难消化，儿童需防噎

reviews.content: 软糯不粘牙，黑芝麻馅香浓流心，冬至吃一碗暖到心窝！
汤头清甜不腻，小圆子Q弹有嚼劲，传统味道很地道。

description.zh: 以白萝卜丝为主料，混合粘米粉蒸制而成，外微焦内软糯，咸鲜清甜，带有淡淡米香与萝卜清香。
description.en: Steamed cake made with shredded daikon radish and rice flour; tender and slightly chewy inside, crisp-edged when pan-fried, savory-sweet with mild radish aroma and subtle rice fragrance.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢传统广式点心、追求温和口感及素食倾向的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for dim sum lovers and vegetarians seeking mild, comforting, and texturally satisfying bites.

caution: 含小麦（米粉），非纯素（部分做法加腊肠）

reviews.content: 萝卜清香扑鼻，外脆内糯，腊肠提鲜恰到好处，地道广式风味！
口感层次丰富，不油腻，配普洱茶解腻又暖胃，老少皆宜。

description.zh: 五花肉切片先煮后煸，配青蒜、郫县豆瓣酱炒制；肥而不腻、咸鲜微辣、锅气十足。
description.en: Sliced belly pork is first boiled, then stir-fried with green garlic and Pixian broad bean paste; savory, slightly spicy, rich umami, with crisp-tender texture and bold wok hei aroma.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢下饭重口味、追求经典川菜风味的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for rice lovers and fans of bold, authentic Sichuan flavors.

caution: 中度油腻，含大豆、小麦，辣度适中。

reviews.content: 五花肉焦香不腻，青蒜提鲜绝了，一口接一口根本停不下！
锅气足、豆瓣酱香醇，微辣刚好，配米饭太满足了。

description.zh: 鲜虾猪肉云吞配碱水面，清汤煮制，云吞皮薄馅弹，面条爽滑劲道，汤头清鲜微甜，整体咸鲜清爽。
description.en: Wontons filled with fresh shrimp and pork served with alkaline wheat noodles in a light, clear broth; tender-crisp filling, springy noodles, and delicate savory-sweet flavor.

recommendation.zh: 适合追求清淡鲜味、肠胃敏感或喜欢经典广式风味的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those seeking light, comforting, authentic Cantonese flavors or sensitive to heavy dishes.

caution: 含小麦、鸡蛋、甲壳类（虾），汤量适中不油腻。

reviews.content: 云吞馅料饱满弹牙，汤头清澈回甘，一碗下肚暖胃又不腻。
面条筋道有嚼劲，云吞皮薄透亮，是记忆里的老广味道。

description.zh: 猪肉与虾仁馅馄饨配清鸡汤，煮制而成，皮滑馅嫩，汤色清亮，鲜香清爽，咸鲜回甘。
description.en: Clear chicken broth with delicate wontons filled with minced pork and shrimp, boiled until tender; light, savory, and refreshing with smooth wrappers and springy filling.

recommendation.zh: 适合肠胃敏感者、老人儿童及追求清淡饮食的人群，暖胃易消化。
recommendation.en: Ideal for sensitive stomachs, elders, children, or anyone seeking a light, soothing, easily digestible meal.

caution: 含小麦和少量猪肉，分量适中不油腻

reviews.content: 汤头清甜不腻，馄饨皮薄馅足，一口一个，暖身又暖心！
孩子一口气喝完汤，连说‘鲜得眉毛掉下来’，馅料新鲜无腥味。

description.zh: 以芋头泥为皮，裹入虾肉、猪肉及冬菇馅料，油炸至金黄，外皮酥脆软糯，内馅鲜香弹牙，咸鲜微甜。
description.en: Crispy-yet-chewy taro paste dumplings filled with shrimp, pork, and dried shiitake mushrooms, deep-fried to golden perfection—savory, umami-rich, and subtly sweet.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢传统广式点心、追求外酥内润口感的食客首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for dim sum lovers who enjoy contrasting textures and authentic Cantonese flavors.

caution: 含花生油（可能致敏），中等油腻，分量适中。

reviews.content: 外皮酥而不硬，芋香纯正，虾肉鲜甜弹牙，一口难忘！
传统做法地道，热食最佳，蘸浙醋更添风味层次。

description.zh: 猪肉与皮冻为馅，蒸制而成，皮薄汁丰、鲜香滑嫩，汤汁清甜微咸，口感弹润多汁。
description.en: Steamed delicate wheat-flour dumplings filled with seasoned pork and aspic that melts into savory broth; tender, juicy, and delicately fragrant.

recommendation.zh: 喜爱精致点心、追求原汁原味的食客首选，适合初次体验江南风味者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for dumpling lovers and first-time explorers of Jiangnan cuisine—elegant, approachable, and deeply flavorful.

caution: 趁热食用防烫；含小麦和猪肉；单份约6只，分量适中。

reviews.content: 汤汁丰盈不腻，咬一口满嘴鲜香，皮薄透光却不易破，功夫了得！
传统做法地道，肉馅细腻有层次，蘸醋吃更显鲜爽平衡。

description.zh: 猪肉与皮冻为馅，蒸制而成，皮薄汁丰、鲜香滑嫩，汤汁清甜微咸，入口即化。
description.en: Steamed delicate dumplings filled with minced pork and aspic that melts into savory-sweet broth; tender skin, juicy filling, and umami-rich flavor.

recommendation.zh: 喜爱传统江南点心、追求原汁原味与精致口感的食客首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for diners who appreciate authentic Jiangnan dim sum and delicate, broth-filled dumplings.

caution: 烫口！需稍晾再食用；含小麦和猪肉；单份约6只。

reviews.content: 汤汁丰盈不腻，皮薄透亮，咬一口满嘴鲜香，地道上海味道！
肉馅调味恰到好处，汤汁清而不油，配姜丝醋吃更显层次。

description.zh: 手擀面配炸香的黄酱肉末，酱香浓郁咸鲜，面条筋道爽滑， topped with清脆黄瓜丝与豆芽。
description.en: Hand-pulled wheat noodles topped with savory, fragrant fried soybean paste and minced pork, garnished with crisp cucumber and bean sprouts. Rich, umami-forward, and satisfyingly chewy.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢咸鲜重口味、追求饱腹感的食客，尤其受北方风味爱好者青睐。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those craving hearty, savory comfort food—especially fans of Northern Chinese flavors.

caution: 较油腻，含小麦和大豆，分量足，微咸不辣。

reviews.content: 酱香扑鼻，肉末酥香不腻，面条劲道入味，一口回到老北京胡同。
黄瓜清爽解腻，酱料层次丰富，咸度适中，是经典北方面食代表作。

description.zh: 糯米包裹五花肉、咸蛋黄等馅料，水煮而成，口感软糯弹牙，咸鲜油润，粽叶清香沁人。
description.en: Glutinous rice stuffed with braised pork belly and salted duck yolk, boiled in bamboo leaves—chewy, savory, rich, and fragrant with herbal notes.

recommendation.zh: 喜爱传统节令美食、偏好软糯口感及咸鲜风味的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those who enjoy traditional festive foods and savory, chewy textures.

caution: 含小麦（粽叶绳）、高脂、分量扎实

reviews.content: 五花肉酥烂入味，糯米吸饱汤汁，软糯不腻，粽叶清香恰到好处。
咸蛋黄流沙感十足，与板栗甜香平衡得宜，传统味道很地道。

description.zh: 嫩滑牛肉丝配洋葱、蘑菇，以酸奶油酱汁慢煨，口感柔嫩浓香，风味醇厚微酸带奶香
description.en: Tender strips of beef sautéed with onions and mushrooms, simmered in a rich, creamy sour cream sauce—velvety, savory, and subtly tangy.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢浓郁奶香与柔嫩肉质的食客，尤其推荐给偏好东欧风味的成年人
recommendation.en: Ideal for adults who enjoy creamy, savory comfort food with tender beef and Eastern European flair.

caution: 含乳制品较油腻，分量适中，无辣度

reviews.content: 牛肉软嫩不柴，酸奶油酱汁香浓顺滑，配米饭绝了！
蘑菇鲜味十足，酱汁微酸解腻，整体平衡感很好。

description.zh: 混合腌肉、新鲜卷心菜与酸菜慢炖而成，口感醇厚软糯，风味酸香浓郁带微烟熏感
description.en: Slow-simmered stew of mixed cured meats, fresh and fermented cabbage, tender and rich with tangy, smoky depth.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜爱浓郁风味和传统东欧美食的食客，尤其推荐给肉食爱好者和冬日暖身需求者
recommendation.en: Ideal for meat lovers and those seeking hearty, comforting Eastern European tradition.

caution: 分量较大，含小麦（黑麦面包常配餐），中等油腻度

reviews.content: 酸菜与腌肉融合绝妙，炖得软烂入味，冬日吃一碗浑身暖透！
层次丰富，酸香解腻，但建议搭配黑麦面包更地道

description.zh: 以小麦粉、牛奶和鸡蛋调制面糊，平底锅煎制而成；外缘微脆、内里柔软微弹，散发淡淡奶香与蛋香。
description.en: Made from wheat flour, milk, and eggs, cooked in a pan until golden; tender and slightly springy inside with crisp edges, offering mild dairy and eggy aroma.

recommendation.zh: 适合早餐偏好轻盈碳水、喜爱俄式传统风味的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for breakfast lovers seeking light, comforting carbs with authentic Eastern European charm.

caution: 含小麦、牛奶、鸡蛋；分量适中不油腻。

reviews.content: 奶香浓郁，饼身柔软有弹性，蘸酸奶油绝了！
复刻了莫斯科早餐店的味道，温热时口感最佳。

description.zh: 以甜菜根为主料慢炖的东欧经典汤品，色泽鲜红，口感微酸清冽，融合牛肉醇厚与蔬菜清甜，风味层次丰富。
description.en: A traditional Eastern European soup slow-simmered with red beets, beef, cabbage, carrots, and potatoes; tangy, earthy, and deeply savory with a vibrant ruby color.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢酸鲜口味、追求暖胃养生或初尝东欧风味的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those who enjoy tangy, hearty soups or seek warming, nutrient-rich comfort food.

caution: 含小麦（面汤勾芡）、中等分量、微酸不辣

reviews.content: 甜菜根的天然酸香与牛肉高汤完美融合，喝完浑身暖意融融！
颜色漂亮，酸度适中不刺激，配黑麦面包绝了。

description.zh: 精选鲟鱼卵经轻盐腌制而成，颗粒饱满弹牙，咸鲜清冽，带有海洋矿物香气与细腻脂香。
description.en: Premium sturgeon roe lightly cured with sea salt; firm, glistening pearls with briny ocean minerality, rich umami, and delicate buttery finish.

recommendation.zh: 追求精致体验的食客、庆祝场合宾客或海鲜爱好者首选开胃珍品。
recommendation.en: Ideal for connoisseurs, celebratory diners, or seafood lovers seeking an elegant, luxurious starter.

caution: 含鱼类过敏原；分量小，价格高；低辣度无添加香料。

reviews.content: 颗粒分明、入口即化，咸鲜平衡绝妙，真正顶级鱼子酱的仪式感。
海味纯净不腥，配薄饼和酸奶油相得益彰，小份量恰到好处。

description.zh: 卷心菜叶包裹牛肉与大米饭馅，慢炖至软烂，口感软糯鲜香，风味咸鲜微酸，带有番茄酱的柔和果酸。
description.en: Cabbage leaves stuffed with ground beef and rice, slow-simmered in tomato-based broth until tender; savory, slightly tangy, and comforting with soft, yielding texture.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢传统家常风味、追求饱腹感与温暖口感的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for comfort-food lovers seeking hearty, home-style Eastern European warmth.

good_for: 主菜，适合独食或家庭分享
caution: 含小麦（卷心菜卷用面粉勾芡），分量扎实，中等油腻度

reviews.content: 卷心菜软而不烂，肉馅多汁入味，酸甜平衡得恰到好处，像奶奶做的味道！
炖得非常软烂，暖胃又满足，配黑麦面包吃更地道。

description.zh: 卷心菜叶包裹猪肉牛肉混合馅料，慢炖至软烂，口感软糯鲜香，酱汁浓郁微酸。
description.en: Cabbage leaves stuffed with a savory blend of ground pork and beef, slow-simmered in tomato-based sauce until tender—rich, slightly tangy, and deeply comforting.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢传统家常风味、追求饱腹感与温暖口感的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for comfort-food lovers seeking hearty, home-style Eastern European warmth.

caution: 含小麦（面糊/面粉）、中等分量，略带酸味不辣。

reviews.content: 卷心菜软而不烂，肉馅多汁入味，酸甜酱汁开胃又下饭！
复刻乌克兰奶奶的味道，暖胃暖心，配黑麦面包绝了。

description.zh: 以苹果、梨、李子等当季水果慢煮而成，口感温润清甜，带有果香与微酸平衡的柔和风味。
description.en: A traditional Eastern European fruit drink made by gently simmering seasonal fruits like apples, pears, and plums; lightly sweet, refreshing, and subtly tart with a smooth, warm texture.

recommendation.zh: 适合老人、儿童及偏好低糖暖饮者，解腻助消化又温和不刺激。
