caution: 较油腻，含鸡蛋和小麦（薯条裹粉），分量充足易饱。

reviews.content: 蛋液裹着薯条太绝了！火腿咸香提味，每一口都满足。
薯条酥脆不软塌，蛋黄流心恰到好处，经典西班牙味道。

description.zh: 100%伊比利亚黑猪后腿，经天然海盐腌制与长达36个月以上山间风干熟成；切片薄如蝉翼，入口即化，咸鲜醇厚，带坚果与橡果回甘。
description.en: Cured hind leg of 100% Iberian black pigs, dry-aged with sea salt for 36+ months in mountain air; paper-thin slices melt on the tongue, offering rich umami, nutty depth, and acorn-sweet finish.

recommendation.zh: 适合追求高品质食材与地道西班牙风味的食客，尤其推荐给火腿鉴赏家和慢食爱好者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for connoisseurs seeking authentic Spanish delicacy and premium cured meat experience.

caution: 高盐高脂，分量精巧，含猪肉，无常见过敏原

reviews.content: 油脂分布如大理石纹路，入口柔润不腻，橡果香气层次分明，真正顶级火腿体验。
切片极薄透光，咸度平衡，配曼萨尼亚雪莉酒绝配，是开胃首选。

description.zh: 选用3周龄内嫩乳羊，炭火慢烤至外皮金黄酥脆、内里粉嫩多汁，咸鲜中透出淡淡奶香与草本清香。
description.en: Roasted whole suckling lamb (under 3 weeks old), cooked over charcoal until crisp-skinned and tender-pink inside, delivering savory, milky, and herbaceous notes with juicy tenderness.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜爱传统风味、追求极致嫩度的食客，或想体验西班牙卡斯蒂利亚经典主菜的美食爱好者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for lovers of authentic Spanish cuisine and those seeking exceptionally tender, flavorful meat.

caution: 分量较大，含小麦（腌料中少量面粉），非素食，脂肪含量中等偏高。

reviews.content: 外皮酥到掉渣，肉质如豆腐般嫩滑，奶香纯粹不膻，西班牙之魂在此一盘！
火候精准，汁水丰盈，配烤土豆绝配，虽略油腻但风味无可替代。

description.zh: 猪里脊肉丁与陈面包屑同炒，外酥里嫩，咸鲜微焦，带有橄榄油香和蒜香
description.en: Sautéed pork tenderloin cubes and stale rustic bread crumbs with garlic, olive oil, and paprika—crispy, savory, aromatic, and deeply flavorful.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢传统风味、追求饱腹感与质朴口感的食客首选
recommendation.en: Ideal for lovers of rustic, hearty Spanish comfort food who enjoy savory, textural dishes.

caution: 含小麦，中等油腻，分量扎实

reviews.content: 面包屑吸饱肉汁后酥香不腻，猪肉嫩滑多汁，地道极了！
蒜香和橄榄油味很正，下饭一流，适合喜欢扎实口感的人

description.zh: 以新鲜虾、青口、鱿鱼等海鲜为主料，用藏红花调味的橄榄油烩制米饭，粒粒分明、鲜香浓郁，带有海洋的清甜与微咸。
description.en: A Spanish rice dish featuring fresh shrimp, mussels, squid, and saffron-infused olive oil; cooked until rice is tender yet distinct, with briny sweetness and aromatic depth.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢海鲜、追求地道风味或想体验西班牙饮食文化的食客首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for seafood lovers and travelers seeking authentic Spanish culinary experience.

caution: 含甲壳类及贝类，分量足，适合2-3人共享。

reviews.content: 海鲜新鲜弹牙，米饭吸饱高汤汁水，藏红花香气迷人，地道不腻！
分量实在，多种海鲜搭配和谐，锅底微焦饭粒是点睛之笔。

description.zh: 以短粒米、兔肉、鸡肉、蜗牛、宽豆和藏红花为主，铁锅明火焖烧，米粒干爽微韧，风味咸鲜浓郁带草本清香
description.en: Made with short-grain rice, rabbit, chicken, snails, green beans, and saffron, cooked in a wide paella pan over open flame; savory, aromatic, with tender meat and slightly al dente rice.

recommendation.zh: 喜爱传统风味与丰富口感的食客，适合想体验正宗西班牙主食文化的顾客
recommendation.en: Ideal for food lovers seeking authentic Spanish tradition and hearty, flavorful rice dishes.

caution: 含海鲜及甲壳类，分量较大，非纯素

reviews.content: 藏红花香气扑鼻，兔肉酥嫩，米饭吸饱高汤却粒粒分明，地道瓦伦西亚风味！
食材新鲜扎实，烟熏火候到位，唯一建议可减少一点盐分更显层次

description.zh: 新鲜烤制面包切片，淋上特级初榨橄榄油，外脆内软，散发橄榄果香与微苦回甘。
description.en: Toasted rustic bread slices generously drizzled with extra virgin olive oil; crisp exterior, tender crumb, aromatic with fruity, peppery, and slightly bitter notes.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢简约原味、追求健康轻食的早餐族或橄榄油爱好者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for health-conscious breakfast lovers who appreciate pure, high-quality ingredients and Mediterranean flavors.

caution: 含小麦；橄榄油含量较高，较油腻

reviews.content: 橄榄油香气扑鼻，面包焦脆恰到好处，纯粹却令人回味无穷。
简单但高级，搭配咖啡绝了，是地道西班牙早餐的灵魂之选。

description.zh: 炸至外酥里软的土豆块，淋上番茄辣椒酱，酸辣开胃，鲜香浓郁带微甜
description.en: Crispy-on-the-outside, tender-on-the-inside fried potato cubes topped with spicy tomato-paprika sauce—tangy, bold, and slightly sweet.

recommendation.zh: 嗜辣者、下酒爱好者及喜欢开胃小食的人首选
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers and those seeking a bold, shareable appetizer with drinks.

caution: 中辣（3/5），含小麦（酱汁），略油腻

reviews.content: 酱汁酸辣平衡，土豆外脆内绵，越吃越上瘾！
分量适中，配啤酒绝了，辣度对多数人友好。

description.zh: 炸土豆块配自制辣味番茄蒜蓉酱，外酥里绵，酸辣开胃，香气浓郁
description.en: Crispy fried potato cubes topped with spicy tomato-garlic bravas sauce; savory, tangy, and moderately hot with a rich umami finish.

recommendation.zh: 嗜辣者和喜欢西班牙小吃的人必点，适合重口味爱好者开胃
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers and tapas enthusiasts seeking bold, authentic Spanish flavor.

caution: 中高辣度，含小麦和少量乳制品

reviews.content: 辣得过瘾又不掩土豆本味，酱汁层次丰富，蘸着吃超上瘾
外脆内软，辣酱酸香平衡，配啤酒或红酒都很绝

description.zh: 新鲜帕德龙辣椒用橄榄油高温快煎，外皮微焦酥脆，内里鲜嫩多汁，咸鲜带微辣，偶有惊喜辣度。
description.en: Small green Padrón peppers sautéed in olive oil until blistered and tender-crisp; salty, savory, with bright vegetal notes and occasional spicy kick.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢探索风味、接受轻度挑战的食客，适合佐酒或开启西班牙风味之旅。
recommendation.en: Ideal for adventurous eaters and wine lovers seeking a simple, authentic Spanish starter.

caution: 辣度随机（约10%较辣），含橄榄油，分量适中

reviews.content: 外脆里嫩，海盐提鲜绝了，配冰啤酒太上头！
地道小食，辣度惊喜但不吓人，下酒一流。

description.zh: 新鲜章鱼水煮后切片，配橄榄油、粗盐和甜椒粉，口感弹嫩微韧，咸鲜中带橄榄清香与微甜烟熏感。
description.en: Tender octopus boiled until just cooked, sliced and dressed with extra virgin olive oil, coarse sea salt, and sweet smoked paprika—chewy, briny, and aromatic with fruity oil and smoky-sweet depth.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢海洋风味、追求地道西班牙小吃体验的食客首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for seafood lovers and travelers seeking authentic Galician tapas culture.

caution: 含海鲜过敏原；分量适中；不辣

reviews.content: 章鱼火候绝妙，Q弹不柴，橄榄油香气纯正，一秒穿越到拉科鲁尼亚夜市！
甜椒粉提香不抢味，海盐颗粒感十足，是教科书级的冷盘章鱼。

description.zh: 以熟番茄、特级初榨橄榄油、面包和大蒜为主料，冷制搅打而成；质地浓稠顺滑，口感清爽酸鲜，橄榄油香浓郁
description.en: A chilled Spanish soup made by blending ripe tomatoes, stale bread, garlic, and premium extra-virgin olive oil until creamy. Refreshing, velvety, tangy, and rich with fruity olive oil aroma.

recommendation.zh: 适合夏季消暑者、喜欢清爽开胃前菜的人，或对地中海风味感兴趣的食客
recommendation.en: Ideal for hot-weather diners seeking a refreshing starter or those exploring authentic Andalusian flavors.

caution: 含小麦和橄榄油，分量适中偏小

reviews.content: 番茄香气纯正，橄榄油香在口中久久不散，冰凉顺滑得像丝绸
比 gazpacho 更浓稠满足，蒜香恰到好处，夏日第一口就唤醒味蕾

description.zh: 红葡萄酒为基底，加入新鲜水果切块与橙汁、白兰地等调制而成；口感清爽微醺，酸甜平衡，果香馥郁。
description.en: A refreshing Spanish wine punch made with red wine, fresh fruit (oranges, apples, berries), orange juice, brandy, and a touch of sweetener. Lightly effervescent, fruity, and pleasantly tart-sweet.

recommendation.zh: 适合聚会社交或夏日消暑的饮酒初学者及果酒爱好者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for social gatherings, summer refreshment, or wine beginners who prefer fruity, approachable drinks.

caution: 含酒精，未成年人勿饮；含柑橘类水果易致光敏。

reviews.content: 果香扑鼻，酒味柔和不冲，朋友聚会时连喝三杯都不腻！
夏日冰镇后超解渴，酸甜度刚好，女生们一致好评。

description.zh: 土豆、洋葱与鸡蛋慢火煎制而成，外微焦内绵软，咸鲜浓郁，蛋香与薯香交融。
description.en: Made with potatoes, onions, and eggs slowly pan-fried until golden outside and tender inside; rich, savory, and comforting with earthy potato and sweet onion notes.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢温和风味、追求饱腹感的食客，尤其推荐给素食倾向者（不含肉）。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those seeking a hearty, egg-based comfort dish—great for vegetarians and first-time Spanish food explorers.

caution: 含鸡蛋和小麦（部分配方用面粉定型），中等分量，不辣。

reviews.content: 外酥里嫩，土豆绵密入味，橄榄油香得恰到好处，地道西班牙家常味！
分量实在，鸡蛋嫩滑不老，洋葱甜味提鲜，配红酒很经典。

description.zh: 新鲜番茄切碎拌橄榄油、蒜末和海盐，铺在烤至金黄酥脆的乡村面包片上，口感酥脆多汁，风味清新酸甜带蒜香。
description.en: Ripe tomatoes finely chopped and mixed with extra virgin olive oil, garlic, and sea salt, served on golden, crispy rustic bread. Fresh, tangy, garlicky, and juicy with a satisfying crunch.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢轻食早餐或地中海风味的人，清爽开胃，不油腻。
recommendation.en: Ideal for light-breakfast lovers or Mediterranean food fans—refreshing, flavorful, and not heavy.

caution: 含小麦；分量适中；无辣度；不含乳制品或坚果。

reviews.content: 番茄新鲜多汁，面包酥脆不硬，蒜香恰到好处，清晨吃一口就唤醒味蕾！
简单却惊艳，橄榄油香气浓郁，搭配咖啡是完美的西班牙式晨间仪式。

description.zh: 精选厚切牛肋排，炭火直烤至外焦里嫩，肉汁丰盈，带有浓郁烟熏香与天然咸鲜味。
description.en: Thick-cut beef rib steak, grilled over open charcoal until crusty outside and tender, juicy inside, with rich smoky aroma and natural umami.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜爱大块厚切牛排、追求原始肉香与满足感的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for meat lovers who crave bold, juicy, smoky-flavored steaks with hearty satisfaction.

caution: 分量较大（约800g），含高脂肪，不建议单人独食。

reviews.content: 炭火香气扑鼻，肉质软嫩多汁，三分熟恰到好处，真正吃出牛肉本味！
分量十足，朋友两人分享刚刚好，外皮微脆内里温润，配粗盐更显风味。

description.zh: 以虾、青口、鱿鱼、鱼片为主料，番茄洋葱烩煮而成，口感鲜嫩多汁，风味咸鲜微酸，带有地中海香草清香。
description.en: A Spanish seafood stew featuring shrimp, mussels, squid, and white fish simmered with tomatoes, onions, garlic, and saffron—savory, briny, and subtly tangy with herbal depth.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢丰富海味与复合风味的食客，尤其推荐给海鲜爱好者和探索地中海风味的人。
recommendation.en: Ideal for seafood lovers and those seeking authentic, aromatic Mediterranean flavors in one hearty dish.

caution: 含多种甲壳类与贝类，过敏者慎选；分量充足，建议2人共享。

reviews.content: 海味层次分明，藏红花香气惊艳，汤汁拌饭绝了！
食材新鲜度高，酱汁浓郁不腻，配面包蘸食非常满足。

description.zh: 以玉米面为主料，煎或烤制而成，外微酥内软糯，带有天然玉米香与淡淡咸鲜味。
description.en: Made from pre-cooked cornmeal, shaped into patties and pan-fried or grilled until golden. Tender inside with a slightly crisp exterior and sweet, earthy corn flavor.

recommendation.zh: 素食者、玉米爱好者及追求便捷饱腹感的上班族首选。
recommendation.en: Great for vegetarians, corn lovers, and busy professionals seeking a satisfying, portable meal.

caution: 含玉米（非常见过敏原），分量扎实易饱

reviews.content: 外皮微脆内里绵软，玉米香气纯正，不油不腻，一口回到南美街头！
饱腹感强又清爽，早餐配咖啡刚刚好，加热后口感依然在线。

description.zh: 法棍面包夹烤肉、腌萝卜、黄瓜、香菜，烘烤微脆，口感酥脆与爽脆交织，风味咸鲜酸甜平衡。
description.en: A crusty French baguette filled with grilled pork or chicken, pickled daikon and carrot, cucumber, cilantro, and pâté—crispy outside, refreshing and savory-sweet inside.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢丰富口感和复合风味的食客，适合午餐快速饱腹或街头小吃爱好者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for lunch seekers and street food lovers craving bold, balanced flavors and textural contrast.

caution: 含小麦、芝麻；分量适中；可选辣度（通常微辣）

reviews.content: 外脆内润，腌菜酸爽解腻，肉香与香草完美融合，一口上瘾！
法棍够脆，馅料丰富不干柴，辣度刚好，是记忆里的越南街头味道。

description.zh: 发酵面皮包裹猪肉或蔬菜馅，蒸制而成，外皮松软微弹，内馅多汁鲜香，咸鲜微甜。
description.en: Steamed buns made from leavened wheat dough filled with savory pork or vegetable filling; soft, slightly springy exterior with juicy, umami-rich, subtly sweet interior.

recommendation.zh: 适合早餐、赶时间上班族及喜欢温和中式主食的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for breakfast or busy eaters seeking a comforting, handheld, non-spicy staple.

caution: 含小麦，分量适中，非辣食，部分含猪肉。

reviews.content: 皮薄馅大，咬一口汤汁四溢，肉香十足，热乎乎的超满足！
面皮松软不粘牙，蔬菜馅清爽解腻，适合不吃太油腻的人。

description.zh: 黑糖煮制的木薯珍珠搭配鲜奶与红茶，冷饮冲泡，Q弹软糯，奶香醇厚，甜润清爽。
description.en: Tapioca pearls cooked in brown sugar, steeped black tea, and fresh milk served chilled—chewy, creamy, sweet, and refreshingly smooth.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢嚼劲与奶香的年轻人、下午提神或解渴时的理想选择。
recommendation.en: Perfect for young adults seeking a chewy, creamy pick-me-up during afternoon breaks or hot days.

caution: 含牛奶与糖分较高，乳糖不耐者慎选。

reviews.content: 珍珠Q弹有嚼劲，茶奶平衡绝妙，冰凉顺滑超解暑！
黑糖香气浓郁，珍珠不糊不硬，喝完心情瞬间变好。

description.zh: 面粉、水、糖和肉桂粉制成面糊，经星形裱花嘴挤入热油炸至金黄，外酥内软，甜香浓郁带肉桂暖香。
description.en: Made from wheat flour, water, sugar, and cinnamon, piped through a star tip and deep-fried until golden. Crispy outside, tender inside, with sweet, warm cinnamon aroma.

recommendation.zh: 甜食爱好者、下午茶人群及儿童首选，解馋又充满节日氛围。
recommendation.en: Perfect for dessert lovers, kids, and afternoon snackers seeking joyful, nostalgic sweetness.

caution: 高油高糖，含小麦和鸡蛋，分量偏大易饱。

reviews.content: 外皮酥到掉渣，内里微韧带嚼劲，裹糖肉桂香得让人停不下嘴！
热乎现炸风味绝佳，搭配巧克力酱更显层次，稍油腻但值得。

description.zh: 小麦粉、鸡蛋、牛奶调制面糊，平底锅薄摊煎制，外缘微脆、内里柔韧，奶香浓郁，甜咸皆宜。
description.en: Made from wheat flour, eggs, and milk batter, cooked thin on a hot griddle—crisp-edged yet tender, rich in dairy aroma, versatile for sweet or savory fillings.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢轻食、追求快速饱腹感的上班族或学生，也适合儿童和甜品爱好者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for students, office workers seeking quick, satisfying meals, and kids or dessert lovers.

caution: 含小麦、鸡蛋、牛奶；分量适中，不油腻。

reviews.content: 面皮薄而有韧性，黄油香气扑鼻，搭配香蕉巧克力绝了！
咸口火腿芝士款很扎实，饱腹又不腻，街边现做超新鲜。

description.zh: 煎烤猪肠配咖喱番茄酱，外微焦内多汁，咸鲜微辣带甜香，酱汁浓稠裹覆。
description.en: Grilled or fried pork sausage served with a spiced ketchup-curry sauce; juicy inside, slightly crispy outside, savory-sweet with mild heat and aromatic curry notes.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢德式街头风味、追求快食满足感的食客首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for street-food lovers seeking bold, comforting, and quick-satisfying flavors.

caution: 中等油腻；含小麦和少量糖；辣度温和。

reviews.content: 酱汁香浓不腻，香肠弹牙多汁，一口回到柏林街头！
咖喱味恰到好处，不抢香肠本味，配薯条绝了。

description.zh: 羊肉或牛肉切薄片，垂直旋转烤制，肉质鲜嫩多汁，外微焦内软润，咸鲜带烟熏香
description.en: Thinly sliced lamb or beef slow-roasted on a vertical rotisserie; tender, juicy, with smoky aroma and savory depth.

recommendation.zh: 适合赶时间的上班族、学生或夜宵爱好者，快速饱腹又风味十足
recommendation.en: Perfect for busy professionals, students, or late-night snackers seeking fast, satisfying flavor.

caution: 较油腻，含小麦（饼皮）和可能含乳制品（酱料）

reviews.content: 肉汁丰盈不柴，饼皮松软吸饱酱汁，烟熏香令人回味
分量实在，配菜清爽解腻，是雨天最治愈的暖胃卷

description.zh: 猪肉与白菜为主料，煎制而成，底面金黄酥脆，上部柔嫩多汁，咸鲜微香，带焦香锅气。
description.en: Pan-fried dumplings filled with pork and napa cabbage; crisp golden bottom, tender juicy top, savory umami flavor with aromatic wok hei.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢酥脆口感和街头烟火气的食客首选，适合初次体验中式煎饺者。
recommendation.en: Perfect for crispy-texture lovers and first-timers exploring authentic Chinese street food.

caution: 含小麦和猪肉，略油腻，分量适中。

reviews.content: 底脆馅嫩汁水足，锅气十足，一口咬下满嘴鲜香！
外皮焦香不腻，内馅调味恰到好处，蘸醋更开胃。

description.zh: 新鲜白肉鱼经香料腌制后煎烤，外皮微酥内里细嫩，搭配卷心菜丝、青柠汁与辣酱，鲜香清爽带微辣。
description.en: Grilled or pan-seared white fish fillets, seasoned with lime and spices, served in soft corn tortillas with crisp cabbage, fresh lime, and creamy chili sauce—light, flaky, and zesty.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢轻食、追求风味层次的年轻食客和海鲜爱好者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for seafood lovers and health-conscious diners seeking bold, fresh flavors without heaviness.

caution: 含鱼类过敏原；辣度可调；分量适中。

reviews.content: 鱼肉鲜嫩多汁，玉米饼软韧恰到好处，青柠提味太惊艳！
辣度温和不呛口，配啤酒超解腻，三只刚好吃饱。

description.zh: 猪肉与白菜为主料，水煮或煎制而成，外皮柔韧微弹，内馅多汁鲜香，咸鲜中带清甜。
description.en: Dumplings filled with minced pork and napa cabbage, boiled or pan-fried; tender chewy wrapper encases juicy, savory-sweet, umami-rich filling.

recommendation.zh: 适合想尝地道中式街头小吃、偏好热食与饱腹感的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for street food lovers seeking authentic, comforting, and satisfying hot bites.

caution: 含小麦和猪肉；煎饺略油；分量适中。

reviews.content: 皮薄馅大，咬一口汤汁四溢，葱姜提鲜不腻，地道家常味！
煎饺底部金黄酥脆，搭配醋蒜汁绝了，暖胃又解馋。

description.zh: 河粉配豆腐干、虾仁、鸡蛋快炒，口感柔韧微弹，酸甜咸鲜交融，带罗望子果酸与鱼露鲜香。
description.en: Stir-fried rice noodles with shrimp, tofu, egg, and bean sprouts, tossed in tamarind sauce—chewy, tangy-sweet, savory, and umami-rich.

recommendation.zh: 适合初次尝试泰餐者，口味平衡不刺激，老少皆宜。
recommendation.en: Ideal for first-time Thai food eaters—balanced, approachable, and universally appealing.

caution: 含花生碎和鱼露，对花生或海鲜过敏者需注意。

reviews.content: 酸甜恰到好处，河粉Q弹不糊，花生香脆提味，地道街头风味！
酱汁浓郁但不腻，虾仁新鲜，配青柠汁更清爽开胃。

description.zh: 土豆、豌豆与香料馅料，油炸至金黄酥脆，外皮焦香起酥，内馅咸鲜微辣，香气浓郁
description.en: Crispy golden pastry filled with spiced potatoes, peas, and aromatic herbs, deep-fried to deliver a savory, slightly spicy, and fragrant bite.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢酥脆口感和香料风味的食客，适合初次尝试印度街头美食者
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice-curious diners and newcomers to Indian street food seeking bold flavor and crunch.

caution: 油炸较油腻，含小麦和少量植物油，辣度适中

reviews.content: 外皮酥到掉渣，内馅香料层次丰富，辣度刚好开胃不刺激
热食时香气扑鼻，配薄荷酸奶奶昔解腻，体验地道街头风味

description.zh: 炭火烤腌制猪肩肉，配菠萝、洋葱和香菜，肉质嫩多汁，酸甜微辣，带有烟熏果香
description.en: Thinly sliced marinated pork shoulder roasted on a vertical spit, served with grilled pineapple, onion, and cilantro—tender, juicy, smoky, tangy-sweet with mild heat.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢风味鲜明、酸甜微辣的食客，尤其适合初次尝试墨西哥街头美食的人
recommendation.en: Ideal for adventurous eaters who love bold, balanced flavors—perfect first-taste of authentic Mexican street food.

caution: 含小麦（玉米饼）、中等辣度，分量适中

reviews.content: 菠萝的甜香完美中和辣味，猪肉嫩而不柴，烟熏味十足！
地道街头风味，酸甜辣平衡得恰到好处，吃完还想再来两份

description.zh: 以鸡腿肉或牛肉为主料，椰奶慢炖的泰式红咖喱，口感柔滑微辣，风味浓郁鲜香带椰香与香茅辛香。
description.en: A Thai red curry made with chicken or beef simmered in coconut milk, featuring creamy texture, moderate heat, and aromatic notes of lemongrass, kaffir lime, and roasted red chilies.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢微辣、爱椰香风味且追求异国主菜体验的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those who enjoy mild spice, rich coconut aroma, and authentic Thai main course flavors.

caution: 辣度中等（3/5），含花生酱和椰奶，对花生或乳制品过敏者慎选。
allergens: 椰子（视为树坚果类过敏原）

reviews.content: 椰奶香浓不腻，鸡肉嫩滑入味，红咖喱的辛香层次分明，地道泰味！
辣度适中，配米饭绝佳，竹笋和小茄子增添了清爽口感。

names: แกงเขียวหวาน

description.zh: 鸡肉与青咖喱酱慢炖，椰奶增香，口感柔嫩微辣，风味鲜香浓郁带草本清香。
description.en: Tender chicken simmered in aromatic green curry paste with coconut milk, offering a fragrant, herbaceous flavor with balanced heat and creamy richness.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢东南亚风味、能接受中等辣度的食客，初尝泰餐者亦可尝试。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those who enjoy bold Southeast Asian flavors and moderate spice; approachable for Thai cuisine newcomers.

caution: 中辣（辣度3/5），含花生、大豆、小麦，分量适中。

reviews.content: 青咖喱香气扑鼻，椰奶平衡得恰到好处，鸡肉滑嫩不柴，圣罗勒提味绝了！
辣度友好，蔬菜新鲜爽脆，汤汁拌饭一流，吃完口齿留香。

description.zh: 以南瓜、秋葵、豆角、空心菜等时蔬为主，清炖而成，汤色澄黄，口感清爽顺滑，突出鲜香微辣与天然甜味。
description.en: A light Thai herbal soup made by gently simmering seasonal vegetables like pumpkin, okra, long beans, and water spinach with lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, and chili. Fresh, fragrant, mildly spicy, and subtly sweet.

recommendation.zh: 适合清淡饮食者、素食者及夏日开胃需求者，健康低脂又暖胃。
recommendation.en: Ideal for health-conscious, vegetarian, or heat-sensitive diners seeking a refreshing, nourishing starter.

caution: 微辣（辣度2），不含常见过敏原，分量适中。

reviews.content: 汤头清亮鲜甜，蔬菜软嫩不烂，喝完喉咙舒服，夏天喝超解腻！
香茅和青柠叶香气很正，辣度刚好，素食者也能安心享用的暖心汤品。

names: แกงเผ็ดเป็ดย่าง

description.zh: 烤鸭肉配红咖喱酱炖煮，鸭肉酥香软嫩，酱汁浓郁微辣带椰香与香茅鲜香。
description.en: Roasted duck simmered in aromatic Thai red curry paste with coconut milk, lemongrass, and kaffir lime—rich, fragrant, mildly spicy, and tender.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢浓郁风味和烟熏鸭肉的食客，适合嗜辣但不追求极致辣度者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for curry lovers who enjoy smoky duck and balanced heat without overwhelming spice.

caution: 中辣（3/5），含花生、大豆、小麦，分量适中偏足。

reviews.content: 鸭肉烤得恰到好处，咖喱香浓不腻，椰香与香茅层次分明，回味悠长。
辣度友好，鸭肉入味软嫩，配米饭非常满足，唯一建议可减盐。

description.zh: 鸡腿肉裹薄粉油炸，外皮金黄酥脆，内里多汁鲜嫩，融合鱼露、蒜香与微甜泰式风味。
description.en: Crispy fried chicken pieces made with marinated chicken thigh, coated in light batter and deep-fried until golden. Juicy inside with savory-sweet Thai flavors from fish sauce, garlic, and palm sugar.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢酥脆口感和地道泰式咸鲜风味的食客首选，适合初次尝试泰国菜的人。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those who love crispy textures and authentic Thai umami-sweet notes—great for first-time Thai cuisine explorers.

caution: 较油腻；含小麦、鸡蛋；辣度低但可选配辣酱

reviews.content: 外皮咔嚓酥脆，鸡肉完全不柴，蒜香鱼露味特别正宗！
分量实在，配米饭或啤酒都很棒，小朋友也爱吃。

names: แกงเขียวหวาน

description.zh: 以鸡腿肉或牛肉为主料，椰奶炖煮而成，口感柔滑微辣，香气浓郁带青柠与香茅的清新辛香。
description.en: Aromatic Thai curry made with chicken or beef, simmered in coconut milk with green chilies, lemongrass, and kaffir lime leaves—creamy, herbaceous, and moderately spicy.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢香辣风味、追求地道泰式体验的食客首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers and those seeking authentic, aromatic Thai flavors.

caution: 辣度中高，含椰奶和鱼露，对坚果过敏者慎选（部分店家加花生）。

reviews.content: 椰香与青柠香完美融合，辣度适中，鸡肉嫩滑不柴。
汤汁浓郁下饭，蔬菜保留脆感，是平衡感极佳的泰式主菜。

description.zh: 新鲜蚝肉与鸡蛋、红薯粉浆混合煎制，外酥里嫩，鲜香浓郁带微咸鲜与焦香
description.en: Fresh oysters mixed with egg and sweet potato starch batter, pan-fried until golden and crisp outside, tender and juicy inside, savory, umami-rich with a subtle briny sweetness.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢海鲜和酥脆口感者必试；适合初次体验泰式街头风味的食客
recommendation.en: Ideal for seafood lovers and those seeking authentic Thai street food crunch and umami.

caution: 含贝类，较油腻，分量适中，微辣

reviews.content: 蚝肉饱满多汁，外皮酥脆不腻，鱼露香气提味绝了！
豆芽和韭菜增添清爽口感，酥脆度恰到好处，配冰镇柠檬水超搭

description.zh: 以大米慢熬而成的绵滑泰式白粥，口感软糯顺滑，咸鲜微甜，常配肉末、皮蛋、油条和香葱提味。
description.en: A comforting Thai rice porridge made by slow-simmering glutinous rice until creamy and smooth, seasoned with savory-sweet broth and topped with minced pork, century egg, crispy fried dough, and scallions.

recommendation.zh: 肠胃敏感者、晨起食欲弱者或需温和暖胃的人群首选早餐。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those with sensitive stomachs, low morning appetite, or needing gentle, warming nourishment.

caution: 含小麦（油条）、可能含鸡蛋（可选配料），分量适中不油腻。

reviews.content: 粥体绵密不糊口，肉末鲜嫩，皮蛋香气恰到好处，暖胃又舒服。
油条吸饱粥汁后酥中带韧，搭配清葱解腻，早餐幸福感满分。

description.zh: 以发酵米浆制成的细软米线为主料，冷食或温热搭配多种泰式咖喱酱汁，口感滑弹清爽，风味酸辣鲜香、层次丰富。
description.en: Fresh, fermented rice noodles served chilled or warm with aromatic Thai curry sauces; smooth, springy texture with vibrant sour-spicy-umami balance.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢酸辣开胃、追求地道泰式风味的食客首选，适合夏日消暑或口味探索者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers and those seeking authentic, refreshing Thai flavors—perfect for hot days or culinary adventurers.

caution: 辣度可调但传统款偏辣；含鱼露（含鱼类过敏原）；分量适中。

reviews.content: 米线滑嫩弹牙，咖喱酱酸辣恰到好处，吃完满口生津，地道泰味太惊艳！
酱料丰富可选，推荐绿咖喱款，椰香与辣味融合得非常和谐。

description.zh: 椰浆、糯米粉与鸡蛋制成，铜模小火煎烤，外微脆内软糯，椰香浓郁带微甜
description.en: Made with coconut milk, glutinous rice flour, and eggs, cooked in bronze molds over low heat—crispy-edged, tender-centered, richly coconut-scented and subtly sweet.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢温和甜点和椰香风味的人，尤其适合初次尝试泰式街头小吃的食客
recommendation.en: Ideal for coconut lovers and first-time Thai street food explorers seeking gentle sweetness.

caution: 含鸡蛋和牛奶，分量小巧，非辣食

reviews.content: 椰香扑鼻，外脆里嫩，一口一个停不下来，地道泰式童年味道
甜度恰到好处，不腻不齁，热乎时吃最能感受米浆的柔滑香气

description.zh: 糯米粉与鸡蛋制成酥脆薄饼，夹入甜豆沙与椰丝，外脆内软，甜香微咸，椰香浓郁
description.en: Crispy rice-flour crepes filled with sweet mung bean paste and toasted coconut, pan-fried until golden—crunchy exterior, soft filling, balanced sweet-savory coconut aroma.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢清爽甜点、不喜油腻者及椰子爱好者首选
recommendation.en: Ideal for those who love light, fragrant desserts and coconut-forward flavors.

caution: 含鸡蛋和小麦，分量小巧，微甜不腻

reviews.content: 饼皮酥得恰到好处，豆沙细腻不齁甜，椰香扑鼻，一口回到清迈街头
传统做法还原度高，甜度克制，适合饭后解腻，但椰丝略少

names: ข้าวคลุกกะปิ

description.zh: 米饭拌发酵虾酱，加入炸猪皮、青豆、腌萝卜等，口感丰富，咸鲜浓郁带微酸微辣
description.en: Steamed jasmine rice tossed with pungent fermented shrimp paste (kapi), crispy pork rinds, green beans, pickled radish, and chili—savory, umami-rich, tangy, and mildly spicy.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢重口味和地道泰式风味的食客首选，适合探索东南亚发酵风味者
recommendation.en: Ideal for adventurous eaters who love bold, umami-forward Southeast Asian flavors.

caution: 含虾酱和炸猪皮，较咸且有甲壳类过敏原

reviews.content: 虾酱香气扑鼻，炸猪皮酥脆提香，酸辣平衡得恰到好处！
地道泰式下饭菜，分量足，配一杯冰椰水解腻绝了

names: ข้าวมันไก่

description.zh: 嫩滑白切鸡配姜香鸡油饭，米饭油润软糯，鸡肉鲜嫩多汁，蘸酱酸辣微甜，整体咸鲜清爽。
description.en: Tender poached chicken served with fragrant ginger-infused rice cooked in chicken fat; accompanied by tangy-sweet chili-ginger sauce. Silky texture, savory, aromatic, and refreshingly balanced.

recommendation.zh: 适合初次尝试泰餐者或偏好清淡鲜香口味的食客，老少皆宜。
recommendation.en: Ideal for Thai cuisine newcomers or those who prefer mild, savory, and aromatic dishes.

caution: 含鸡肉和大豆（酱料中），分量适中，微辣（可选辣度）

reviews.content: 鸡肉嫩得入口即化，鸡油饭香气扑鼻，酱汁开胃又不抢味，地道泰式家常味！
米饭粒粒分明油润不腻，搭配自制辣椒酱层次丰富，温和暖胃很治愈。

names: ข้าวหมกไก่

description.zh: 以香料腌制鸡肉，与姜黄饭同锅焖煮，米饭金黄油润，鸡肉鲜嫩多汁，风味浓郁咸鲜带微甜。
description.en: Fragrant marinated chicken slow-cooked with turmeric-infused jasmine rice; tender, juicy meat and aromatic, golden, slightly sweet, savory rice.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢浓郁香料风味、追求饱腹感的食客，尤其推荐给初次尝试泰式主食者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice-curious diners seeking a satisfying, aromatic Thai comfort meal.

caution: 含小麦（鱼露）、中等分量、微辣（可选辣度）

reviews.content: 姜黄饭香气扑鼻，鸡肉嫩而不柴，酱汁拌饭绝了！
香料层次丰富，不腻口，配腌萝卜解腻很到位。

names: ข้าวเหนียวมะม่วง

description.zh: 香甜芒果配蒸熟糯米饭，淋椰奶酱汁，口感软糯微弹，风味甜润奶香浓郁。
description.en: Steamed glutinous rice served with ripe mango slices and sweetened coconut milk sauce; soft, chewy texture with rich, creamy sweetness.

recommendation.zh: 喜甜食者、热带水果爱好者及初次尝试泰式甜品的人首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for dessert lovers and those new to Thai sweets—refreshing, approachable, and authentically tropical.

caution: 含牛奶与椰奶，甜度较高，分量适中

reviews.content: 芒果新鲜多汁，糯米饭软而不烂，椰奶香浓不腻，泰式甜品天花板！
甜度恰到好处，冷藏后更清爽，适合夏日解暑。

description.zh: 米饭与鸡蛋、虾仁、鸡肉或猪肉同炒，镬气十足，粒粒分明，咸鲜微甜，略带鱼露香气。
description.en: Fried rice with jasmine rice, egg, and choice of shrimp, chicken, or pork, wok-tossed for smoky aroma and distinct grains; savory-sweet with umami depth from fish sauce.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢经典泰餐、追求饱腹感与镬气风味的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those craving authentic, satisfying Thai comfort food with bold wok-hei flavor.

caution: 含鸡蛋和鱼露；辣度可调；分量扎实。

reviews.content: 米饭干爽不腻，虾仁Q弹，鱼露香气恰到好处，地道泰式镬气！
分量足味道正，配黄瓜片解腻，是忙碌午餐的完美选择。

description.zh: 椰奶咖喱汤底炖煮的鸡蛋面，配鸡/牛肉与炸面酥，口感浓滑微辣，风味鲜香浓郁带奶香与南姜辛香。
description.en: Creamy coconut curry broth simmered with egg noodles, tender chicken or beef, pickled mustard greens, and crispy fried noodles—rich, fragrant, mildly spicy, and luxuriously smooth.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢浓郁咖喱风味、追求暖胃饱腹感的食客首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for curry lovers and those seeking a hearty, comforting noodle meal.

caution: 含牛奶、小麦、花生；中辣；分量足，易饱。

reviews.content: 椰奶香和咖喱味完美融合，炸面酥增添绝妙口感层次！
汤头醇厚不腻，鸡肉嫩滑，酸辣平衡得恰到好处。

description.zh: 鸡胸肉与圣罗勒快火爆炒，口感鲜嫩微韧，风味辛辣鲜香，伴蒜香与鱼露咸鲜底味。
description.en: Stir-fried chicken breast with holy basil, garlic, chilies and fish sauce; savory, spicy, aromatic, with tender-crisp texture and bold umami depth.

recommendation.zh: 嗜辣者与追求地道泰式风味的食客首选，开胃下饭效果极佳。
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers and those seeking authentic Thai street-food flavor—great for appetite stimulation and rice pairing.

caution: 辣度较高，含鱼露（含小麦、大豆），分量适中偏足。

reviews.content: 圣罗勒香气扑鼻，鸡肉嫩而不柴，辣得过瘾又不掩鲜味！
鱼露提鲜恰到好处，配米饭一扫而光，是记忆中的曼谷街头味道。

names: คั่วเมี่ยง

description.zh: 米粉为主料，干炒至微焦香脆，口感干爽弹牙，风味咸鲜带微甜与淡淡鱼露香气。
description.en: Stir-fried rice noodles with garlic, soy sauce, and fish sauce; cooked dry until slightly crisp and springy, delivering savory-sweet umami depth with aromatic garlic notes.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢干香口感、追求地道泰式街头风味的食客首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for noodle lovers seeking authentic, aromatic Thai street food with bold yet balanced flavor.

caution: 含鱼露（海鲜过敏慎点），中辣，分量适中。

reviews.content: 米粉干香不腻，蒜香扑鼻，鱼露提鲜恰到好处，一口回到曼谷夜市！
锅气十足，蛋香与豆芽清脆相得益彰，微辣度适合大多数人的口味。

names: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวน้ำ

description.zh: 泰式米线配清甜牛骨高汤，慢炖入味，汤头鲜香清爽，米粉滑嫩弹牙，佐以豆芽、青柠与香草提味。
description.en: Rice noodles in a clear, fragrant Thai beef bone broth, slow-simmered for depth; tender, springy noodles with crisp bean sprouts, lime, and fresh herbs.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢清淡鲜香汤品、追求暖胃舒适感的食客，尤其适合微凉天气或肠胃敏感者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those seeking a light, comforting, aromatic soup—great for cool days or sensitive stomachs.

caution: 含小麦（米粉）、牛肉；辣度可调，建议初尝者选微辣。

reviews.content: 汤头清澈却滋味丰盈，米粉Q弹不糊，青柠一挤瞬间点亮整碗，喝完全身暖洋洋！
牛肉嫩而不柴，香草和豆芽带来清新口感，比普通汤粉更显层次与平衡。

description.zh: 鸡胸肉末炒香后拌入青柠汁、鱼露、辣椒、香草，口感鲜嫩微脆，风味酸辣清爽带鲜香。
description.en: Minced chicken breast stir-fried until fragrant, then tossed with lime juice, fish sauce, chilies, and fresh herbs. Bright, spicy, tangy, and herbaceous with tender-crisp texture.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢酸辣开胃、追求低脂健康饮食的食客首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for health-conscious diners who love bold, zesty, low-fat flavors.

caution: 辣度中高，含鱼露（含小麦/大豆），分量适中

reviews.content: 酸辣平衡绝妙，鸡肉嫩而不柴，香草清香提神！
开胃效果一流，配米饭解辣又满足，夏日必点。

description.zh: 以猪肉末或鸡肉末为主料，拌入烤香米饭、青柠汁、鱼露、辣椒和新鲜香草，口感清爽微辣，风味酸咸鲜辣平衡。
description.en: Minced pork or chicken tossed with toasted rice, lime juice, fish sauce, fresh chilies, and herbs; bright, tangy, spicy, and umami-rich with a light, textured bite.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢酸辣开胃、追求地道泰式风味的食客首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers and those seeking authentic, vibrant Thai flavors in a light dish.

caution: 辣度较高，含鱼露（含小麦/大豆），分量适中。

reviews.content: 酸辣恰到好处，香草清香扑鼻，吃完胃口大开！
烤米粒增添独特焦香，肉末嫩而不腻，泰式风味很正。

description.zh: 以绿豆淀粉制成的细软粉条，煮后浸冰水，配椰奶、糖水与碎冰，口感滑糯微弹，风味清甜椰香浓郁。
description.en: Soft, chewy rice-and-mung-bean starch noodles boiled and chilled, served with sweetened coconut milk, palm sugar syrup, and crushed ice—creamy, refreshing, and delicately sweet.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢清爽甜品、怕腻怕热者首选，尤其适合夏日解暑或餐后清口。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those seeking a light, cooling dessert—perfect after spicy meals or on hot days.

caution: 含椰奶（乳制品），甜度较高，分量适中

reviews.content: 粉条Q弹不糊，椰奶香浓不腻，冰凉顺滑，一口回到清迈街头！
甜度刚好，冰镇后口感层次丰富，解腻效果一流，夏天必点。

names: ข้าวเหนียวมะม่วง

description.zh: 泰国经典甜品，用椰浆煮熟的糯米饭搭配成熟芒果，口感软糯香滑，风味清甜中带浓郁奶香与果香。
description.en: Thai classic dessert featuring glutinous rice cooked in sweetened coconut milk, served with ripe mango—creamy, chewy, and delicately sweet with rich coconut and tropical fruit notes.

recommendation.zh: 喜甜食者、热带水果爱好者及初次尝试泰餐者首选，清爽不腻，老少皆宜。
recommendation.en: Ideal for dessert lovers, mango fans, and first-time Thai diners—refreshing, approachable, and universally appealing.

caution: 含椰奶（牛奶过敏者慎食），甜度较高，分量适中

reviews.content: 芒果香甜多汁，糯米饭吸饱椰浆，软糯不粘牙，甜度恰到好处！
传统做法正宗，椰香浓郁，搭配新鲜芒果，夏日解暑首选。

names: แกงมัสมั่น

description.zh: 以牛肉或鸡肉为主料，慢炖于椰奶酱汁中，口感醇厚柔滑，风味融合南洋香料与微甜微辣的浓郁异域香气。
description.en: Tender beef or chicken slow-simmered in rich coconut milk with roasted Massaman curry paste, peanuts, and tamarind—creamy, aromatic, subtly sweet and mildly spicy.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢温和香料、不耐高辣但追求层次风味的食客，尤其推荐给初次尝试泰餐者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice-sensitive diners and Thai cuisine newcomers seeking complex, comforting flavors without heat overload.

caution: 含花生与椰奶，辣度较低但分量较足

reviews.content: 椰香与肉香交融，花生增添脆香，甜辣平衡得恰到好处，暖心又满足。
酱汁浓稠入味，土豆绵软吸饱汤汁，配米饭堪称泰式慢炖典范。

description.zh: 炸至金黄酥脆的细米粉，配以虾仁、豆芽、韭菜和酸甜咸鲜的鱼露糖醋汁，口感层次丰富，外脆内韧，酸甜微咸带鲜香。
description.en: Crispy fried rice noodles tossed with shrimp, bean sprouts, garlic chives, and a tangy-sweet-savory tamarind-fish sauce dressing. Light, crunchy, and boldly flavored.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢酥脆口感与复合酸甜味的食客，或想尝试经典泰式街头风味的初体验者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for texture lovers and those seeking authentic Thai street food flavors.

caution: 含花生与虾，略油腻，辣度可调

reviews.content: 酥脆米粉裹着酸甜酱汁太上头！虾仁新鲜，花生香脆，一口停不下来。
酸甜平衡得恰到好处，酥脆感保持得很好，适合配冰啤酒解腻。

description.zh: 精选猪肩肉腌制后炭火烤制，外微焦香、内多汁嫩滑，咸鲜带甜，伴有微微烟熏与香料芬芳。
description.en: Marinated pork shoulder skewers grilled over charcoal—tender, juicy, with savory-sweet notes, subtle smokiness, and aromatic Thai spices.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢街头风味、追求香嫩口感的食客首选，适合初次尝试泰餐者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for street food lovers and first-time Thai cuisine explorers seeking bold, approachable flavor.

caution: 含少量糖和鱼露；辣度可调；每串约30g，建议点3串起。

reviews.content: 肉质超嫩不柴，酱汁咸甜平衡，炭火香扑鼻，一口就爱上！
腌得入味，外皮微脆内里多汁，配冰啤酒绝了！

names: น้ำพริกอ่อง

description.zh: 以猪肉末、番茄、干辣椒为主料炒制而成，口感微稠带颗粒感，酸辣开胃，融合罗勒与虾酱的泰北独特鲜香。
description.en: A northern Thai chili dip made by stir-frying ground pork, tomatoes, and dried chilies with shrimp paste and holy basil; savory, tangy, moderately spicy, with a rustic, slightly chunky texture.

recommendation.zh: 嗜辣者与东南亚风味爱好者必试，适合想体验地道泰北家常风味的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers and Southeast Asian food enthusiasts seeking authentic northern Thai home-style flavor.

caution: 辣度中高，含虾酱和大豆，慎选过敏者

reviews.content: 酸辣平衡绝妙，番茄的微甜完美中和辣度，罗勒香气扑鼻，下饭无敌！
虾酱风味醇厚不腥，肉末酥香有嚼劲，蘸生菜吃清爽解腻。

description.zh: 以炭烤牛肉为主料，切薄片后拌入青木瓜丝、香草与酸辣鱼露汁，口感鲜嫩微韧，风味酸辣清爽带焦香。
description.en: Grilled beef slices tossed with shredded green papaya, mint, cilantro, shallots, and a vibrant dressing of lime juice, fish sauce, chili, and roasted rice powder—tangy, spicy, herbaceous, and texturally lively.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢酸辣开胃、追求清爽口感的食客，尤其适合夏日或油腻餐后解腻。
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers and those seeking a bright, refreshing salad after rich meals or in hot weather.

caution: 辣度中高，含鱼露（含大豆/海鲜），分量适中偏小

reviews.content: 牛肉焦香十足，青木瓜脆爽解腻，酸辣平衡得恰到好处，一口上瘾！
香草新鲜量足，鱼露咸鲜不齁，辣度够劲但不烧喉，很地道的泰式风味。

description.zh: 新鲜生蚝与鸡蛋、豆芽、韭菜混合煎制，外酥里嫩，鲜香浓郁带微焦香气。
description.en: Fresh oysters pan-fried with eggs, bean sprouts, and Chinese chives until golden-crisp outside and tender inside—savory, umami-rich with a subtle smoky edge.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢海鲜与焦香口感者必试，适合初次体验泰式街头风味的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for seafood lovers and first-time Thai street food explorers seeking bold, authentic flavor.

caution: 含贝类，分量适中，微辣不油腻

reviews.content: 生蚝饱满多汁，蛋饼酥脆不腻，蘸鱼露青柠汁绝配！
镬气十足，鲜味扑鼻，比普通蚝烙更清爽不厚重。

description.zh: 小麦粉制成的油炸面食，外皮金黄酥脆，内里微韧带气孔，咸香微甜，带有焦香与米酒发酵风味。
description.en: Thai-style fried dough sticks made from wheat flour, deep-fried until golden and crisp outside with a slightly chewy, airy interior; savory-sweet with subtle fermented rice wine aroma.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢传统油条口感又想尝试泰式风味的早餐爱好者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for breakfast lovers seeking crispy, nostalgic fried dough with authentic Thai flair.

caution: 较油腻；含小麦和鸡蛋；分量适中。

reviews.content: 外酥里软，带着淡淡米酒香，蘸炼乳绝了！
比中式油条更轻盈，早餐配咖啡刚刚好。

description.zh: 猪肉末快炒圣罗勒，镬气十足，咸鲜微辣，香气浓烈，口感干香带脆感。
description.en: Stir-fried minced pork with holy basil, garlic, chilies and fish sauce; savory, spicy, aromatic, with a dry, crisp texture and bold wok hei.

recommendation.zh: 嗜辣者与追求地道泰式风味的食客首选，下饭解腻又过瘾。
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers and those seeking authentic, bold Thai street food flavor.

caution: 辣度较高，含鱼露和大豆，分量适中偏小。

reviews.content: 镬气扑鼻，圣罗勒香气纯正，辣得爽快又不掩肉香！
辣度可调，配米饭一绝，但圣罗勒量足才够地道。

names: ผัดพริกขิง

description.zh: 猪肉丝与青红椒、圣女果快炒，姜末与干红椒爆香，口感鲜辣微麻，风味浓郁咸鲜带微甜
description.en: Stir-fried pork strips with green and red chilies, cherry tomatoes, ginger, and dried chilies—savory, spicy, slightly sweet, with bold aroma and tender-crisp texture.

recommendation.zh: 嗜辣者与喜欢浓郁泰式风味的人必点，下饭开胃效果极佳
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers and those craving bold, aromatic Thai flavors—it’s deeply satisfying and perfect with rice.

caution: 辣度较高（中高辣），含花生与大豆，分量适中

reviews.content: 姜香与辣味层层递进，猪肉滑嫩不柴，花生增添香脆层次感
辣得过瘾但不燥口，配米饭一扫而光，家常又地道的泰北风味

description.zh: 宽河粉配鸡蛋、豆芽和青菜，快火炒制，酱香浓郁、咸鲜微甜，口感滑嫩弹牙。
description.en: Wide rice noodles stir-fried with eggs, bean sprouts, and Chinese broccoli in dark soy sauce—savory, slightly sweet, with tender-chewy texture and rich umami.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢咸鲜酱香、追求饱腹感的食客首选，适合不嗜辣但爱浓郁风味的人。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those who love savory-sweet umami flavors and hearty, non-spicy noodle dishes.

caution: 含大豆（酱油）、小麦（面条），中等油量，微咸，不辣。

reviews.content: 酱香扑鼻，河粉吸足酱汁却不软烂，鸡蛋嫩滑，豆芽脆爽，层次太丰富了！
分量实在，咸甜平衡得恰到好处，吃完满足感强，是经典泰式家常味。

description.zh: 河粉配虾仁、豆腐干、豆芽快炒，口感柔韧微弹，酸甜咸鲜交融，略带焦香与鱼露醇厚风味
description.en: Stir-fried rice noodles with shrimp, firm tofu, bean sprouts, and tamarind sauce—chewy, tangy-sweet, savory, and aromatic with a hint of smoky wok hei.

recommendation.zh: 适合初次尝试泰餐者及喜欢酸甜口味的食客，老少皆宜，接受度高
recommendation.en: Ideal for Thai food newcomers and those who love balanced sweet-sour flavors—widely appealing and approachable.

caution: 含花生与鱼露，可能偏咸，辣度可调

reviews.content: 酸甜比例绝妙，河粉不糊不硬，花生香脆，鱼露提鲜不腥
锅气十足，虾仁Q弹，豆芽清脆，整体层次丰富又不腻

names: ผัดไทยกุ้ง

description.zh: 鲜虾仁与宽河粉快炒，口感滑嫩弹牙，酸甜微辣，裹着鱼露、青柠与花生的复合泰式鲜香。
description.en: Stir-fried wide rice noodles with plump shrimp, tamarind sauce, fish sauce, lime, and roasted peanuts—tangy, sweet, savory, and slightly spicy with springy texture.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢酸甜微辣、追求地道泰味的食客首选，新手亦可轻松接受。
recommendation.en: Ideal for lovers of tangy-sweet umami flavors; approachable for Thai cuisine beginners.

caution: 含甲壳类海鲜，辣度可调，分量适中偏足。

reviews.content: 虾仁饱满入味，河粉不糊不硬，酸甜平衡得恰到好处！
花生香脆提味，青柠汁最后淋上太点睛，吃完口齿生津。

description.zh: 以牛肉或鸡肉为主料，椰奶慢炖而成，口感浓稠顺滑，风味咸鲜微辣，带有烤花生与香茅的复合香气。
description.en: A Thai curry made with beef or chicken simmered in rich coconut milk, resulting in a thick, creamy texture with savory, mildly spicy flavors and aromatic notes of roasted peanuts and lemongrass.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢浓郁口感又怕太辣的食客，是初次尝试泰式咖喱的理想选择。
recommendation.en: Ideal for curry newcomers or those who prefer rich flavor without intense heat.

caution: 含花生与椰奶，辣度中等偏下，分量适中。

reviews.content: 椰香浓郁不腻，花生碎增添香气和层次感，辣度刚好开胃。
酱汁醇厚挂饭一流，肉质软嫩，比绿咖喱更温和易接受。

names: ปลาราดพริก

description.zh: 新鲜海鱼煎至外酥里嫩，淋上酸辣咸鲜的泰式辣椒酱汁，口感酥脆与柔嫩并存，风味层次丰富、开胃爽口。
description.en: Crispy pan-fried whole fish topped with a vibrant, tangy-spicy Thai chili sauce; tender flesh contrasts with a crisp skin, delivering bold umami, heat, and citrusy brightness.

recommendation.zh: 嗜辣者与喜欢东南亚风味的人必点，适合想体验地道泰式主菜的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers and those seeking authentic, bold Thai flavors in a satisfying main course.

caution: 辣度高，含鱼和少量芝麻，分量足宜2人共享。
ingredients: 海鱼（常用罗非鱼或鲳鱼）

reviews.content: 鱼皮酥到掉渣，酱汁酸辣平衡绝了，米饭拌着吃太上头！
辣得过瘾但不烧胃，鱼肉鲜嫩多汁，配冰啤酒超解腻。

description.zh: 以鸡肉或牛肉为主料，椰奶炖煮而成，口感柔滑微辣，风味浓郁鲜香带椰甜与香茅辛香。
description.en: A Thai classic made with chicken or beef simmered in coconut milk, red curry paste, and aromatic herbs; creamy, moderately spicy, fragrant with lemongrass and kaffir lime.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢微辣、爱椰香风味的食客，初次尝试泰餐者友好。
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice newcomers and coconut lovers—balanced heat and rich aroma make it approachable yet authentic.

caution: 中高辣度，含花生与大豆，分量适中偏足。

reviews.content: 椰香醇厚不腻，辣度刚好唤醒味蕾，鸡肉嫩滑入味！
香料层次丰富，配米饭绝了，唯一建议可减盐更健康。

description.zh: 椰奶、碎冰、红豆、西米、玉米、芋圆等混合制成，冰凉绵密，甜润清爽带椰香
description.en: A refreshing Thai dessert made with shaved ice, sweetened coconut milk, red beans, tapioca pearls, corn, taro balls, and more—creamy, sweet, and delicately fragrant.

recommendation.zh: 怕热、喜甜、爱尝鲜的食客首选，尤其适合夏日解暑
recommendation.en: Ideal for heat-sensitive or sweet-toothed diners seeking a cool, satisfying summer treat.

caution: 含牛奶与小麦成分，分量较大，甜度较高

reviews.content: 椰香浓郁，冰沙细腻不呛喉，八种料搭配丰富又不腻
分量实在，红豆软烂入味，芋圆Q弹，解暑效果一流

description.zh: 鸡肉或牛肉切条腌制后炭火烤制，外微焦内多汁，咸鲜微甜带微辣，佐以浓香花生酱。
description.en: Marinated chicken or beef skewers grilled over charcoal, tender and juicy with a smoky char; served with rich, creamy peanut sauce offering savory-sweet-spicy depth.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢烧烤风味和浓郁酱香的食客，适合初次尝试泰式街头美食者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for barbecue lovers and first-time Thai street food explorers seeking bold, approachable flavors.

caution: 含花生；中等辣度；分量适中，易上瘾。

reviews.content: 花生酱香浓不腻，肉质鲜嫩多汁，炭火香气十足，地道泰式风味！
酱料层次丰富，微辣提味不刺激，配米饭或啤酒都绝配。

description.zh: 青木瓜丝为主料，手工舂制而成，口感爽脆，酸辣开胃，融合鱼露鲜香与青柠清香。
description.en: Shredded unripe papaya pounded with chilies, garlic, green beans, cherry tomatoes, lime juice, fish sauce, and palm sugar—crisp, tangy, spicy, and umami-rich.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢酸辣清爽口味、追求低卡健康饮食的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers and health-conscious diners seeking a vibrant, low-calorie meal.

caution: 辣度较高，含鱼露和花生，慎选过敏者

reviews.content: 酸辣平衡绝妙，木瓜脆度十足，开胃解腻一绝！
传统舂制风味正宗，花生香脆，鱼露鲜味提神醒脑。

description.zh: 青木瓜丝为主料，手工舂制，口感爽脆，酸辣开胃，融合鱼露鲜香与青柠清香。
description.en: Shredded unripe green papaya pounded with chilies, garlic, lime juice, fish sauce, and palm sugar; crisp, tangy, spicy, and umami-rich.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜酸辣、追求清爽口感或想体验地道泰式风味的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers and those seeking authentic, vibrant Thai flavors.

caution: 辣度较高，含鱼露和花生，分量适中

reviews.content: 酸辣平衡绝妙，木瓜脆度十足，吃完满口生津，泰餐灵魂之作！
传统舂制工艺保留风味层次，花生香脆加分，微辣更易接受。

description.zh: 浓烈烘焙泰式咖啡粉经反复滴滤，混合炼乳与冰块，口感顺滑微稠，风味香甜醇厚带焦苦回甘
description.en: Strongly roasted Thai coffee grounds are drip-brewed slowly, then mixed with sweetened condensed milk and served over ice—creamy, rich, bittersweet, and refreshingly chilled.

recommendation.zh: 适合咖啡爱好者或需提神者，尤其喜爱甜苦平衡风味的人群
recommendation.en: Ideal for coffee lovers or anyone needing an energizing, sweet-bitter pick-me-up.

caution: 含乳糖和添加糖，分量偏甜

reviews.content: 炼乳与咖啡融合绝妙，冰凉顺滑不腻，午后提神首选！
焦香咖啡味足，甜度适中，比普通冰咖啡更有层次感

description.zh: 以锡兰红茶为基底，加入炼乳与淡奶冷泡调制，口感顺滑浓郁，甜中带微苦，奶香醇厚，冰凉沁爽。
description.en: Brewed strong Ceylon black tea chilled and mixed with sweetened condensed milk and evaporated milk. Creamy, rich, sweet with subtle tannic bitterness and refreshing coolness.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢甜饮、怕苦茶客或夏日解暑者首选，适合不习惯纯茶苦涩的人群。
recommendation.en: Ideal for sweet-toothed drinkers, tea beginners, or anyone seeking a refreshing, non-bitter iced beverage on hot days.

caution: 含乳制品，糖分较高，不适宜控糖人群。

reviews.content: 奶香扑鼻，甜度刚好，冰凉顺滑，喝完瞬间降温，泰餐绝配！
茶香和奶味平衡得恰到好处，不会过腻，冰镇后风味更突出。

names: ปอเปี๊ยะทอด

description.zh: 以米粉皮包裹胡萝卜、豆芽、香菇与猪肉，油炸至金黄酥脆，外脆内润，咸鲜微甜带香草清香。
description.en: Crispy fried rice paper rolls stuffed with shredded carrots, mung bean sprouts, wood ear mushrooms, and seasoned pork; savory-sweet with herbal freshness and a light crunch.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢酥脆口感和地道泰式风味的食客，初次尝试泰国菜的理想入门前菜。
recommendation.en: Great for first-time Thai food explorers or anyone craving crispy, flavorful appetizers.

caution: 含小麦和花生，油炸较油腻，辣度低但可蘸辣酱

reviews.content: 外皮酥到掉渣，内馅多汁不干，薄荷香提味绝了！
比普通春卷更清爽不腻，蘸甜辣酱风味层次丰富。

description.zh: 椰奶、鸡肉、香茅、南姜与香菇炖煮而成，汤体柔滑微稠，酸辣鲜香，椰香浓郁带清冽草本气息。
description.en: A fragrant Thai coconut soup simmered with chicken, lemongrass, galangal, and straw mushrooms—creamy, tangy, spicy, and herbaceous with a silky texture.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢酸辣开胃、追求异国风味又怕太刺激的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those who love bold, aromatic flavors but prefer mild heat and comforting richness.

caution: 含椰奶（乳制品替代品），辣度中等，分量适中

reviews.content: 酸辣平衡绝妙，椰香不腻，喝一口就暖到胃里！
香茅和南姜香气扑鼻，鸡肉嫩滑，是冬日治愈系热汤。

description.zh: 以猪排骨为主料，慢炖而成的泰式酸辣汤，汤色清亮，口感清爽开胃，突出香茅、青柠与辣椒的复合酸辣鲜香。
description.en: A Thai sour-spicy soup featuring tender pork ribs simmered with lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, chili, and lime juice—bright, tangy, aromatic, and refreshingly light.

recommendation.zh: 适合嗜酸喜辣者、食欲不振时开胃，或夏季消暑解腻首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers, those seeking appetite stimulation, or a refreshing summer meal.

caution: 辣度中高（可选调整），含鱼露（含小麦/大豆）

reviews.content: 酸辣层次分明，排骨软而不烂，喝完浑身通透，开胃效果绝了！
汤底清香扑鼻，青柠和香茅风味十足，辣度够劲但不烧胃。

description.zh: 以鲜虾为主料，酸辣汤底现煮，汤色微浊，口感清爽刺激，突出香茅、青柠叶与辣椒的复合酸辣鲜香。
description.en: A hot and sour Thai soup featuring fresh prawns, simmered with lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, galangal, and chilies for a bold, aromatic, tangy, and spicy flavor with clean, vibrant texture.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢酸辣开胃、追求地道泰式风味的食客，尤其适合湿热天气或食欲不振时享用。
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers and those seeking authentic, appetite-boosting Thai flavors—great on humid days or when craving bold taste.

caution: 辣度高，含甲壳类过敏原，汤量适中偏少

reviews.content: 酸辣平衡绝妙，虾肉弹牙，喝一口瞬间唤醒味蕾！
香茅和青柠香气扑鼻，汤底层次丰富，微辣不燥。

description.zh: 鲜虾为主料，酸辣热汤烹制，口感清爽开胃，融合香茅、柠檬叶、辣椒与鱼露的鲜明酸、辣、鲜、香
description.en: A hot and sour Thai soup featuring fresh shrimp, simmered with lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, chilies, and fish sauce—bright, spicy, tangy, and deeply aromatic.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢酸辣口味、追求开胃醒神的食客首选，适合食欲不振或湿热天气食用
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers and those seeking a refreshing, appetite-boosting starter or light meal.

good_for: 前菜或主菜，适合独食或分享
caution: 辣度较高，含甲壳类海鲜，分量适中偏小

reviews.content: 酸辣平衡绝妙，虾肉弹牙，喝完浑身暖意，开胃效果一流！
香料层次丰富，柠檬叶香气扑鼻，辣度够劲但不烧胃。

names: ทับทิมกรอบ

description.zh: 以红心火龙果丁裹木薯淀粉油炸，配椰奶、碎冰与煮西米，外脆内润，清甜微凉，椰香沁爽。
description.en: Crispy ruby-red dragon fruit cubes coated in tapioca starch and lightly fried, served chilled with sweetened coconut milk, crushed ice, and soft sago pearls—refreshing, sweet, creamy, and delightfully crunchy.

recommendation.zh: 喜清凉甜品者、夏日解暑人群及椰香爱好者首选。
recommendation.en: Perfect for those craving a refreshing, non-baked Thai dessert on hot days or coconut lovers.

caution: 含椰奶（含少量牛奶），分量适中不腻

reviews.content: 外皮酥脆如宝石，果肉多汁清甜，椰奶香浓不腻，一口消暑！
冰凉顺滑，火龙果新鲜度高，适合怕甜腻但爱清爽口感的人。

description.zh: 以嫩牛肉为主料，经快炒或烫熟后与青木瓜丝、洋葱、香草等凉拌，口感爽脆鲜嫩，风味酸辣开胃、层次丰富。
description.en: Sliced tender beef quickly cooked then tossed with shredded green papaya, red onion, chili, lime juice, fish sauce, and fresh herbs. Bright, spicy, tangy, and herbaceous with crisp-tender texture.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢酸辣清爽口味、追求高蛋白低脂饮食的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers and health-conscious diners seeking lean protein and vibrant flavors.

caution: 辣度中高，含鱼露（含小麦、大豆），分量适中

reviews.content: 酸辣平衡绝妙，牛肉嫩滑不柴，青木瓜脆爽解腻，泰式灵魂沙拉！
香草香气扑鼻，辣度够劲但不烧喉，配冰啤酒太完美了。

description.zh: 鲜嫩鱿鱼切圈，焯水后与青木瓜丝、圣女果等凉拌，口感爽脆弹牙，酸辣开胃，鲜香清爽。
description.en: Tender squid rings blanched and tossed with green papaya, cherry tomatoes, herbs, and a zesty lime-chili dressing—crisp, springy, tangy, spicy, and refreshingly aromatic.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢酸辣清爽口感、追求低脂高蛋白的食客首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for health-conscious diners who love bold, refreshing, low-calorie seafood dishes.

caution: 含海鲜及鱼露，辣度中等偏上，慎选肠胃敏感者。

reviews.content: 酸辣平衡绝了！鱿鱼Q弹不腥，青木瓜脆爽解腻，夏天吃超满足。
开胃效果一流，配料丰富有层次，微辣够味但不烧喉。

description.zh: 以长豆为主料凉拌而成，口感爽脆，酸辣开胃，融合鱼露鲜香与青柠清香。
description.en: A refreshing Thai salad made with blanched yard-long beans, tossed in a zesty dressing of lime juice, fish sauce, chilies, and herbs—crisp, tangy, spicy, and umami-rich.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢酸辣清爽口味、追求低脂健康饮食的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers and health-conscious diners seeking a light, vibrant, low-calorie dish.

caution: 辣度中高，含鱼露（含大豆、海鲜），分量适中

reviews.content: 酸辣平衡绝了！长豆脆嫩多汁，花生香脆提味，开胃效果满分。
清爽不腻，配米饭解腻一流，辣度够劲但不烧喉。

names: ยำวุ้นเส้น

description.zh: 以透明粉丝为主料，拌入鲜虾、豆芽、香草等，清爽酸辣，口感弹脆爽口，突出泰式鱼露与青柠的鲜香酸辣风味。
description.en: A refreshing Thai salad made with translucent mung bean noodles, poached shrimp, crisp bean sprouts, herbs, lime juice, fish sauce, and chili—bright, tangy, spicy, and texturally vibrant.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢开胃酸辣口味、追求低脂轻食的食客，尤其适合夏日或餐前唤醒味蕾。
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers and health-conscious diners seeking a light, zesty appetizer.

caution: 含虾和鱼露，辣度中等偏上，分量适中

reviews.content: 酸辣平衡绝妙，粉丝Q弹入味，青柠香气扑鼻，吃完神清气爽！
虾肉鲜甜，配料丰富有层次，微辣不呛，很地道的泰式开胃感。

description.zh: 精选羊肉与少量牛肉剁碎腌制，炭火直烤，外焦里嫩，辣香浓郁，带有烟熏焦香
description.en: Minced lamb and beef marinated with red pepper paste and spices, skewered and grilled over charcoal until charred outside and tender inside, bold, spicy, smoky, and aromatic.

recommendation.zh: 嗜辣者与肉食爱好者必点，追求地道土耳其风味的食客首选
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers and meat enthusiasts seeking authentic Turkish street-food flavor.

caution: 辣度高（建议初尝者慎选），含小麦（烤签可能接触面筋）

reviews.content: 辣得过瘾又不掩肉香，炭火味十足，一口回到阿达纳街头！
肉质细腻多汁，香料层次丰富，配皮塔饼解辣刚刚好。

description.zh: 以脱脂酸奶、冰水和少量盐调制而成，口感稀薄顺滑，风味咸酸清爽，解腻生津。
description.en: A refreshing Turkish drink made by whisking strained yogurt with cold water and a pinch of salt; light, tangy, slightly salty, and ultra-smooth.

recommendation.zh: 适合夏日消暑、餐中解腻或乳糖不耐者（低乳糖）饮用。
recommendation.en: Ideal for hot days, cutting through rich meals, or lactose-sensitive diners seeking a light dairy option.

caution: 含牛奶；无添加糖；分量适中

reviews.content: 酸咸平衡绝妙，喝完口腔瞬间清亮，配烤肉太解腻了！
比普通酸奶饮更轻盈，冰镇后畅快感十足，肠胃友好。

description.zh: 以菲洛酥皮、核桃与开心果为主料，层层叠叠烘烤后浇灌玫瑰糖浆，口感酥脆香甜，风味馥郁微花香。
description.en: Layers of flaky phyllo dough filled with crushed walnuts and pistachios, baked until golden and drenched in fragrant rose-scented syrup—crispy, sweet, and delicately floral.

recommendation.zh: 喜爱甜食、坚果香与层次酥脆感的食客必尝，适合下午茶或节日庆贺。
recommendation.en: Ideal for dessert lovers who enjoy nutty richness and crisp-sweet textures—perfect for afternoon tea or celebrations.

caution: 含坚果与小麦，较甜腻，分量偏小

reviews.content: 酥皮轻盈不油，坚果香浓，玫瑰糖浆清雅不齁甜，一口惊艳！
传统风味正宗，甜度适中，但建议搭配红茶解腻。

description.zh: 土耳其传统早餐甜点，以绵密奶油（Kaymak）淋上天然蜂蜜，冷热交融，口感丰润顺滑，甜香醇厚带微酸回甘
description.en: Turkish breakfast delicacy featuring thick, clotted cream (kaymak) drizzled with floral honey; creamy, cool, and luxuriously rich with balanced sweetness and subtle tang.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢温和甜食、追求地道土耳其早餐体验的食客，尤其推荐给乳制品爱好者
recommendation.en: Ideal for dairy lovers and those seeking authentic, comforting Turkish breakfast indulgence.

caution: 含高脂乳制品；分量偏小；无辣度
ingredients: 水牛奶或山羊奶制成的Kaymak奶油

reviews.content: Kaymak绵密如云，蜂蜜清亮不腻，冷热交织的层次感令人惊艳！
正宗土耳其风味，奶香与蜜香融合完美，早餐吃一份幸福感爆棚。

description.zh: 精选牛肉末混合洋葱、香料，卷入薄饼烤制而成；外微焦内多汁，咸鲜浓郁带烟熏香
description.en: Minced beef mixed with onions and spices, wrapped in thin lavash bread and grilled until golden. Juicy, savory, smoky, and aromatic with a tender-crisp texture.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢地道土耳其风味、追求饱腹感与烟火气的食客
recommendation.en: Ideal for lovers of authentic Turkish street food who crave hearty, smoky, and satisfying grilled meat.

caution: 含小麦，分量扎实，中等油腻度

reviews.content: 肉汁丰盈不柴，薄饼吸饱香气，配酸奶酱绝了！
传统做法还原度高，烟熏味足，适合配冰啤酒解腻

description.zh: 以酥脆千层菲洛饼皮包裹碎羊肉或奶酪，烘烤而成，外皮酥香、内馅咸鲜多汁，带有浓郁乳香与香料气息
description.en: Flaky phyllo pastry layered and baked with spiced minced lamb or feta cheese; crisp exterior, savory-juicy filling with rich dairy and warm spice notes.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢酥脆口感和咸香风味的食客，尤其适合初次尝试土耳其菜的入门者
recommendation.en: Ideal for newcomers to Turkish cuisine who love flaky, savory bites with comforting warmth.

caution: 含小麦和奶制品，略油腻，分量适中

reviews.content: 外皮酥到掉渣，内馅奶酪拉丝香浓，完全还原伊斯坦布尔街头风味！
羊肉款香而不膻，层次丰富，配红茶解腻刚刚好。

description.zh: 以酸奶、黄瓜、大蒜和莳萝为主料冷拌而成，口感清爽顺滑，酸咸微辛，带有清新草本香气。
description.en: A chilled Turkish sauce made by mixing strained yogurt, grated cucumber, garlic, olive oil, and dill. Creamy, tangy, cool, and subtly garlicky with herbal freshness.

recommendation.zh: 适合怕辣、易上火或追求轻食的人群，解腻开胃又消暑。
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice-sensitive, heat-prone, or health-conscious diners seeking a refreshing, low-calorie palate cleanser.

caution: 含乳制品；冷藏食用更佳；分量适中不油腻

reviews.content: 黄瓜清脆+酸奶醇厚，夏日配烤肉绝了，解腻又提神！
蒜香恰到好处，不冲不呛，老人小孩都爱喝着吃。

description.zh: 羊肉与洋葱切小块串烤，外焦里嫩，咸鲜多汁，带有炭火烟熏香
description.en: Skewered cubes of lamb and onion grilled over charcoal until charred outside and tender inside, savory, juicy, with smoky aroma.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢炭火风味和小份量烧烤的食客首选，适合初次尝试土耳其街头美食者
recommendation.en: Ideal for street food lovers and first-time Turkish cuisine explorers who enjoy smoky, bite-sized grilled meat.

caution: 含羊肉和小麦（串签可能接触面筋），中等油腻度

reviews.content: 炭火香气扑鼻，羊肉不膻不柴，一口一串超满足！
分量小巧精致，洋葱甜味完美中和羊肉膻气，配啤酒绝了

description.zh: 羊肉或牛肉切薄片，垂直旋转炭火烤制，外焦里嫩，咸鲜多汁，带有微烟熏香与香料辛香
description.en: Thinly sliced lamb or beef slow-roasted on a vertical rotisserie over charcoal, yielding tender, juicy, savory-scented meat with smoky and spiced notes.

recommendation.zh: 肉食爱好者和追求饱腹感的上班族首选，快速美味又扎实
recommendation.en: Ideal for meat lovers and busy professionals seeking a satisfying, flavorful, and convenient meal.

caution: 含小麦（饼皮）、中等油腻，辣度可选

reviews.content: 肉质软嫩不柴，香料层次丰富，酸奶酱解腻绝配！
烤肉香气扑鼻，分量足，搭配蔬菜很平衡

description.zh: 番茄、洋葱、红椒切碎拌制，清爽酸辣，质地细碎湿润，带有香草与柠檬的鲜明土耳其风味
description.en: Finely chopped tomatoes, onions, and red peppers mixed with parsley, lemon juice, and spices; fresh, tangy, spicy, and herbaceous with a moist, chunky texture.

recommendation.zh: 喜食开胃小食、偏好酸辣口味或想体验地道土耳其风味的食客
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers and those seeking authentic Turkish appetizer flavors.

caution: 辣度中等偏上，含小麦（部分配方用面包屑）

reviews.content: 酸辣平衡绝妙，搭配烤肉解腻又提味，仿佛置身伊斯坦布尔街头
香草清香扑鼻，番茄新鲜多汁，辣度适中不抢味

description.zh: 手擀薄面皮包裹菠菜奶酪或肉末等馅料，铁板煎制而成，外皮微酥内馅柔润，咸香浓郁带奶香
description.en: Thin hand-rolled dough stuffed with spinach-feta, minced meat, or potato, cooked on a griddle until golden. Crispy outside, tender and creamy inside, savory with rich dairy and herb notes.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢热食、追求地道街头风味的食客，尤其推荐给素食者（菠菜奶酪款）和能量需求高的人群
recommendation.en: Ideal for street-food lovers and vegetarians (spinach-feta version); great for those needing hearty, warm, portable meals.

caution: 含小麦和乳制品；分量扎实，较油腻

reviews.content: 外皮焦香酥脆，内馅菠菜清甜+奶酪浓香，一口暖到胃里，土耳其街头灵魂！
现擀现煎香气扑鼻，奶酪拉丝完美，唯一建议可选少油版本更健康

description.zh: 以脱脂酸奶为主料，拌入蒜末、黄瓜丁、莳萝和橄榄油，口感绵密清爽，酸香微咸，带有清新的草本气息。
description.en: A creamy Turkish yogurt dip made with strained yogurt, minced garlic, diced cucumber, fresh dill, and olive oil; cool, tangy, herbaceous, and subtly salty with a smooth, velvety texture.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢清爽开胃小食或需解腻的食客，尤其适合搭配烤肉或中东主食。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those seeking a refreshing, cooling dip with grilled meats or flatbreads.

caution: 含乳制品，对乳糖敏感者慎食；分量适中，非辛辣。

reviews.content: 蒜香与酸奶完美融合，黄瓜脆爽提神，配皮塔饼绝了！
清凉解腻，莳萝香气很地道，比普通酸奶酱更有层次感。

description.zh: 以鹰嘴豆为主料，经煮制、研磨后拌入芝麻酱与橄榄油，口感绵密顺滑，风味醇厚微酸，带有坚果香与淡淡蒜香。
description.en: Made from boiled and blended chickpeas mixed with tahini, olive oil, lemon juice, and garlic; creamy, smooth texture with nutty, tangy, and subtly garlicky flavors.

recommendation.zh: 素食者、健身人群及追求健康轻食者首选，低脂高蛋白，易消化。
recommendation.en: Ideal for vegetarians, fitness enthusiasts, and health-conscious diners seeking a protein-rich, easily digestible appetizer.

caution: 含芝麻与少量大蒜，对芝麻过敏者慎选；分量适中，非主食。

reviews.content: 鹰嘴豆泥细腻无颗粒，芝麻香和柠檬酸平衡绝妙，蘸皮塔饼太满足了！
蒜味温和不冲，橄榄油香气纯正，冷藏后口感更清爽开胃。

description.zh: 以长茄为主料，橄榄油慢炖至软糯，加入洋葱、番茄与香草，口感绵软入味，风味鲜香微酸、咸鲜柔和。
description.en: Stuffed eggplants slow-cooked in olive oil with onions, tomatoes, garlic, and herbs until tender; savory, subtly tangy, and aromatic with a soft, melt-in-mouth texture.

recommendation.zh: 素食者、清淡饮食者及喜爱地中海风味的人首选，老少皆宜。
recommendation.en: Ideal for vegetarians, light-eaters, and Mediterranean food lovers—mild, nourishing, and universally appealing.

caution: 含橄榄油量较高，分量适中，无辣度，不含常见过敏原。

reviews.content: 茄子酥软入味，橄榄油香而不腻，酸甜平衡得恰到好处！
传统做法还原度高，香气扑鼻，配粗粮面包吃更满足。

description.zh: 薄切羊肉片烤制后铺于烤馕上，淋番茄酱与融化的黄油，佐以原味酸奶，口感酥香浓郁、咸鲜微酸、层次丰富。
description.en: Thin slices of marinated lamb grilled to tender crispness, served over toasted pita bread, topped with tangy tomato sauce, melted butter, and cool plain yogurt.

recommendation.zh: 喜爱浓郁风味与丰富口感的肉食爱好者及土耳其菜初尝者首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for meat lovers and newcomers to Turkish cuisine seeking bold, comforting flavors.

good_for: 主菜，适合独食或两人分享
caution: 较油腻，含小麦和乳制品，分量较大

reviews.content: 羊肉嫩而不柴，黄油香气与酸奶清爽完美平衡，地道土耳其风味！
分量实在，番茄酱酸度恰到好处，配酸奶解腻非常到位。

description.zh: 烤裂开的长茄填入洋葱、番茄、牛肉末与香料，烘烤至茄肉软糯、馅料鲜香浓郁，咸鲜微甜，香气扑鼻。
description.en: Hollowed-out eggplants stuffed with sautéed ground beef, onions, tomatoes, and Turkish spices, baked until tender and fragrant—savory, slightly sweet, and deeply aromatic.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜爱地中海风味、追求饱腹感与层次口感的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for lovers of hearty, flavorful Mediterranean dishes who enjoy rich textures and savory depth.

caution: 分量较大，含小麦（面包屑）和牛肉，中等油腻度

reviews.content: 茄子软烂入味，肉馅香而不腻，土耳其香料搭配得恰到好处！
分量实在，烤茄子吸饱酱汁，配米饭绝了，唯一建议少放点油。

description.zh: 以牛奶、大米和糖为主料，慢火熬煮后焦化锅底，形成微苦焦香脆层与柔滑奶香布丁的双重口感。
description.en: A Turkish caramelized rice pudding made with milk, rice, and sugar, cooked slowly until the bottom layer crisps into a bittersweet, fragrant crust while the top remains creamy and smooth.

recommendation.zh: 喜爱层次口感与焦香风味的甜品爱好者必试，适合追求传统手作温度的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for dessert lovers who enjoy contrasting textures and deep caramel notes; perfect for those seeking authentic, artisanal sweets.

caution: 含乳制品与谷物，分量适中偏小，无辣度

reviews.content: 锅底焦香恰到好处，布丁细腻顺滑，香草味清新不腻，传统风味令人难忘。
焦糖层酥脆迷人，内里温润绵密，冷热皆宜，是土耳其甜点中的温柔力量。

description.zh: 以牛肉和羊肉为主料，手工揉捏后煎烤而成；外微焦香、内多汁软嫩，风味咸鲜浓郁带孜然与香菜清香。
description.en: Made with ground beef and lamb, hand-mixed with onions, cumin, and parsley, then pan-fried or grilled. Juicy, tender interior with a slightly crisp exterior and aromatic, savory-spiced flavor.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢传统肉食、追求扎实口感的食客，也推荐给初尝土耳其菜者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for meat lovers and first-time Turkish cuisine explorers seeking hearty, flavorful comfort food.

caution: 含小麦（面包糠）；中等分量；微辣可选

reviews.content: 肉质紧实不柴，香料搭配恰到好处，蘸酸奶酱更显层次感！
外酥里嫩，孜然香气扑鼻，配皮塔饼吃非常满足。

description.zh: 以细丝奶酪（阿卡瓦特）和酥脆细面团为主料，经烘烤后淋玫瑰糖浆，口感外酥内软、热烫拉丝，甜香浓郁带微咸奶香。
description.en: Made with shredded akkawi cheese and fine vermicelli-like pastry, baked until golden and drenched in rose-scented sugar syrup—hot, stretchy, crisp-edged, sweet with subtle salty dairy notes.

recommendation.zh: 喜爱热食甜点、追求拉丝快感及奶香与花香平衡的食客首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for dessert lovers who crave warm, cheesy, stretchy sweets with floral sweetness.

caution: 高温热食，含大量乳制品和小麦，分量较足

reviews.content: 刚出炉时拉丝惊艳，奶香与玫瑰香融合得恰到好处，不腻口！
热乎酥脆，奶酪微咸提味，糖浆甜度适中，适合配浓茶解腻。

description.zh: 薄脆面饼铺满碎羊肉、洋葱、番茄与香料，烤制而成；外酥内润，咸鲜微酸，香气浓郁。
description.en: Thin, crisp wheat flatbread topped with spiced minced lamb, onions, tomatoes, and herbs, baked until golden. Savory, tangy, aromatic, with a satisfying crisp-chewy texture.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢异国风味、追求轻食主食或想尝试地道土耳其街头美食的食客首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for lovers of bold Middle Eastern flavors or those seeking a light yet satisfying handheld meal.

caution: 含小麦和少量洋葱；辣度温和，分量适中。

reviews.content: 饼底酥脆不硬，肉馅多汁入味，酸香平衡得恰到好处，一口回到伊斯坦布尔街头！
香料层次丰富，不腻不膻，配柠檬汁更显清新，适合胃口小但爱尝鲜的人。

description.zh: 以红扁豆为主料慢炖而成，质地细腻顺滑，风味醇厚微酸，带有洋葱与香料的温暖香气。
description.en: A velvety Turkish soup made by slow-simmering red lentils with onions, carrots, tomato paste, and spices like cumin and paprika, resulting in a rich, earthy, subtly tangy flavor.

recommendation.zh: 适合素食者、肠胃敏感者及追求暖胃低脂餐食的人群。
recommendation.en: Ideal for vegetarians, those with sensitive digestion, or anyone seeking a comforting, low-fat, nutrient-rich meal.

caution: 不含常见过敏原，微酸不辣，分量适中

reviews.content: 汤体丝滑无颗粒，酸香平衡恰到好处，喝完胃里暖暖的很舒服。
经典家常味，红扁豆煮得软烂入味，配一片烤面包绝了。

description.zh: 以糖、淀粉和玫瑰水为主料熬煮凝结而成，质地软糯弹牙，甜润微香，常裹椰丝或坚果碎增添层次
description.en: Made by simmering sugar, cornstarch, and rose water until set, then cut into cubes; soft, chewy, springy texture with floral sweetness and subtle citrus or nutty notes.

recommendation.zh: 甜食爱好者、下午茶伴侣、喜欢温和异国风味的食客首选
recommendation.en: Ideal for dessert lovers, tea-time indulgers, and those seeking mild, fragrant Middle Eastern sweets.

good_for: 餐后甜点/分享小食/伴手礼
caution: 含小麦淀粉；甜度高；分量小巧易食多块

reviews.content: 玫瑰香气清雅不腻，咬下去Q弹回甘，配红茶绝了！
传统配方扎实，甜度适中，椰丝版更添香气与口感层次

description.zh: 羊肉或牛肉馅包裹在薄面皮中水煮，淋酸奶酱与红椒油，口感软糯弹牙，风味咸鲜微酸，奶香浓郁
description.en: Tiny dumplings filled with spiced lamb or beef, boiled until tender, served with garlicky yogurt sauce and chili oil—creamy, tangy, savory, and delicately spiced.

recommendation.zh: 喜爱传统手工面食、偏好酸咸平衡口味的食客首选
recommendation.en: Ideal for dumpling lovers and those who enjoy creamy, tangy, savory flavors in one bite.

caution: 含小麦和乳制品；分量精致，易饱

reviews.content: 酸奶酱醇厚不腻，小饺子一口一个，肉汁丰盈，地道土耳其风味！
面皮薄而筋道，配蒜香酸奶绝了，微辣提神但不刺激。

description.zh: 新鲜番茄、青椒与鸡蛋慢炒而成，质地柔嫩湿润，酸香微辛，带有土耳其香料的温暖风味。
description.en: A Turkish breakfast dish of fresh tomatoes, green peppers, and eggs gently sautéed together—tender, moist, tangy, aromatic, and subtly spiced with paprika and oregano.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢软嫩蛋食、追求地道异国早餐体验的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for egg lovers and travelers seeking an authentic, comforting Turkish morning meal.

caution: 含鸡蛋；中等油量；微辣（可选辣度）

reviews.content: 番茄汁水丰盈，蛋体滑嫩不老，香料平衡得恰到好处！
热乎现炒，香气扑鼻，配皮塔饼吃超满足。

description.zh: 以烤红椒、核桃和面包碎为主料，经研磨制成的中东风味辣酱，质地绵密微颗粒，酸辣开胃，带有烟熏与坚果香
description.en: A Middle Eastern dip made from roasted red peppers, walnuts, and toasted bread, blended to a creamy yet slightly textured consistency with tangy, smoky, and spicy notes.

recommendation.zh: 嗜酸喜辣者、坚果爱好者及素食者首选，风味层次丰富，开胃解腻
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers, walnut fans, and vegetarians seeking bold, complex flavor and natural umami.

caution: 含坚果，辣度中等，建议搭配面包或蔬菜条食用

reviews.content: 核桃香与红椒酸甜完美融合，辣而不燥，蘸皮塔饼绝了！
口感细腻有嚼劲，石榴糖浆提亮风味，适合佐餐开胃

description.zh: 小麦面团烤制船形饼，夹入碎牛肉、洋葱、番茄与香料，外皮微脆内里松软，咸鲜浓郁带香草辛香。
description.en: Leavened wheat dough shaped like a boat and baked, filled with spiced ground beef, onions, tomatoes, and herbs; crispy exterior, tender interior, savory and aromatic.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢主食+肉馅组合的食客，尤其适合偏好热食、饱腹感强的午餐或晚餐。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those seeking a hearty, warm, protein-rich main meal—perfect for lunch or dinner lovers.

caution: 含小麦和牛奶，分量较大，中等油腻度

reviews.content: 外皮酥香有嚼劲，肉馅多汁不腻，香料搭配恰到好处，地道土耳其风味！
分量实在，热乎上桌香气扑鼻，配酸奶酱更解腻，适合胃口大的朋友。

description.zh: 羊肉或牛肉切块串烤，外焦里嫩，烟熏香气浓郁，咸鲜微香，肉汁丰盈。
description.en: Cubed lamb or beef skewered and grilled over charcoal, yielding tender, juicy meat with smoky aroma and savory, slightly herbal seasoning.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢炭火风味和扎实肉感的食客首选，适合肉食爱好者和户外聚餐人群。
recommendation.en: Ideal for meat lovers and those who enjoy bold, smoky grilled flavors—great for casual gatherings.

caution: 含小麦（腌料中可能含酱油），分量较足，轻度烟熏味。

reviews.content: 羊肉鲜嫩多汁，炭火香扑鼻，孜然调味恰到好处，毫无膻味。
分量实在，蔬菜烤得微甜，和肉搭配清爽不腻，适合夏天吃。

description.zh: 小麦粉面团经糖水浸泡后裹满芝麻，烘烤至金黄酥脆，外脆内韧，麦香浓郁伴芝麻焦香。
description.en: A circular bread made from wheat dough dipped in molasses water, generously coated with sesame seeds, and baked until golden and crisp—chewy inside, crunchy outside, with rich malty and nutty aroma.

recommendation.zh: 适合早餐、下午茶或轻食爱好者，方便手持，饱腹又不腻。
recommendation.en: Ideal for breakfast or snack lovers seeking a portable, satisfying, and aromatic carb fix.

caution: 含小麦和芝麻，分量适中，无辣度。

reviews.content: 外皮芝麻香脆到掉渣，内里微韧有嚼劲，配红茶绝了！
传统土耳其风味十足，冷吃也不硬，早餐搭配咖啡很提神。

description.zh: 以牛肉和羊肉为主料，经发酵风干制成，口感紧实有嚼劲，风味咸鲜浓郁带微辛香与烟熏感。
description.en: Made from fermented and air-dried beef and lamb, with a firm, chewy texture and savory, smoky, slightly spicy flavor.

recommendation.zh: 适合早餐偏好高蛋白、重口味者，或想体验地道土耳其风味的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for breakfast lovers seeking high-protein, bold flavors or authentic Turkish taste.

caution: 较油腻，含小麦和牛肉，辣度中等

reviews.content: 烟熏香气十足，切片煎后外微焦内柔韧，配煎蛋绝了！
传统风味正宗，咸香适口，但初次尝试者建议少量搭配酸奶解腻。

description.zh: 以大米、牛奶和糖为主料慢煮烘烤而成，口感软糯顺滑，奶香浓郁，甜度适中带微焦香
description.en: A traditional Turkish rice pudding made with short-grain rice, milk, and sugar, slowly simmered then baked until creamy and slightly caramelized on top.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢温和甜品、乳制品爱好者及寻求怀旧风味的食客首选
recommendation.en: Ideal for dessert lovers, dairy fans, and those craving comforting, nostalgic sweetness.

caution: 含乳制品和小麦，分量适中偏小

reviews.content: 表面焦糖脆壳与内里温润米布丁形成绝妙对比，奶香纯粹不腻
冷藏后口感更绵密，撒上肉桂粉增添温暖辛香，老少皆宜

description.zh: 鸡胸肉丝、牛奶、大米粉与糖熬煮而成的柔滑布丁，口感细腻软糯，奶香清甜，带有微妙的禽肉鲜香。
description.en: A delicate Turkish dessert made by simmering shredded chicken breast with milk, rice flour, and sugar until smooth and creamy; tender, silky, subtly savory-sweet with rich dairy aroma.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢新奇口感、不排斥禽肉甜点的食客，或想体验地道土耳其风味的甜品爱好者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for adventurous eaters curious about savory-sweet desserts or authentic Turkish culinary traditions.

caution: 含牛奶、鸡蛋、小麦；质地柔滑但分量偏小

reviews.content: 入口即化，鸡茸完全融入奶香中，毫无腥味，甜度恰到好处！
颠覆认知的甜点，细腻顺滑，肉香与奶香融合得非常和谐。

description.zh: 羊肉与番茄、青椒、洋葱等炖于密封陶罐中慢烤，肉质酥嫩多汁，风味浓郁鲜香带微烟熏感。
description.en: Tender lamb stewed with tomatoes, bell peppers, and onions in a sealed clay pot over open fire; rich, savory, smoky, and succulent with deep umami.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢传统炭火风味和软嫩肉食的食客首选，适合追求地道土耳其体验者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for lovers of rustic, slow-cooked meats and authentic Turkish culinary traditions.

caution: 分量较大，含小麦（陶罐封泥可能含面粉），中等油腻度
ingredients: 香料（孜然、红椒粉、黑胡椒）

reviews.content: 陶罐现敲开的仪式感十足，羊肉入口即化，香料融合得恰到好处！
汤汁浓郁拌馕一绝，虽稍油腻但风味层次非常丰富。

description.zh: 以奶酪、橄榄、番茄、黄瓜、鸡蛋和面包为主，冷热兼备；口感丰富多样，咸鲜清爽中带微酸奶香。
description.en: A vibrant spread featuring aged white cheese, green olives, fresh tomatoes and cucumbers, boiled eggs, butter, jam, and crusty bread—served cold and warm with savory, tangy, creamy, and rustic notes.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢丰盛早食、追求地道风味或需高能量开启一天的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for food lovers seeking authentic Turkish flavors or needing a hearty, energizing start to the day.

caution: 含乳制品与小麦；分量较大，易饱腹。

reviews.content: 奶酪醇厚、橄榄清香，搭配刚烤热的面包，层次感绝了！
食材新鲜丰富，分量足，是唤醒味蕾的完美土耳其式清晨。

description.zh: 深度烘焙阿拉比卡咖啡豆研磨成极细粉，铜壶慢煮不滤渣，口感浓稠微苦，带有焦糖与香料余韵。
description.en: Finely ground dark-roasted Arabica coffee brewed slowly in a cezve (copper pot) without filtering; thick, rich, bittersweet with caramel and spicy notes.

recommendation.zh: 咖啡爱好者、追求传统手作体验者及喜欢浓烈风味的人士。
recommendation.en: Ideal for coffee connoisseurs and those seeking authentic, ritualistic, bold-flavored drinks.

caution: 含咖啡因较高，孕妇慎饮；沉淀物勿喝尽。

reviews.content: 香气扑鼻，杯底沉淀形成独特醇厚感，土耳其待客仪式感满分！
现煮现喝温度恰到好处，微苦回甘，配一小块软糖更显平衡。

description.zh: 以糖、淀粉和玫瑰水或柠檬汁熬煮凝结而成，口感软糯弹牙，风味清甜微香，常裹椰丝或坚果碎
description.en: Made by simmering sugar, cornstarch, and rosewater or lemon juice until set, then cut into cubes; soft, chewy, and delicately fragrant with floral or citrus notes.

recommendation.zh: 甜食爱好者与茶饮搭配者首选，适合追求精致小食体验的人群
recommendation.en: Ideal for dessert lovers and tea drinkers seeking a delicate, aromatic treat.

caution: 含小麦淀粉；糖分高；分量小巧易多食

reviews.content: 玫瑰味纯正不腻，咬下去Q弹回甘，配红茶绝了！
传统手工制，椰丝包裹恰到好处，甜度适中不齁人

description.zh: 优质红茶经双层铜壶煮沸萃取，茶汤红亮浓醇，口感温润微涩，带有焦糖与干果般的醇厚回甘
description.en: Brewed using high-quality black tea leaves in a traditional double-layered copper kettle, yielding a rich, ruby-red infusion with warm, smooth texture and subtle astringency balanced by caramel and dried-fruit notes.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢纯正茶香、需提神醒脑或体验地道土耳其日常的饮茶者
recommendation.en: Ideal for tea lovers seeking authentic, caffeine-rich refreshment and cultural immersion.

caution: 含咖啡因；无添加糖，甜度依个人调配

reviews.content: 茶香纯粹饱满，双壶煮法让层次感惊艳，喝完神清气爽不苦涩
正宗土耳其风味，色泽透亮，搭配方糖或柠檬更显风味平衡

description.zh: 精选羊肉与牛肉混合剁碎，炭火慢烤，外微焦内多汁，带有乌尔法辣椒的烟熏微辣与香料醇香。
description.en: Minced lamb and beef seasoned with Urfa pepper and spices, grilled over charcoal—juicy inside, slightly charred outside, with smoky, mild heat and aromatic depth.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢烟熏风味和温和辣度的食客，适合初次尝试土耳其烧烤者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those who enjoy smoky flavors and mild spice—perfect for first-time Turkish kebab explorers.

caution: 含小麦（面包屑），中等辣度，分量扎实。

reviews.content: 肉质细嫩多汁，乌尔法辣椒的果香和微辣恰到好处，完全不呛口。
炭火香气十足，搭配皮塔饼绝配，分量足且饱腹感强。

description.zh: 米浆蒸制而成的薄软粉皮，包裹鲜香猪肉香菇馅，口感滑嫩柔韧，风味清淡鲜美带微甜
description.en: Thin, delicate rice crepes steamed from rice batter, filled with savory minced pork and wood ear mushrooms; tender, silky texture with light umami sweetness.

recommendation.zh: 适合早餐偏好清淡、易消化者，或想体验地道越南早茶风味的食客
recommendation.en: Ideal for breakfast lovers seeking light, digestible, authentic Vietnamese morning fare.

caution: 含小麦（蘸酱）、微量鸡蛋（部分配方）；分量适中不油腻

reviews.content: 粉皮薄如蝉翼又不失韧性，肉馅鲜而不腻，蘸鱼露吃太地道了！
口感清爽不厚重，早上吃一碗很舒服，配豆芽和香草更添层次

description.zh: 烤法棍夹烤猪肉、腌萝卜胡萝卜、香菜、青葱与特调鱼露蛋黄酱，外脆内软，酸甜微辣，鲜香清爽
description.en: Grilled baguette filled with lemongrass-marinated grilled pork, pickled daikon-carrot, cilantro, scallions, and house fish sauce-mayo. Crispy exterior, tender interior, tangy-sweet-spicy, aromatic and refreshing.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢风味层次丰富、开胃又饱腹的食客首选
recommendation.en: Ideal for adventurous eaters seeking bold, balanced flavors in a satisfying handheld meal.

caution: 含小麦、鱼露（含海鲜）、芝麻；中等辣度可选

reviews.content: 法棍酥脆不干硬，腌菜爽脆解腻，鱼露酱汁提鲜不腥，风味太有记忆点！
分量实在，肉质多汁入味，微辣恰到好处，吃完口齿留香不油腻。

description.zh: 以米纸丝为主料，拌入干虾米、青木瓜丝、蛋皮、葱油等，口感酥脆爽口，风味酸辣鲜香带芝麻香。
description.en: Tossed rice paper strips with dried shrimp, green papaya, fried egg threads, scallion oil, lime, and roasted peanuts—crispy, tangy, spicy, and umami-rich.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢清爽酸辣口味、追求街头风味体验的年轻人首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for young diners seeking bold, zesty street food flavors in a light, vibrant dish.

caution: 含花生、虾米和小麦；辣度中等偏上；分量适中。

reviews.content: 酸辣开胃，米纸酥脆不软塌，青木瓜清甜解腻，一口接一口停不下来！
地道西贡风味，配料丰富有层次，只是辣度对新手稍显刺激。

description.zh: 以米浆为皮，包裹虾仁、猪肉、豆芽，铁锅猛火煎至金黄酥脆，外脆内润，鲜香微酸带椰香
description.en: Crispy rice-flour crepe pan-fried until golden, filled with shrimp, pork, and bean sprouts; savory, tangy, aromatic with coconut notes and a satisfying crunch.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢酥脆口感和地道越南风味的食客首选，适合初次尝试越菜者
recommendation.en: Ideal for first-time Vietnamese food explorers or crisp-texture lovers.

caution: 含花生油与小麦粉，分量较大，微辣

reviews.content: 外皮酥得掉渣，内馅鲜甜多汁，蘸鱼露青木瓜丝绝配！
传统做法还原度高，米香浓郁，虾肉弹牙不腥

description.zh: 牛肉末混合香料裹入柔韧蒌叶，炭火煎至外微焦内多汁，鲜香浓郁带草本清香与微辛回甘。
description.en: Minced beef seasoned with lemongrass, shallots, and fish sauce, wrapped in betel leaves and grilled until crisp-edged and juicy—aromatic, savory, with herbal freshness and subtle heat.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢风味独特、不腻口的食客，尤其适合初次尝试越南菜的人。
recommendation.en: Ideal for adventurous eaters and first-time Vietnamese food lovers seeking bold yet balanced flavors.

caution: 含小麦（鱼露）、轻微辣度；分量适中，非素食。

reviews.content: 蒌叶清香完美衬托牛肉鲜味，外脆里嫩，一口停不下来！
香料搭配恰到好处，不抢味，炭火香让整道菜更有层次感。

description.zh: 嫩牛肉粒以猛火快炒，外微焦里多汁，搭配洋葱青椒，咸鲜微甜带黑胡椒辛香。
description.en: Tender beef cubes stir-fried over high heat until caramelized on the outside and juicy within, with onions, bell peppers, and a savory-sweet black pepper sauce.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢镬气足、口感鲜明的年轻食客和牛肉爱好者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for beef lovers and young diners who enjoy bold wok-hei flavors and tender-crisp textures.

caution: 含小麦（鱼露、酱油）、中等分量、微辣

reviews.content: 牛肉嫩滑不柴，锅气十足，黑胡椒香气扑鼻，配饭绝了！
洋葱清甜解腻，酱汁浓郁但不齁咸，下饭能力满分。

description.zh: 牛腱与猪脚熬制红汤，配细圆米粉、香草与青柠，汤色红亮，口感醇厚微辣，风味鲜香浓郁带柠檬酸香
description.en: Rich, spicy broth made from beef shank and pork knuckle, served with round rice noodles, fresh herbs, and lime wedges; savory, aromatic, tangy, and moderately spicy with tender meat and springy noodles.

recommendation.zh: 嗜辣者与汤粉爱好者必尝，适合追求地道越南风味的食客
recommendation.en: Ideal for spice lovers and noodle enthusiasts seeking authentic, bold Vietnamese street food flavor.

caution: 辣度中高，含小麦和牛肉，分量足宜独食

reviews.content: 汤底香辣过瘾，牛腱软烂入味，青柠提鲜让整碗层次分明
顺化风味正宗，辣而不燥，香茅与辣椒油香气扑鼻，暖身又开胃

description.zh: 炭火烤制猪肩肉与猪五花，搭配清爽米粉、青柠鱼露蘸汁和生菜香草，肉质焦香多汁，酸甜微咸，清新解腻。
description.en: Grilled marinated pork shoulder and belly served with rice vermicelli, fresh herbs, pickled vegetables, and tangy-sweet fish sauce dip; smoky, juicy, and refreshingly balanced.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢酸甜开胃、追求地道越南风味的食客，尤其推荐给初次尝试越式烧烤者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for first-time Vietnamese food explorers or those craving a bright, smoky, and balanced grilled dish.

caution: 含小麦（米粉）、鱼露（含海鲜），分量适中，微辣可调。

reviews.content: 烤肉焦香入味，蘸汁酸甜恰到好处，配菜清脆爽口，一口米粉一口肉太满足！
鱼露香气浓郁但不腥，猪肉不柴，米粉吸饱酱汁后特别入味，夏天吃超开胃。

description.zh: 以蟹肉、番茄和发酵虾酱熬制的鲜酸汤底，配弹滑米线与嫩豆腐，口感清爽微酸，风味鲜香浓郁带独特发酵醇香。
description.en: A vibrant Vietnamese noodle soup with a tangy, umami-rich broth made from crab, tomatoes, and fermented shrimp paste, served with springy rice noodles and soft tofu.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢酸鲜风味、追求地道越南味的食客首选，适合口味偏好丰富层次者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for lovers of bright, umami-tangy flavors seeking authentic Vietnamese comfort food.

caution: 含甲壳类过敏原，汤底微辣，分量适中。

reviews.content: 汤头酸鲜开胃，蟹香扑鼻，米线爽滑不糊，喝完一碗浑身舒畅！
发酵风味独特但不冲，番茄酸度恰到好处，豆腐吸饱汤汁特别入味。

description.zh: 炭火烤制的焦香猪里脊配细圆米粉，肉质鲜嫩多汁，搭配鱼露青木瓜沙拉，酸甜微咸，清爽开胃。
description.en: Grilled marinated pork loin served over thin rice vermicelli, topped with tangy green papaya salad and nuoc cham; savory, sweet-sour, smoky, and refreshingly light.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢清爽酸甜口味、追求低负担主食的上班族和素食转荤食者。
recommendation.en: Ideal for office workers seeking a light yet satisfying meal or flexitarians craving flavorful, balanced Vietnamese fare.

caution: 含鱼露（含小麦/大豆），分量适中，微辣可选。

reviews.content: 烤肉焦香入味，米粉爽滑不腻，青木瓜沙拉酸甜解腻，一口上头！
酱汁层次丰富，鱼露香而不腥，配菜新鲜爽脆，饱腹感恰到好处。

description.zh: 主料为鲶鱼或鲭鱼，以鱼露、糖、蒜、姜慢炖于陶制砂锅中，肉质软嫩入味，酱汁浓稠咸鲜微甜。
description.en: Catfish or mackerel braised slowly in a clay pot with fish sauce, caramelized sugar, garlic, and ginger—tender, savory-sweet, and deeply aromatic.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢浓郁酱香与软嫩鱼肉的食客，尤其推荐给偏好传统越式家常风味的人。
recommendation.en: Ideal for lovers of savory-sweet Vietnamese comfort food and tender, flavorful fish dishes.

caution: 含鱼及鱼露（大豆），分量适中，微咸不辣。

reviews.content: 鱼肉酥烂入味，焦糖酱汁拌饭绝了，地道越式家常味道！
砂锅保温好，酱汁浓而不腻，老人小孩都爱吃。

description.zh: 用越南滴漏壶萃取浓烈罗布斯塔咖啡，混合炼乳，加冰块制成；口感顺滑微稠，风味苦中带甜、奶香浓郁、冰凉提神
description.en: Strong Robusta coffee brewed slowly through a Vietnamese phin filter, mixed with sweetened condensed milk and served over ice. Rich, creamy, bittersweet, and refreshingly cold.

recommendation.zh: 适合咖啡爱好者、怕苦者及需提神的上班族，炼乳缓和苦味，冰饮解暑
recommendation.en: Ideal for coffee lovers, those sensitive to bitterness, or anyone needing an energizing, refreshing pick-me-up.

caution: 含乳糖和较高糖分，糖尿病患者慎饮

reviews.content: 炼乳与冰咖啡融合绝妙，苦甜平衡，冰凉丝滑，夏日续命神器！
咖啡香浓不涩，炼乳量恰到好处，喝完神清气爽不腻口。

description.zh: 鲜鸡蛋黄与炼乳打发成绵密奶霜，覆于热越南滴滤咖啡上；口感丝滑温润，风味甜香浓郁带微苦回甘。
description.en: Whisked egg yolk and sweetened condensed milk form a creamy, airy foam layered over hot Vietnamese drip coffee; rich, velvety texture with sweet, caramelized notes balanced by bold coffee bitterness.

recommendation.zh: 咖啡爱好者或喜欢甜味暖饮者，尤其适合冬日暖身或下午提神小憩。
recommendation.en: Ideal for coffee lovers or those craving a sweet, warming drink—perfect for cold days or afternoon pick-me-ups.

caution: 含生蛋黄，孕妇及免疫力弱者慎用；含高糖高脂。

reviews.content: 蛋霜轻盈如云，咖啡香醇不抢戏，甜度恰到好处，喝完满口余香。
冬日里最治愈的暖饮，蛋香与咖啡融合得温柔又高级，不腻不涩。

description.zh: 以鱼片、番茄、菠萝、豆芽为主料，酸汤慢炖而成，口感清爽微酸，融合鱼鲜与果香的平衡酸甜风味。
description.en: A light Vietnamese sour soup made with catfish or snakehead fish, tomatoes, pineapple, bean sprouts, and tamarind, simmered to achieve a bright, tangy-sweet balance with delicate fishiness and fruity freshness.

recommendation.zh: 适合口味偏好清新酸甜、易上火或夏季食欲不振者，开胃解腻效果佳。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those seeking refreshing, appetite-stimulating dishes—especially in hot weather or after rich meals.

caution: 含鱼和少量虾米，过敏者慎选；酸度明显，胃敏感者适量食用。

reviews.content: 酸甜恰到好处，鱼肉滑嫩，菠萝清香提味，喝完浑身通透！
汤色清亮，层次丰富，酸而不涩，配米饭特别开胃。

description.zh: 碱水面配炭烤猪肉、芽菜、炸猪油渣和秘制酱汁，口感弹牙微韧，风味咸鲜浓郁带烟熏香与淡淡甜味。
description.en: Chewy alkaline noodles topped with charcoal-grilled pork, bean sprouts, crispy lard bits, and a savory-sweet fermented soy-based sauce with smoky depth.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢地道越南风味、追求独特口感和层次感的食客首选。
recommendation.en: Ideal for adventurous eaters seeking authentic, texturally complex Vietnamese street food.

caution: 含小麦、猪肉、贝类（虾米提鲜），分量适中偏小。

reviews.content: 面条筋道有嚼劲，炭香和虾米鲜味融合绝妙，会安灵魂味道！
酱汁微甜不腻，猪油渣酥脆提香，整体平衡感极佳。

description.zh: 猪肉、虾仁、粉丝与蔬菜卷入米纸油炸，外皮金黄酥脆，内馅鲜香多汁，咸鲜微甜带竹笋清香。
description.en: Crispy fried rice paper rolls filled with minced pork, shrimp, vermicelli, wood ear mushrooms, and julienned vegetables; savory-sweet, juicy interior with a light bamboo shoot aroma.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢酥脆口感和地道越南风味的食客，初次尝试越菜者的理想入门 appetizer。
recommendation.en: Perfect for first-time Vietnamese food explorers or anyone craving crispy, savory snacks.

caution: 含小麦（春卷皮）和虾，油炸略油腻

reviews.content: 外皮炸得恰到好处，酥而不硬，内馅鲜甜不腻，蘸鱼露辣椒酱绝配！
虾肉弹牙，猪肉嫩滑，竹笋清香提味，是记忆中的正宗河内风味。

description.zh: 以红豆、绿豆、西米或芋头为主料，加糖慢煮而成，口感软糯滑润，甜度适中，带有植物清香与微焦糖风味。
description.en: A traditional Vietnamese dessert made by slow-simmering mung beans, red beans, taro, or tapioca pearls with sugar; soft, smooth, and subtly fragrant with balanced sweetness.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜甜人士、饭后解腻者及想体验越南传统甜品的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for dessert lovers and those seeking a light, authentic Vietnamese sweet finish to a meal.

caution: 含糖量较高，部分款含椰奶（含牛奶）

reviews.content: 红豆软烂入味，西米Q弹不糊，椰香清甜不腻，完美还原河内老街风味。
温热时喝暖心，冷藏后更显清爽，是夏日解暑与冬日暖身的双重选择。

description.zh: 碎米粒蒸熟，搭配炭火烤制的焦香五花肉，口感干爽微韧，咸鲜带微甜，佐以鱼露青木瓜沙拉提味。
description.en: Steamed broken rice served with charcoal-grilled marinated pork belly, offering a savory-sweet umami flavor, tender-crisp texture, and bright contrast from pickled green papaya salad.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢地道街头风味、追求饱腹感与层次口感的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for food lovers seeking authentic, hearty Vietnamese street food with balanced textures and bold flavors.

caution: 含鱼露（含小麦）、分量足，微咸不辣。

reviews.content: 五花肉焦香多汁，碎米吸饱酱汁却粒粒分明，越吃越上瘾！
青木瓜沙拉酸辣开胃，完美中和猪肉油腻，整体清爽不腻。

description.zh: 以脆嫩莲藕为主料，生拌凉制，口感清脆爽口，融合鱼露、青柠、糖的酸甜咸鲜与香草清香。
description.en: Fresh lotus stem tossed raw with nuoc mam, lime juice, sugar, chili, and herbs—crisp, refreshing, tangy-sweet, savory, and aromatic.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜清爽口感、控热量或素食者，也推荐给初次尝试越式风味的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for health-conscious diners, vegetarians, or first-time Vietnamese food explorers seeking light, vibrant flavors.

caution: 微辣，含鱼露（含海鲜），分量适中

reviews.content: 莲藕脆得恰到好处，酸甜平衡，香草香气扑鼻，开胃又解腻！
清爽不腻，花生增添香脆感，配啤酒或白葡萄酒都很出色。

description.zh: 以米纸包裹鲜虾、猪肉、米粉、生菜和薄荷等，冷食，口感清爽弹牙，风味清新微酸带香草芬芳。
description.en: Rice paper rolls filled with poached shrimp, grilled pork, rice vermicelli, lettuce, mint, and herbs; served chilled—light, springy, and refreshingly tangy with aromatic herbs.

recommendation.zh: 适合追求低脂健康、清淡开胃或素食倾向者，也受怕辣和儿童欢迎。
recommendation.en: Ideal for health-conscious diners, those preferring light meals, or children—naturally gluten-free and non-spicy.

caution: 含虾和小麦（米纸可能含微量小麦淀粉），非油炸但需蘸酱食用

reviews.content: 虾肉弹嫩，米纸柔韧不破，蘸花生酱绝配，吃完毫无负担！
清香解腻，夏天吃特别舒服，蔬菜分量足，健康感满分。

description.zh: 猪骨与虾壳熬制清鲜高汤，配细滑米制Hủ Tiếu粉、薄切猪肉片、虾仁与豆芽，汤头清爽微甜，粉质柔韧弹牙，风味鲜香平衡。
description.en: Clear, fragrant broth simmered from pork bones and shrimp shells, served with tender rice noodles, sliced pork, prawns, and bean sprouts; light, subtly sweet, with springy noodles and savory-umami depth.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢清淡鲜味、肠胃敏感者或初次尝试越南面食的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for those seeking light, umami-rich comfort food or new to Vietnamese cuisine.

caution: 含小麦（米粉含少量淀粉添加剂）、海鲜过敏者慎选

reviews.content: 汤头清而不寡，米粉爽滑不糊，猪肉嫩而不柴，喝完暖胃又解腻。
鲜味层次丰富，虾香融入汤中，配酸萝卜更添开胃清爽感。

description.zh: 鲜黄姜黄汤底煮制宽米线，配烤猪肉、虾仁、花生与生菜，口感爽滑弹牙，风味咸鲜微辛、层次丰富
description.en: Wide rice noodles in fragrant turmeric-infused broth, topped with grilled pork, shrimp, crushed peanuts, and fresh herbs; savory, aromatic, with springy texture and subtle earthy warmth.

recommendation.zh: 喜欢尝鲜、追求风味层次的食客，尤其适合初次体验越南中部美食者
recommendation.en: Ideal for adventurous eaters seeking authentic Central Vietnamese flavors and aromatic, balanced umami.

caution: 含花生、虾、小麦；辣度可调，分量适中

reviews.content: 姜黄汤底香气扑鼻，米线弹牙不腻，配料丰富又不抢味，地道广南风味！
汤头清鲜回甘，虾和猪肉火候刚好，花生脆香点睛，吃完胃很舒服。

description.zh: 新鲜牛肉片与牛骨高汤炖煮的河粉，汤色清亮，肉质柔嫩，口感滑爽，风味鲜香微甜，带有八角、桂皮等香料的温和辛香。
description.en: Rice noodles served in a clear, aromatic beef bone broth with tender slices of fresh beef, simmered with star anise and cinnamon; savory, fragrant, subtly sweet, and deeply umami.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢暖胃汤面、追求原汁原味或初尝越南菜的食客。
recommendation.en: Ideal for soup lovers, first-time Vietnamese food explorers, or anyone seeking a comforting, nourishing meal.

caution: 含小麦（河粉）、牛肉；汤温热，分量适中，微辣可选。

reviews.content: 汤头清澈却醇厚，牛肉现烫极嫩，河粉吸饱汤汁仍弹牙，香料味恰到好处不抢戏。
暖身又开胃，配青柠和豆芽后层次更丰富，是冬日里最治愈的一碗。

description.zh: 以嫩鸡胸肉和清炖鸡骨高汤为基底，搭配爽滑米线，汤色澄亮，口感清爽鲜香，带有香茅、姜与青柠的柔和辛香
description.en: Tender poached chicken breast and delicate rice noodles in a clear, aromatic chicken broth infused with ginger, lemongrass, and lime—light, savory, and refreshingly fragrant.

recommendation.zh: 适合肠胃敏感者、清淡饮食人群及初次尝试越南菜的食客
recommendation.en: Ideal for sensitive stomachs, light-eaters, or first-time Vietnamese cuisine explorers.

caution: 含小麦（米粉）、无辣度，分量适中

reviews.content: 汤头清甜不腻，鸡肉嫩而不柴，喝完整个人都暖了
米线Q弹入味，配青柠和豆芽后层次丰富，解腻又开胃

description.zh: 以宽扁河粉为主料，猛火快炒，口感柔滑微弹，鲜香微咸，略带焦香与肉汁醇厚风味。
description.en: Wide rice noodles stir-fried over high heat with beef or chicken, bean sprouts, and scallions; tender, slightly chewy, savory, aromatic, and delicately smoky.

recommendation.zh: 适合喜欢清淡鲜香、追求快速饱腹感的上班族和素食者（可选素版）。
recommendation.en: Ideal for busy professionals seeking a light yet satisfying meal; vegetarian version available.

caution: 含小麦（米粉）、可能含鱼露（含大豆/贝类）；中等分量，微咸不辣。

reviews.content: 河粉滑而不烂，肉片嫩滑入味，锅气十足，吃得出新鲜食材。
比普通炒河粉更清爽不油腻，鱼露提鲜恰到好处，适合夏天。

description.zh: 新鲜牛油果与炼乳、冰块搅打而成，口感绵密顺滑，奶香浓郁中带清甜果香。
description.en: Fresh avocado blended with sweetened condensed milk and ice until creamy and smooth, offering rich dairy notes balanced by natural fruit sweetness and cool refreshment.

recommendation.zh: 适合追求健康轻食、需要补充健康脂肪的上班族或学生。
recommendation.en: Ideal for health-conscious people seeking nutritious, energizing refreshment.

caution: 含乳制品；分量适中；无辣度

reviews.content: 牛油果香浓不腻，炼乳甜度刚好，喝完满口顺滑回甘！
冰沙细腻无渣，夏天来一杯瞬间降温，饱腹感强又不负担。
